chapters.title: Chapter 3951 Protecting his own people
paragraphs: 3951 Protecting his own people
Right at this moment, a figure appeared. It was an old man who looked to be in his seventies.
True Self Tier!
This was a native. Obviously, he had snatched the token of an outsider, and successfully left the Mystery Realm.
“Humph!” A Venerate Tier elite moved, grabbing out at the old man.
The pitiful old man was an invincible elite in the Mystery Realm, but once he came out, he was extremely weak in front of Venerate Tier elites.
He couldn’t block this strike at all, and he was immediately captured.

The old man revealed an expression of disbelief. Though he had already prepared himself mentally that the outside world was filled with elites, he had not thought that he would encounter them so quickly.
“A mere native actually dares to harm our disciple?” That Venerate Tier humphed, and clenched his hand. Pa, that old man was forcibly crushed, turning into a shower of blood.
So what if he was a True Self Tier? In front of a Venerate Tier elite, he was like an ant.
One after another, some natives managed to snatch the tokens and escaped from the Mystery Realm. However, the Venerate Tier elites outside easily killed them, and none of them survived.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel a little rueful. Who would want to die?

Wasn’t the reason why the natives did this also for the sake of living a few more years? However, because they were on opposing sides, this caused the natives to kill outsiders in the Mystery Realm, and when they were outside, it would become the outsiders slaughtering the natives.
He put away his worries and good feelings, because he was completely powerless to change them.

Surprisingly, it wasn’t just the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators that were fleeing for their lives. The Foundation Building Tier cultivators and the Core Formation Tier cultivators also started to flee.
As it turned out, they had also encountered a similar situation. The natives were beginning to turn hostile, wanting to snatch their tokens and run out.
The empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, Lin Luo, Zhou Heng... Seeing familiar faces appear one after another, Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. The people around him were all fine.

Everyone reunited, and they were all very happy. That was because those like the empress, Hu Niu, and the others had all advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier. Furthermore, they had reached heights like Four Cauldrons and Five Cauldrons, which could be considered extremely shocking.
In a short while, everyone retreated out of the White Lotus Mystery Realm, and that doorway of light in the skies flashed rapidly a few times. With a xiu, it suddenly disappeared.

“Nine Mountains!” A voice rang out, and a fourth pinnacle level Venerate strode over, shouting at Nine Mountains Venerate, “There is a disciple of your Holy Land, who shot a sneak attack. Hand him over, and I will break one of his arms and legs.”
The Nine Mountains Venerate was a little confused. What was going on here?
He looked at the other, and asked, “Have you taken the wrong medicine?”

“Hmph, you still want to quibble?” The Venerate Tier humphed, and said, “Our Feng Jixing used to be the number one elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier. Now, he’s even advanced into the Core Formation Tier, yet he was defeated by a Cauldron Forging Tier from your Holy Land. If he didn’t use some underhanded means, how could it be possible?”
Yi?
The Nine Mountains Venerate was stunned. He didn’t dare to believe his own ears.
A Cauldron Forging Tier had defeated a Core Formation Tier elite? Moreover, it was a super genius like Feng Jixing?
Who was it, that was so awesome?
He turned around and looked at the disciples of Nine Suns Holy Land, and said with a smile, “Which little guy is so awesome? Hurry up and let me see!”
Right, he had no intention of blaming them at all. Instead, he was filled with pride.
In the past, the Nine Suns Saint was practically invincible in the world. He had been proud all his life, and this kind of bad habit had also been passed down.
Just looking at how the Nine Suns Holy Land only opened its doors once every 10,000 years, recruiting disciples only based on quality, it was clear just how high-spirited the Nine Suns Holy Land was.
This kind of Holy Land had to be extremely protective of their own people.
What? Who was so powerful?
Most people didn’t know the situation, and when they heard the Venerate Tier elite’s words, they were all shocked. Subconsciously, they turned to look at Lu Qi.

However, Lu Qi had long since retreated out of the Mystery Realm, so it naturally couldn’t be him. When he saw everyone look over, he was a little humiliated and angered, yet his eyes turned towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I merely defeated Feng Jixing. There’s nothing to boast about.”
“You?” The Venerate Tier elite looked at Ling Han in disbelief.
Could a Cauldron Forging Tier really defeat a Core Formation Tier elite? Even if he borrowed the power of a precious tool.
“You are a bit strange.” This Venerate Tier elite moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
In this world, there was no Ancestral King to keep watch, and Saints had not appeared. Venerate Tier was the strongest battle prowess, so what was there to be afraid of?
It was naturally impossible for Ling Han to dodge, but how could the Nine Mountains Venerate sit by and watch? Immediately, he delivered a palm strike, “Changfeng, do you take me for a dead person?”
Boom!

The two great Venerate Tier elites only made a casual move, but the terrifying energy surged, tearing apart even the Void. If onewas touched by the aftermath, it was guaranteed that even a Sect Master would die.
Changfeng Venerate frowned slightly, “Nine Mountains, you are protecting your own disciple like this?”
“Tsk, none of your business!” Nine Mountains Venerate was extremely domineering.

“Good!” The disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land all cheered internally, feeling that though this Venerate Tier was a little uncouth, coveting their contribution points to trick them into buying him wine, he was still incredibly forceful when it was time to be forceful.
If Nine Mountains Venerate knew what everyone was thinking, he would definitely glare, and then return to beat up that fat cat.

“Let me ask you. Do you believe that with Cauldron Forging Tier, he could be so strong, defeating a Core Formation Tier elite, and a Core Formation Tier like Feng Jixing at that?” Changfeng Venerate said.
Without waiting for Nine Mountains Venerate to answer, Ling Han immediately said, “Easy, call Feng Jixing over, and I’ll kill him for you to see.”
Interjecting in front of a Venerate Tier elite could be considered extremely disrespectful, which naturally made Changfeng Venerate fly into a thunderous rage.

However, with his status, he naturally wouldn’t argue with a mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator. Instead, he looked at Nine Mountains Venerate and said, “Heh, looks like I’ll have to educate your disciple for you.”
Nine Mountains Venerate humphed, and said, “The disciple of Nine Suns Holy Land is just that domineering. What can you do about it?”
Changfeng Venerateg couldn’t help but feel angry. ‘Is this how you set an example for your disciple?’
To be so arrogant outside, wasn’t he afraid of being beaten to death?
“All right!” Changfeng Venerate humphed, “Jixing, come here, you fight with this boy! Don’t worry, with me by the side, he can forget about using any rare treasure!”
When Feng Jixing heard this, his expression instantly became awkward.

He did indeed say that he had lost to a Cauldron Forging Tier, but Changfeng Venerate immediately imagined it, and thought that Ling Han had only won because of a rare treasure, Talisman Weapon, and most importantly, Feng Jixing wanted to save face, so he didn’t retort.
If he were to battle with Ling Han now, er, wouldn’t that just be seeking his own humiliation?
“What are you standing around for?” Changfeng Venerate rebuked. “With me here, who dares to say that you’re bullying the weak?”
Right, this person’s method of teaching his disciples wasn’t all that impressive either.
Feng Jixing had no choice but to slowly walk over with a constipated expression. He walked as slowly as he could.
However, no matter how slow he walked, he would eventually reach the end.
Ling Han and Feng Jixing stood facing each other. A gentle breeze blew, and even the hem of their clothes fluttered slightly.
Right at this moment, a subtle fluctuation suddenly appeared in space.
Instantly, all the Venerate Tier elites revealed solemn expressions, as they looked towards the skies.

chapters.title: Chapter 3952: Visitors from the Western Heavenly Realm
paragraphs: All the Venerate Tier elites raised their heads to look at the sky. What great matter had happened?
Everyone raised their heads as well. Coincidentally, the space actually split apart, and four people walked out from within.
An old man, along with three young men, appeared in an extremely simple manner.
However, being able to tear a rip into the Void, this kind of strength was too terrifying. It was at least Sect Master-level.

Of course, there were enough Venerate Tier elites here, so naturally, no one was afraid. “Extreme Frost!” Nine Mountains Venerate suddenly muttered through gritted teeth. “Damn it, they have come again!” Changfeng Venerate also frowned.

It was not just the two of them. Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and saw that there was practically not a single Venerate Tier that did not show an expression of disgust. It was as if this old man was a great devil that was wicked beyond redemption, and everyone despised him.

“Hehe, everyone, it’s been a long time!” The old man said calmly as he flew in the sky. Being able to talk and laugh so easily in front of Venerate Tier elites, this guy was definitely at the level of the Venerate Tier.
“Extreme Frost, why have you come to the North Heavenly Realm for?” the Nine Mountains Venerate asked.
The old man in the sky was none other than Extreme Frost Venerate. He chuckled, and said, “What is it? The battle hasn’t even begun, and everyone is already afraid?”
“Ha, what’s there to be afraid of!” Changfeng Venerate sneered, “Western Heavenly Realm won’t produce geniuses generation after generation, and North Heavenly Realm won’t stay silent forever either.”
West Heavenly Realm?
Oh, so this Extreme Frost Venerate had come from the West Heavenly Realm. No wonder he was so disliked.
Ever since the four Heavenly Realms were divided, the competition between the Heavenly Realm had never stopped.
As the saying went, the wheel of fortune turns. Every Heavenly Realm would have times when they were powerful - aside from the North Heavenly Realm.

In the current situation, the South Heavenly Realm was the strongest, followed by the East Heavenly Realm, the West Heavenly Realm was third, and the North Heavenly Realm was the weakest. The label of weakest Heavenly Realm for North Heavenly Realm hadn’t changed for tens of millions of years, and was at the bottom.

This time, it was probably because the West Heavenly Realm had suffered defeat in the competition with the East and South Heavenly Realms. Thus, they had come to the North Heavenly Realm to find confidence.
It was the same every time, and that was why Nine Mountains Venerate, Changfeng Venerate, and the others disliked Extreme Frost Venerate so much.
Extreme Frost Venerate smiled, “Come, let’s have a competition.”

He pointed at a young man and said, “Luo Ziyun, ranked fifth of Foundation Building Tier in our West Heavenly Realm.” He then pointed at the second young man, and said, “Ni Wenbai, ranked third in the Cauldron Forging Tier in West Heavenly Realm.”
Then, he pointed at the last person and said, “Lu Yongchang, ranked fourth in the Core Formation Tier.”

“You see, I didn’t want to bully you guys either. Let the three of them fight in the arena with the kids from the North Heavenly Realm. In a battle of the same cultivation level, whoever wins will be considered a winner.”

Extreme Frost Venerate took out a bottle, played around with it in his hands, and said, “Here, this is Divine Source. I expended some effort to obtain it. Whoever wins, I will gift this bottle of Divine Source to him.”
When the prodigies of the North Heavenly Realm heard this, they were all furious.

That’s right. The overall strength of the North Heavenly Realm was indeed inferior to the West Heavenly Realm, but you brought these people ranked third, fourth and even fifth here; was this an action to humiliate their North Heavenly Realm?
To say nothing else, when Feng Jixing was ranked 12th on the Galaxy Network, he would definitely be able to squeeze into the top three if he were placed in the West Heavenly Realm, right?
Moreover, the North Heavenly Realm was completely capable of fighting in turns. They didn’t believe that the three of them on the opposite side were all made of iron.

“We’ll set a time limit of one day. Anyone can fight; he only has to win a battle.” Extreme Frost Venerate descended with his three juniors. He walked with his hands clasped behind his back, appearing calm and unperturbed. He didn’t take the Venerate Tier elites here seriously at all.

In the past, he had also come on behalf of the West Heavenly Realm. However, at that time, he had only been a Cauldron Forging Tier, and Nine Mountains and Changfeng Venerates had both lost to him. Now that they had all reached Venerate Tier, he still frasped a massive psychological advantage.
Extreme Frost Venerate grabbed at empty air with both hands, and instantly, he had grabbed out three high platforms on the flat ground, which he then stabilized with great power.
Multiple seals flickered.
“Go on!” he said softly.

Luo Ziyun, Ni Wenbai and Lu Yongchang leaped onto a high platform respectively. This naturally was the arena that they would be fighting on. It was reinforced by a Venerate Tier’s great power, and even if a Core Formation Tier cultivator went all out, they would not be able to damage it in the slightest.

“I am Luo Ziyun, and would like to ask for guidance from the Foundation Building Tier friends of the North Heavenly Realm.” Luo Ziyun was tall and slender, and his words were also cultured and refined. He clasped his hands in greeting towards those below the stage.
Meanwhile, Ni Wenbai was much more arrogant. He stood on the platform with his hands clasped behind his back, looking completely condescending.
Meanwhile, Lu Yongchang’s eyes were sleepy, and he looked listless. It was as if he wasn’t some super genius at all.
“Let me experience it!” Immediately, someone leaped onto the “stage”, and began a fierce battle with Luo Ziyun, but in a few moves, he was practically defeated in an instant.
Xiu, another person leaped onto the tournament stage. This time, it was a Cauldron Forging Tier that issued a challenge to Ni Wenbai. In just one move, he was sent off the tournament
stage.

“Those who are too weak should not come up,” Ni Wenbai stated calmly. “Firstly, it would be a waste of time, and secondly, it would not be appropriate for me to control my power for those who are too weak. It would not be good if I killed them.”
This... was too humiliating!
The people of North Heavenly Realm were all enraged, scrambling over each other to fight
fiercely on stage.
However, at least in the two cultivation levels of Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier, the North Heavenly Realm was at a great disadvantage.

Because everyone had just come out of the White Lotus Mystery Realm, the top prodigies had all broken through, such as Feng Jixing. He had once been the number one person in the Cauldron Forging Tier of North Heavenly Realm. However, once he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, would he still be able to rank in the top few of the Core Formation Tier? To say nothing of the first place, even the top 1000 or top 10,000 was impossible.
It couldn’t be helped. His cultivation level was too low.
Thus, even though there were some prodigies who hadn’t broken through yet, they were all ranked below the top 100 on the Galaxy Network. Thus, how could they defeat those ranked in
the top five?
The Venerate Tier elites obviously knew this as well, and thus placed their hopes on the Core Formation Tier elites.

Zhongsun Tiankun, the former top elite of Core Formation Tier of North Heavenly Realm. Of course, he was still the top elite of Core Formation Tier now, because he had not broken through into True Self Tier, but was rather tempering his power to a stronger extent. He was the strongest person in the North Heavenly Realm, so how could it be that he couldn’t compare to the fourth strongest person in the West Heavenly Realm?

In the current situation, prodigies like Feng Jixing and Song Lan were completely unqualified to interfere. Prodigies like Feng Jixing and Song Lan were only at the early stage of Core Formation Tier, so how many Heavens could their battle prowess reach?
Continuously, there would be challengers ascending the martial arts ring, but they would all suffer terrible defeats. The gap was really too wide.
Though this result was within the expectations of the Venerate Tier elites, witnessing a
terrible defeat continuously still made these big shots very displeased.
Finally, Zhongsun Tiankun walked out. His feet stepped on midair, rising step by step, and
walked onto the martial arts ring.
This attracted everyone’s attention.
Ling Han’s interest was also piqued. He wanted to know just how powerful a top-notch Core Formation Tier cultivator was.
“Hehe, finally, an opponent that can make me fight a real battle has come,” Lu Yongchang
said calmly. Though he was facing the strongest in the Core Formation Tier, he did not take
him seriously in the slightest.
Zhongsun Tiankun was also very calm, and said, “You can only go so far.”

“I am Luo Ziyun, and would like to ask for guidance from the Foundation Building Tier friends of the North Heavenly Realm.” Luo Ziyun was tall and slender, and his words were also cultured and refined.
He clasped his hands in greeting towards those below the stage.
Meanwhile, Ni Wenbai was much more arrogant.
He stood on the platform with his hands clasped behind his back, looking completely condescending.
Meanwhile, Lu Yongchang’s eyes were sleepy, and he looked listless.
It was as if he wasn’t some super genius at all.
“Let me experience it!” Immediately, someone leaped onto the “stage”, and began a fierce battle with Luo Ziyun, but in a few moves, he was practically defeated in an instant.
Xiu, another person leaped onto the tournament stage.
This time, it was a Cauldron Forging Tier that issued a challenge to Ni Wenbai.
In just one move, he was sent off the tournament
stage.
“Those who are too weak should not come up,” Ni Wenbai stated calmly.
“Firstly, it would be a waste of time, and secondly, it would not be appropriate for me to control my power for those who are too weak.
It would not be good if I killed them.”
This... was too humiliating!
The people of North Heavenly Realm were all enraged, scrambling over each other to fight
fiercely on stage.
However, at least in the two cultivation levels of Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier, the North Heavenly Realm was at a great disadvantage.
Because everyone had just come out of the White Lotus Mystery Realm, the top prodigies had all broken through, such as Feng Jixing.
He had once been the number one person in the Cauldron Forging Tier of North Heavenly Realm.
However, once he advanced into the Core Formation Tier, would he still be able to rank in the top few of the Core Formation Tier?
To say nothing of the first place, even the top 1000 or top 10,000 was impossible.
It couldn’t be helped.
His cultivation level was too low.
Thus, even though there were some prodigies who hadn’t broken through yet, they were all ranked below the top 100 on the Galaxy Network.
Thus, how could they defeat those ranked in
the top five?
The Venerate Tier elites obviously knew this as well, and thus placed their hopes on the Core Formation Tier elites.
Zhongsun Tiankun, the former top elite of Core Formation Tier of North Heavenly Realm.
Of course, he was still the top elite of Core Formation Tier now, because he had not broken through into True Self Tier, but was rather tempering his power to a stronger extent.
He was the strongest person in the North Heavenly Realm, so how could it be that he couldn’t compare to the fourth strongest person in the West Heavenly Realm?
In the current situation, prodigies like Feng Jixing and Song Lan were completely unqualified to interfere.
Prodigies like Feng Jixing and Song Lan were only at the early stage of Core Formation Tier, so how many Heavens could their battle prowess reach?
Continuously, there would be challengers ascending the martial arts ring, but they would all suffer terrible defeats.
The gap was really too wide.
Though this result was within the expectations of the Venerate Tier elites, witnessing a
terrible defeat continuously still made these big shots very displeased.
Finally, Zhongsun Tiankun walked out.
His feet stepped on midair, rising step by step, and
walked onto the martial arts ring.
This attracted everyone’s attention.
Ling Han’s interest was also piqued.
He wanted to know just how powerful a top-notch Core Formation Tier cultivator was.
“Hehe, finally, an opponent that can make me fight a real battle has come,” Lu Yongchang
said calmly.
Though he was facing the strongest in the Core Formation Tier, he did not take
him seriously in the slightest.
Zhongsun Tiankun was also very calm, and said, “You can only go so far.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3953: Ling Han moves
paragraphs: Zhongsun Tiankun strode towards Lu Yongchang. Boom, he did not restrain his aura at all, which turned into raging waves.
Even at such a far distance, Ling Han could still clearly sense just how powerful this aura was. It made his hair stand on end.
Strong, he was really strong.
Ling Han made a comparison. Zhongsun Tiankun’s battle prowess was at least Fifteenth Heaven, or even stronger.

As expected, a martial artist like Feng Shaolin who had reached consummate level of Core Formation Tier could not be considered the strongest battle prowess of a martial artist in Core Formation Tier at all. For example, Zhongsun Tiankun easily reached Fifteenth Heaven, and this should not be his strongest battle prowess yet.
“Interesting,” Lu Yongchang stated calmly. He had finally gotten serious. Boom, a terrifying aura surged out of his body, like a wide river, like a great river, rolling out like the tides.
Boom! Their auras collided, and it could actually be seen that their auras had solidified. One was black, while the other was white, and they were fiercely resisting each other.
It was hard to determine the victor.

“Interesting, truly interesting.” Lu Yongchang nodded. “After all, he’s the number one elite in the Core Formation Tier of North Heavenly Realm. I can’t underestimate him too much. Fine, then I’ll have to show some of my abilities.”

He let out a battle cry, and his aura actually increased greatly in an inconceivable manner. Zhongsun Tiankun’s expression changed drastically. Though aura could not completely represent battle prowess, it could indeed explain a great many things.
In terms of aura, he was being suppressed by his opponent.
“Heavenly Wind Palm!” Zhongsun Tiankun took the initiative to attack, his aura having been suppressed. If he still did not regain the initiative, he would be completely suppressed by his opponent.

“Heh, Saint Technique from the very beginning. You’re really going all out,” Lu Yongchang said calmly. He also used a Saint Technique, clashing with Zhongsun Tiankun. In terms of aura, he was not the slightest bit inferior.
Boom!
The two top-notch prodigies exchanged blows, incredibly intense.

After a short while, the expressions of those Venerate Tier elites from the North Heavenly Realm became solemn. With their insight, they naturally could see clearly that Zhongsun Tiankun had already fallen into a disadvantage, and going by the progress of things, he would be defeated in less than a hundred moves.
If the person who had the greatest chance of winning was about to lose, who else would be able to defeat these three people from the West Heavenly Realm?

It should be known that these three people in fact weren’t the top of three cultivation levels of the West Heavenly Realm. However, they could still completely defeat the North Heavenly Realm. This was a great humiliation.
Zhongsun Tiankun clearly knew that he was in a disadvantageous position. He channelled powerful secret techniques one after another, wanting to turn the tables, but it was completely useless.
Lu Yongchang continued to control the situation on the field, and slowly turned his advantage into victory.
After a hundred moves, Zhongsun Tiankun was defeated.
He was only a little bit weaker than Lu Yongchang, but for such elites, this little bit of gap was completely enough to decide the outcome of the battle.
There was no excuse for this loss. He was completely inferior in terms of abilities.
“So this is the number one elite of the Core Formation Tier of North Heavenly Realm?” Lu Yongchang shook his head, “And here I thought there was something impressive about him. He’s only so-so.”
These words were too much. He had only won by a small margin, and had not crushed his opponent completely. But who asked him to win?
Moreover, the number one elite of the North Heavenly Realm was defeated by one who was ranked fourth, so what excuse was there left to make?
All of a sudden, the morale on the side of the North Heavenly Realm dropped drastically.
Even Zhongsun Tiankun had lost, so who else could win back some face for the North Heavenly Realm?

“Haha, Nine Mountains, Changfeng, Guxue...” Extreme Frost Venerate extended a finger and pointed at the various big shots, then shook his head, “Ai, the North Heavenly Realm is still so weak. To think that I had your best interests, and only brought Yongning and the others. If it was those top elites of Foundation Building Tier, Cauldron Forging Tier of our West Heavenly Realm, would your juniors here be able to block even one move?”
This mockery was practically attracting animosity from all corners of the world.
Nine Mountains Venerate and the other elites all wore ugly expressions. However, what could they do when their skills were inferior?

Since ten million years ago, the North Heavenly Realm’s fortune was completely outmatched by the other great Heavenly Realms, and could not produce any supreme prodigies. The number of their top grade elites were also fewer. and lower in quality. This was a fact.
If they attacked together, they could kill Extreme Frost Venerate, of course, but this was a battle between two great Heavenly Realms, so what meaning was there for them to win with
numbers?
They definitely had to win fair and square.
“Sigh, looks like no one can win this Divine Source.” Extreme Frost Venerate shook his head,
his eyes sweeping over everyone, filled with mockery.
This was indeed the truth. He had come to ridicule the entire North Heavenly Realm.
The Venerate Tier elites were all clenching their fists, extremely furious.
“Haoyue, do you have the confidence to defeat Luo Ziyun?”
“Ziqing, if you battle with Ni Wenbai, do you have a chance of winning?”

The elders were all secretly communicating with their clansmen or sects’ proud disciples through divine sense, but those prodigies all shook their heads slightly. They were indeed elites in the North Heavenly Realm, but in front of prodigies on the level of Luo Ziyun and Ni Wenbai, they were completely inadequate.
There was even less need to mention Lu Yongchang. Even Zhongsun Tiankun had lost, so there was naturally no one that could match him in the North Heavenly Realm.
The more time passed, the more awkward the atmosphere became.
Ling Han sighed. These big shots were really stingy. He had initially wanted to see if any Venerate Tier would increase the stakes, and say that whoever won would be rewarded, but
actually, not one of them spoke up.
Forget it, then he’ll just win a bottle of Divine Source.
With a leap, he had already arrived on the tournament stage. His opponent was naturally Ni
Wenbai.
Ling Han finally made his move.

Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven, Nangong Hao and the others were all filled with anticipation. They had all advanced into the level of Core Formation Tier, so it was impossible for them to battle against Ni Wenbai. Moreover, compared to Lu Yongchang, their cultivation levels were far too inferior, so they could only feel anxious.
“Who are you?” Ni Wenbai asked, his tone casual.
“The person who will defeat you,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Haha, those people said that before, but what happened?” Ni Wenbai shook his head, appearing extremely disdainful.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I am very strong.”
“It’s useless.” This time, Ni Wenbai did not shake his head. Instead, he wagged a finger, “In
front of me, any prodigy would show their true colors. They are only slightly stronger than
ordinary people.”
Ling Han clicked his tongue, and said, “Indeed, I’ve already experienced your verbal prowess.
I’m ashamed of my inferiority.”
“Hehe, the fact that you can talk to me for so long is already enough for you to boast about for your whole life,” Ni Wenbai said coldly. He sent out a palm strike towards Ling Han.
How could such a minor character be qualified to stand in front of him?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and tapped out a finger.

Pu, Ni Wenbai’s attack was instantly annihilated, and Ling Han’s finger force swept over, pushing Ni Wenbai backwards. He forcefully retreated to the side of the tournament stage, and only then did he manage to forcefully stop himself.
Instantly, the whole area fell silent.
This was too exaggerated, wasn’t it? Who didn’t know Ni Wenbai’s strength? However, Ling
Han had merely flicked out a finger, and not only had it dispersed his attack, it had even sent him flying to the side of the tournament stage. This was practically exaggerated to the
extreme.
However, after a moment of shock, everyone became excited.
This, there was hope of victory.
Nine Mountains Venerate and the other elites were also energized. They could finally hold
their heads high.

chapters.title: Chapter 3954: Ten moves
paragraphs: “En?” Ni Wenbai showed a hint of surprise. He had completely misjudged Ling Han’s battle
prowess.
‘So powerful!’
“Who are you?” he asked seriously.
Ling Han flicked his sleeves and said calmly, “Ling Han.”
This show-off.

Ni Wenbai instantly felt an urge to smack Ling Han. However, Ling Han’s finger had indeed frightened him. He frowned slightly, and said, “Ling Han? But in the top twenty Cauldron Forging Tiers of the Galaxy Network, you are not there.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “My ranking is around 10,000.”
When these words fell, everyone wanted to give Ling Han the middle finger. ‘You are really too f good at showing off.’

Especially Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven and the others. They had seen how Ling Han forced Feng Jixing to burst his token with their own eyes. Ling Han had even forced a consummate level elite of the Core Formation Tier to self-explode his Celestial Core. This strength was definitely top of Cauldron Forging Tier.
-In the entire universe.
Over 10,000? He really wanted to complain. Aren’t you f embarrassed?
Ni Wenbai was slightly dumbfounded. Over 10,000? What was going on here? The people of North Heavenly Realm were all so strong, that someone in the 10,000s was actually this powerful?
However, he immediately came to his senses. This wasn’t because the North Heavenly Realm had suddenly exploded in power, but rather because a freak like Ling Han had suddenly appeared.
“Heh, regardless of whether you’re ranked 10,000th or number one, you’ll ultimately suffer a defeat before me,” Ni Wenbai said in a calm voice. His confidence soared.
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, and said with a smile, “Come.”
Ni Wenbai strode towards Ling Han. Boom, the aura all over his body surged, and leaped up another level.
Ling Han nodded internally. Though this guy was also Nine Cauldrons, his abilities were considerably stronger than Feng Jixing back then.
Unfortunately, he had not even reached Ten Cauldrons, so how could he be a match for him?
He smiled and said, “Not bad, you are slightly more powerful than Feng Jixing back then. However, that’s about it.”
‘F*ck! I’m innocent!’
Feng Jixing’s expression instantly darkened. ‘F*ck! So be it if you want to fight. Why are you dragging me into this?’
“Feng Jixing?” Ni Wenbai laughed loudly, “This kind of character is not worthy of my notice.”
If it wasn’t for the fact that he had absolute confidence in defeating Feng Jixing, how could he have become a representative of Cauldron Forging Tier?
F***, it was another shot.
Feng Jixing’s expression was already as dark as an iron pot. He really wanted to rush over and smack Ling Han and Ni Wenbai to death.
He, the former mighty number one Cauldron Forging Tier of the North Heavenly Realm, had actually become nothing more than a background. Just any random person was going to use him as comparison?
“If you can survive ten moves from me, I’ll consider it your win,” Ling Han said calmly.
Ni Wenbai’s expression darkened. Ten moves?
Are you joking?
“Hahaha!” Extreme Frost Venerate laughed loudly. He did not have any reservations at all, “What a joke. You want to defeat Wenbai in ten moves?”
Ling Han looked over, “Do you want to make a bet?”
Extreme Frost Venerate was taken aback. This brat was truly outrageously bold. A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually dared to speak frankly with him, and was not the slightest bit afraid?

With a flutter of his sleeve, he couldn’t be bothered to pay attention to Ling Han. Otherwise, it would be too demeaning of him to actually lower himself to the level of a Cauldron Forging Tier junior.
Sigh, Ling Han sighed. He had feigned for so long just to arouse Extreme Frost Venerate’s pride. Shouldn’t he take out another bottle of Divine Source, or an equally valuable treasure?
Unfortunately, the old geezer was too petty.

“You are really outrageously bold, to actually dare speak in this manner to Lord Extreme Frost!” Ni Wenbai said coldly. Extreme Frost Venerate was a Venerate Tier that was well- known in the Western Heaven Realm, and had hopes of becoming a Saint.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Come, ten moves. After that, you win!”
Ni Wenbai was beside himself with rage. With a tap of his foot, he instantly shot toward Ling Han at a breakneck speed.
He was really extraordinary. He seemed to have turned into a streak of light, and was astonishingly fast.
Ling Han acted as if he didn’t notice, and allowed his opponent’s attack to land.
This caused everyone to be dumbfounded. Weren’t you f arrogant to the extreme just now? How did you get hit with the first move?
This was too humiliating.

Extreme Frost Venerate shook his head. At first, he had thought that this brat had some abilities, but he had never thought that he was actually this kind of character. He had really overestimated him.
“Even a single move from me-” Ni Wenbai was presently feeling proud, yet his eyes suddenly almost popped out of their sockets.
That was because Ling Han was presently looking at him, and even blinked his eyes.
F-freak!

Ni Wenbai almost exclaimed in shock. He had seen a ghost. Though he had not used his strongest technique in this blow, he had still used a Venerate Tier-level Technique. The might of this blow was incredibly terrifying. Who would have expected that not only had Ling Han suffered it completely head-on, he was completely unscathed?
This was too strange. How could such a thing happen?
Not only was he stunned, the others were also dumbfounded. They could not believe their eyes at all.
“Is he wearing some kind of super armor?”
“Probably. Otherwise, how could he have sustained such a powerful blow from Ni Wenbai?”
“That doesn’t count as his strength, right?”
Everyone whispered among themselves. Though everyone hoped that Ling Han would win, if he relied on his precious tool, that would be an unjust victory.
This was a battle between the elites of the two Heavenly Realms, not enemies meeting on a narrow path, when it was necessary for one of them to survive.
However, none of the Venerable Tier elites spoke. They merely wore solemn expressions, and the gazes they directed at Ling Han were filled with curiosity.

With their insight, they naturally could tell that Ling Han had not used his precious tool, and had completely relied on his own strength to take that blow from Ni Wenbai head-on. It was precisely because of this that they were all stunned.
Was this brat a monster?
“The first move,” Ling Han said calmly.
Ni Wenbai faltered for a moment before gritting his teeth and unleashing his second attack at
Ling Han.
Peng!
This palm strike landed on Ling Han, and not a single bit of power missed its target.
However, Ling Han cracked a smile, and was still completely unscathed, “Second move.”
Ling Han clearly didn’t counterattack, but Ni Wenbai felt a coldness rise up from the bottom
of his heart.
He had never encountered such an opponent before. He allowed him to attack him without fighting back, and was still alive and kicking.
He refused to believe this!
Ni Wenbai roared loudly, and delivered the third strike.
This time, he went all out, channeling out the Saint Technique.
Boom, his attack landed, and there was not the slightest bit of sluggishness. He delivered
another attack, and it was still the Saint Technique. There were a total of seven styles, and he could deliver them continuously. Furthermore, every style had a boost, and the might of each
style was stronger than the last.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!
Seven consecutive moves sounded like a drum.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was still counting, “The third move, the fourth move... the ninth
move!”

Ni Wenbai’s seven moves of the Saint Technique blasted over. This was his strongest burst of power. After seven moves, he had no choice but to stop. The Saint Technique was extremely powerful, and the burden on him was also astonishingly heavy. Even with his strength, he had no choice but to slow down slightly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “There is still one more move. It’s my turn now.”
He didn’t use any powerful moves. He simply threw a simple punch, but with the boost of
terrifying power, it was more kickass than any technique.
Peng!
A punch landed, and Ni Wenbai fell off the tournament stage.
Pa, he fell heavily onto the ground, and was actually knocked out directly.
All of a sudden, the whole area was silent, but after only an instant, cheers exploded again,
like thunder.

Unfortunately, he had not even reached Ten Cauldrons, so how could he be a match for him?
He smiled and said, “Not bad, you are slightly more powerful than Feng Jixing back then.
However, that’s about it.”
‘F*ck!
I’m innocent!’
Feng Jixing’s expression instantly darkened.
‘F*ck!
So be it if you want to fight.
Why are you dragging me into this?’
“Feng Jixing?” Ni Wenbai laughed loudly, “This kind of character is not worthy of my notice.”
If it wasn’t for the fact that he had absolute confidence in defeating Feng Jixing, how could he have become a representative of Cauldron Forging Tier?
F***, it was another shot.
Feng Jixing’s expression was already as dark as an iron pot.
He really wanted to rush over and smack Ling Han and Ni Wenbai to death.
He, the former mighty number one Cauldron Forging Tier of the North Heavenly Realm, had actually become nothing more than a background.
Just any random person was going to use him as comparison?
“If you can survive ten moves from me, I’ll consider it your win,” Ling Han said calmly.
Ni Wenbai’s expression darkened.
Ten moves?
Are you joking?
“Hahaha!” Extreme Frost Venerate laughed loudly.
He did not have any reservations at all, “What a joke.
You want to defeat Wenbai in ten moves?”
Ling Han looked over, “Do you want to make a bet?”
Extreme Frost Venerate was taken aback.
This brat was truly outrageously bold.
A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator actually dared to speak frankly with him, and was not the slightest bit afraid?
With a flutter of his sleeve, he couldn’t be bothered to pay attention to Ling Han.
Otherwise, it would be too demeaning of him to actually lower himself to the level of a Cauldron Forging Tier junior.
Sigh, Ling Han sighed.
He had feigned for so long just to arouse Extreme Frost Venerate’s pride.
Shouldn’t he take out another bottle of Divine Source, or an equally valuable treasure?
Unfortunately, the old geezer was too petty.
“You are really outrageously bold, to actually dare speak in this manner to Lord Extreme Frost!” Ni Wenbai said coldly.
Extreme Frost Venerate was a Venerate Tier that was well- known in the Western Heaven Realm, and had hopes of becoming a Saint.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Come, ten moves.
After that, you win!”
Ni Wenbai was beside himself with rage.
With a tap of his foot, he instantly shot toward Ling Han at a breakneck speed.
He was really extraordinary.
He seemed to have turned into a streak of light, and was astonishingly fast.
Ling Han acted as if he didn’t notice, and allowed his opponent’s attack to land.
This caused everyone to be dumbfounded.
Weren’t you f arrogant to the extreme just now?
How did you get hit with the first move?
This was too humiliating.
Extreme Frost Venerate shook his head.
At first, he had thought that this brat had some abilities, but he had never thought that he was actually this kind of character.
He had really overestimated him.
“Even a single move from me-” Ni Wenbai was presently feeling proud, yet his eyes suddenly almost popped out of their sockets.
That was because Ling Han was presently looking at him, and even blinked his eyes.
F-freak!
Ni Wenbai almost exclaimed in shock.
He had seen a ghost.
Though he had not used his strongest technique in this blow, he had still used a Venerate Tier-level Technique.
The might of this blow was incredibly terrifying.
Who would have expected that not only had Ling Han suffered it completely head-on, he was completely unscathed?
This was too strange.
How could such a thing happen?
Not only was he stunned, the others were also dumbfounded.
They could not believe their eyes at all.
“Is he wearing some kind of super armor?”
“Probably.
Otherwise, how could he have sustained such a powerful blow from Ni Wenbai?”
“That doesn’t count as his strength, right?”
Everyone whispered among themselves.
Though everyone hoped that Ling Han would win, if he relied on his precious tool, that would be an unjust victory.
This was a battle between the elites of the two Heavenly Realms, not enemies meeting on a narrow path, when it was necessary for one of them to survive.
However, none of the Venerable Tier elites spoke.
They merely wore solemn expressions, and the gazes they directed at Ling Han were filled with curiosity.
With their insight, they naturally could tell that Ling Han had not used his precious tool, and had completely relied on his own strength to take that blow from Ni Wenbai head-on.
It was precisely because of this that they were all stunned.
Was this brat a monster?
“The first move,” Ling Han said calmly.
Ni Wenbai faltered for a moment before gritting his teeth and unleashing his second attack at
Ling Han.
Peng!
This palm strike landed on Ling Han, and not a single bit of power missed its target.
However, Ling Han cracked a smile, and was still completely unscathed, “Second move.”
Ling Han clearly didn’t counterattack, but Ni Wenbai felt a coldness rise up from the bottom
of his heart.
He had never encountered such an opponent before.
He allowed him to attack him without fighting back, and was still alive and kicking.
He refused to believe this!
Ni Wenbai roared loudly, and delivered the third strike.
This time, he went all out, channeling out the Saint Technique.
Boom, his attack landed, and there was not the slightest bit of sluggishness.
He delivered
another attack, and it was still the Saint Technique.
There were a total of seven styles, and he could deliver them continuously.
Furthermore, every style had a boost, and the might of each
style was stronger than the last.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Seven consecutive moves sounded like a drum.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was still counting, “The third move, the fourth move... the ninth
move!”
Ni Wenbai’s seven moves of the Saint Technique blasted over.
This was his strongest burst of power.
After seven moves, he had no choice but to stop.
The Saint Technique was extremely powerful, and the burden on him was also astonishingly heavy.
Even with his strength, he had no choice but to slow down slightly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “There is still one more move.
It’s my turn now.”
He didn’t use any powerful moves.
He simply threw a simple punch, but with the boost of
terrifying power, it was more kickass than any technique.
Peng!
A punch landed, and Ni Wenbai fell off the tournament stage.
Pa, he fell heavily onto the ground, and was actually knocked out directly.
All of a sudden, the whole area was silent, but after only an instant, cheers exploded again,
like thunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 3955 Invincible might
paragraphs: This was too satisfying. This was really too satisfying.
Previously, the North Heaven Heavenly Realm competed with the other three great Heavenly Realms, and had never won, no matter what cultivation level they had competed on.
The young prodigies were inferior, and the elites of the older generation were also inferior. They were always at the bottom, and the gap between them was still extraordinarily wide.

For example, this time, the strength of West Heavenly Realm was only ranked third among the four Heavenly Realms, but merely sending out people ranked third, fourth and fifth in the various cultivation levels was enough to crush the North Heavenly Realm.
The gulf between them was clear for all to see.

Right until now, when Ling Han had aggressively appeared, allowing Ni Wenbai to deliver nine consecutive blows without sustaining any injury. With just another punch, he had knocked Ni Wenbai off the tournament stage. This was a completely one-sided suppression of strength.
“Ling Han!”
“Ling Han!”
“Ling Han!”

Everyone was cheering Ling Han’s name loudly. Even those who had previously been on bad terms with Ling Han were cheering for Ling Han now. This kind of exaltation, this kind of sense of collective glory had transcended narrow-minded personal grievances.
“Hiss, so Brother Ling is actually this strong!”
“Then how strong is Brother Ling’s Big Brother, the benevolent and unparalleled Li Zisuan?”
“He would probably be able to kill Ni Wenbai with a single thought.”

Those who had previously come into contact with Ling Han and Li Zisuan in the desert were all whispering among themselves, but these words were heard by Lu Qi. However, he did not know how to complain, because Li Zisuan had simply been boasting.

“Humph!” Lu Yongchang took a step forward, and crossed over from another tournament stage. “There can’t possibly be such a powerful Cauldron Forging Tier in this world. You must be a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and deliberately pretend to be a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.”

En, if a Core Formation Tier cultivator faced off against a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, then even if Ni Wenbai was a supreme prodigy, it would be very normal for him to be defeated by Ling Han in a single move.
As for the Cauldron Forging Tier aura that Ling Han was exuding?
Hehe, wasn’t it known that there were some secret techniques could change the aura of cultivators?
Extreme Frost Venerate also couldn’t help but feel suspicious.

He indeed couldn’t see through Ling Han’s “flaws”. This was a Cauldron Forging Tier, but to convince him that this Cauldron Forging Tier was strong enough to send Ni Wenbai flying with a single punch was truly a bit of a fantasy story.

It was not just him. Even Nine Mountains and Changfeng Venerates were suspicious, especially Changfeng Venerate. Previously, he did not believe that Ling Han could defeat Feng Jixing who was in Core Formation Tier.
“Hehe, then show me the Celestial Cauldron. Everything will be clear then,” Extreme Frost Venerate said calmly.
This was the best way to prove oneself.

A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivated the Celestial Cauldron, and the Core Formation Tier cultivated the Celestial Core. It was completely different—even if the Core Formation Tier was at the early stage, and twas at the stage of nurturing the Celestial Core, it would be very easy to distinguish, because the Celestial Core was inside the cauldron, and it could not possibly be hidden.
Ling Han deliberately changed his expression, revealing an expression of pride, “I won with my abilities, so why are you doubting me?”
“Don’t you think that victory is too inconceivable?” Lu Yongchang asked balefully.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “There are two reasons. Firstly, I am too strong, and secondly, he is too weak.”
F***, he was still showing off.
Extreme Frost Venerate sneered, “Changfeng, Han Yue, Nine Mountains, you guys have really disappointed me. Are you sore losers?”
Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but feel speechless. Did this brat have a taste for money? Why did he keep mentioning compensation and stakes?

These words were harsh. If Extreme Frost Venerate widely publicized in the universe that the North Heavenly Realm were sore losers, having a Core Formation Tier pose as a Cauldron Forging Tier to defeat the Cauldron Forging Tier of the West Heavenly Realm, this would make the martial artists of North Heavenly Realm be unable to raise their heads ever again.
Of course, they couldn’t touch this dirty water.
Nine Mountains Venerate looked towards Ling Han, and said, “Since that’s the case, show the Celestial Cauldron to everyone.”
Ling Han pretended to hesitate, and said, “Sure, but if it is proven that I’ve been wronged, how are you going to compensate me?”
This was his true motive.
Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t help but feel speechless. Did this brat have a taste for money? Why did he keep mentioning compensation and stakes?
Only the large black dog was overjoyed. This was his true brother.

Extreme Frost Venerate didn’t want to waste time, and said with a wave of his hand, “All right, if it’s proven that you’re really Cauldron Forging Tier, I’ll compensate you with a celestial technique.”
“What level?” Ling Han asked. “It has to be Saint Tier, at least. Otherwise, I don’t want it.”
Everyone’s expressions were strange. F***, they had really never seen such an outrageously bold person, to actually bargain with a Venerate Tier elite.
Extreme Frost Venerate almost burst into laughter in his fury. Saint Technique?

Just how valuable was the Saint Technique? Which Holy Land didn’t view it as the highest level inheritance? Only the most core disciple could learn it. Yet, the moment you opened your mouth, you actually dared to ask for a Saint Technique. You really didn’t hold back.
He thought for a moment, took out a bottle of alchemical pills, and said, “This is the Minor Nine Suns Pill. Under the Venerate Tier, no matter how serious the injury, it can immediately heal.”
When everyone heard this, their eyes lit up.
This was a good thing. With this thing, it was equivalent to having an additional life.
Ling Han was also delighted. He had finally squeezed out something. His hard work had not been in vain.
“Er, do you have the pill recipe as a freebie with it?” he asked shamelessly.

Extreme Frost Venerate almost wanted to rush up and slap him. He suddenly waved his hand, and said, “No!” His face was completely dark. He had seen shameless people before, but he was so shameless that he was rendered speechless.
Meanwhile, the others could only feel admiration. This was a Venerate Tier elite! Who wouldn’t hold their breath upon seeing him? That they wouldn’t even dare to breathe loudly?
However, Ling Han actually dared to bargain. How could they not be impressed?
“Alright, hurry up and show the Celestial Cauldron,” Extreme Frost Venerate urged. He felt like he was about to become a joke.
Ling Han chuckled. He finally summoned his Celestial Cauldron.
Weng, the primitive aura spread out in all directions, as if it was boundless.

Ni Wenbai bore the brunt of it. He had just woken up, but when he was struck by this aura, he immediately fell to his knees with a ‘pa’. His knees landed solidly on the ground, and with a ‘peng’, the sound could be clearly heard.

It was not just him. With the high platform that Ling Han was standing on as the centre, circles of Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators involuntarily knelt down. It was only when they were three thousand meters away that the people there could barely control themselves. However, their hearts and spirits were still trembling, and they could not control themselves.

If even the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was like this, then it was naturally even more unbearable for Foundation Building Tiers. They were all prostrating on the ground, as if they were worshipping their emperor.
Right now, only those at the Core Formation Tier could remain standing within 3000 meters.
A gentle breeze blew, and the entire area was silent.

Song Lan, Prosperous Heaven, Jie Yingqiu and other great beauties all bore captivated expressions. No matter how proud and lofty they were, seeing how Ling Han was being worshipped by the masses like a young Great Emperor, at least for this moment, their hearts had melted.
If Ling Han walked over to kiss them now, they would definitely welcome him warmly.

Lu Qi, Feng Jixing, and the others all showed expressions of jealousy and hatred. They too had once been the most famous prodigy of the North Heavenly Realm. They had high hopes placed on them, and were revered as idols by countless cultivators of the same cultivation level.
But now, in front of Ling Han’s brilliance, they paled in colour.
Now, there was only one person left in everyone’s eyes. He stood proudly, as if he was the center of the world, as if he was a dazzling Great Emperor.

The more time passed, the more terrified and reverent those kneeling on the ground became. Sweat dripped down their foreheads like streams, and obedience rose from the bottoms of their hearts and bones.

chapters.title: Chapter 3956: Legend of Fusing Cauldrons
paragraphs: Extreme Frost Venerate’s expression changed drastically.
Had he seen a young Great Emperor?
In fact, he was even wondering could even the Ancestral King possess such might when he was young?
Wasn’t it said that North Heavenly Realm’s fortune had fallen, and supreme prodigies could no longer appear?
Then what was going on with Ling Han?

By now, he was already 99% sure that Ling Han was a Cauldron Forging Tier. However, since he had already started, he naturally could not delay things any longer. He said, “Turn over the Celestial Cauldron.”

Having the Celestial Cauldron didn’t mean that this was definitely a Cauldron Forging Tier. This was because the early stage of the Core Formation Tier also had the Celestial Cauldron, which was used to nurture the Celestial Core.
Ling Han turned the Celestial Cauldron over. It was completely empty inside, aside from a streak of divine light of lightning.
Needless to say, every Venerate Tier elite only had to take a look, and they would know that it was the celestial light that had been refined.
“What about the other Celestial Cauldrons?” Extreme Frost Venerate asked.
Even the most ordinary Core Formation Tier cultivator could reach three Celestial Cauldrons. In that case, he could completely take out a “useless” Celestial Cauldron to show others.
Ling Han shook his head, “I have only one Celestial Cauldron.”
Haha, who would believe that? Who was he kidding!
You are so strong, and you actually only have a single Celestial Cauldron? Then when you reach Seven Cauldrons and Eight Cauldrons, wouldn’t you be able to insta-kill all Core Formation Tiers?
“Ha! Ha!” Lu Yongchang laughed, expressing his disbelief.
Ling Han stowed the Celestial Cauldron away, and smiled faintly, “What are you laughing at? When I advance into the Core Formation Tier, do you believe that I will beat you up?”
Lu Yongchang humphed, “Continue the lie!”
He was clearly a Core Formation Tier cultivator, yet he still wanted to pretend to be a Cauldron Forging Formation Tier cultivator.
He waited for Extreme Frost Venerate to flip out, and angrily rebuke Ling Han for being a conman. However, he still didn’t hear Extreme Frost Venerate’s voice.
Yi?
He turned his head, and looked towards the Extreme Frost Venerate. There was a hint of shock and disbelief on his face.
What was going on?
He turned to look at the other Venerate Tier elites, and saw that they were more or less the same, looking as if they had seen a ghost.
F***, what in the world was going on here?
“Could it be that this is the legendary Fusion Cauldron?” Finally, a Venerate Tier spoke up.
“Shatter all the Celestial Cauldrons and fuse them together to forge a supreme Celestial Cauldron, crushing everything!” Another Venerate Tier elite said.

“The more Celestial Cauldrons there are, the higher the quality of this Celestial Cauldron. Even a bronze cauldron can surpass Nine Coloured Glass Cauldrons and the like, and become the strongest Celestial Cauldron in the world.”
“That’s the only explanation.”
“Look at that brat’s Celestial Cauldron. It has patterns like True Dragon, Divine Phoenix, and so on. Only by fusing the cauldrons can it be explained.”
“Heavens, this only exists in legends. I never thought that it would actually appear!”
“No wonder this brat is so strong!”
“Combining the cauldrons is not much different from advancing into the Core Formation Tier.”

All the Venerate Tier elites shook their heads and nodded at the same time. They finally knew why Ling Han was so powerful, but at the same time, they found it somewhat hard to accept that such a prodigy would actually appear in front of them alive.
What!
When the others heard this, they all felt their scalps go numb.
Fusion Cauldron?
The Celestial Cauldrons could actually be fused? They had never heard of it before!

“Of course. Fusing the cauldrons is too dangerous, and no matter how prodigious the prodigies are, they would not be able to do it, unless they use the means of the Great Emperor!” A Venerate Tier said, “Only the super genius of the Imperial Clan would be qualified to use the Imperial Weapon to help fuse the cauldrons, but the chances of success would also be pitifully small!”

No wonder, though there were heirs of Imperial Clans here, such as Lin Qi, he came from a side branch. Strictly speaking, he was not a true heir of the Imperial Clan. He only had a slight bloodline of the Great Emperor, and had not grasped the Imperial Technique at all.

He was the descendant of a Great Emperor, transcendent above all else, and was not subject to the division of power of the four Heavenly Realms. He did not feel any sense of honour or humiliation about this.

Realization dawned on everyone. No wonder they had never heard of this kind of legend. That was because so what if they knew? What Imperial Clan would take out an Imperial Weapon to help you create a Fusion Cauldron?
That’s not right!
Everyone turned to look at Ling Han. This guy had been in the White Lotus Mystery Realm all this while, so how had he fused his cauldrons?
“It must be Pseudo-Emperor Doga!” someone exclaimed in shock.

Even more people chimed in, adding that Buddha Doga had once struck three streaks of celestial light into Ling Han’s body. Then, taking advantage of this opportunity, it was not impossible to help Ling Han fuse the cauldrons again.
So that was the case.
Hearing this “explanation”, those Venerate Tier elites also came to a realization. As it turned
out, it was a Pseudo Emperor that had moved.
Ling Han had absolutely no intention of explaining. Sometimes, it was necessary to hide
one’s strength.
Only now did he know that he was not the only one who could fuse the cauldrons. As it turned out, the prodigies of the Imperial Clan could do the same.
However, ten cauldrons becoming one was a Fusion Cauldron, and eight cauldrons becoming one was also a Fusion Cauldron, so how could the significance be the same?

Ling Han still firmly believed that, with how he had almost died just to fuse Ten Cauldrons into one, even if this kind of accomplishment was not unprecedented, there were only a rare few that could match him in this era.
Those Cauldron Forging Tiers, and Core Formation Tiers were all dying of jealousy. Why was
it Ling Han?
If they could get help from Buddha Doga, and fuse the cauldrons together, they would definitely be able to stand tall on the platform and look down on all life like Ling Han.
Extreme Frost Venerate was rendered speechless. With a wave of his hand, shua, the two bottles flew towards Ling Han.
There were many Venerate Tier elites here, so he didn’t do anything. The two bottles automatically slowed down when they flew in front of Ling Han, so he could easily grasp
them.

As expected, when he saw how humble Ling Han was, Extreme Frost Venerate instantly forgot about Ling Han’s previous minor disrespect. After all, this young man was too prodigious, capable of matching the prodigies of the Imperial Clan.
A thought flashed through his mind, and he asked, “Brat, are you interested in coming to our
Western Heavenly Realm?”
When these words fell, it instantly enraged all the Venerate Tier elites here.
“Extreme Frost, are you done yet?”
“You’ve gone too far by coming here to poach people!”
“A loss is a loss. You can leave now.”
Extreme Frost Venerate naturally knew that it was impossible to poach Ling Han. He was only
saying this to provoke the North Heavenly Realm’s people. After all, he had lost a bet, so no matter what, he had to give the North Heavenly Realm’s people some trouble.

“Everyone, you have won once for the time being. However, there is no shortage of prodigies in the Western Heaven Realm. We will come again!” He laughed loudly, and with a wave of his hand, tore a rip into the Void, leaving directly with Ni Wenbai and the others.
They had won! Everyone was stunned for a moment, then cheered in unison.
In the competition with the elites of the other three Heavenly Realms, they had never won
before. Now that Ling Han had won beautifully, it was as if he had pumped them full of adrenaline. Even those Venerate Tier elites showed a faint smile.

trying to poach him.

Had he seen a young Great Emperor?
In fact, he was even wondering could even the Ancestral King possess such might when he was young?
Wasn’t it said that North Heavenly Realm’s fortune had fallen, and supreme prodigies could no longer appear?
Then what was going on with Ling Han?
By now, he was already 99% sure that Ling Han was a Cauldron Forging Tier.
However, since he had already started, he naturally could not delay things any longer.
He said, “Turn over the Celestial Cauldron.”
Having the Celestial Cauldron didn’t mean that this was definitely a Cauldron Forging Tier.
This was because the early stage of the Core Formation Tier also had the Celestial Cauldron, which was used to nurture the Celestial Core.
Ling Han turned the Celestial Cauldron over.
It was completely empty inside, aside from a streak of divine light of lightning.
Needless to say, every Venerate Tier elite only had to take a look, and they would know that it was the celestial light that had been refined.
“What about the other Celestial Cauldrons?” Extreme Frost Venerate asked.
Even the most ordinary Core Formation Tier cultivator could reach three Celestial Cauldrons.
In that case, he could completely take out a “useless” Celestial Cauldron to show others.
Ling Han shook his head, “I have only one Celestial Cauldron.”
Haha, who would believe that?
Who was he kidding!
You are so strong, and you actually only have a single Celestial Cauldron?
Then when you reach Seven Cauldrons and Eight Cauldrons, wouldn’t you be able to insta-kill all Core Formation Tiers?
“Ha!
Ha!” Lu Yongchang laughed, expressing his disbelief.
Ling Han stowed the Celestial Cauldron away, and smiled faintly, “What are you laughing at?
When I advance into the Core Formation Tier, do you believe that I will beat you up?”
Lu Yongchang humphed, “Continue the lie!”
He was clearly a Core Formation Tier cultivator, yet he still wanted to pretend to be a Cauldron Forging Formation Tier cultivator.
He waited for Extreme Frost Venerate to flip out, and angrily rebuke Ling Han for being a conman.
However, he still didn’t hear Extreme Frost Venerate’s voice.
Yi?
He turned his head, and looked towards the Extreme Frost Venerate.
There was a hint of shock and disbelief on his face.
What was going on?

F***, what in the world was going on here?

“That’s the only explanation.”
“Look at that brat’s Celestial Cauldron.
It has patterns like True Dragon, Divine Phoenix, and so on.
Only by fusing the cauldrons can it be explained.”
“Heavens, this only exists in legends.

“No wonder this brat is so strong!”
“Combining the cauldrons is not much different from advancing into the Core Formation Tier.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3957: Strength of the pervert pig
paragraphs: Because there were too many people, even Nine Mountains Venerate couldn’t directly tear open space and create a human-made wormhole to quickly traverse through space.
However, Venerate Tier was Venerate Tier after all, so traversing the galaxy was still astonishingly fast.
Three months later, the Nine Suns Planet was already within sight.

Nine Mountains Venerate led everyone down. Then, he announced the disbanding of the team, and told everyone to properly cultivate and digest the benefits they had gained from the Mystery Realm. After saying this, he left.
This was natural. Ling Han had actually attained a Fusion Cauldron. This was an incredible matter, and he had to inform the other Venerate Tier elites of the Holy Land.

It wasn’t long before Ling Han was summoned over to ask about the details of the cauldron. Thus, Ling Han simply pushed all the credit onto Buddha Doga. Then, he also hid his abilities for a while, and said that he had fused Nine Cauldrons into one.

Nine Cauldrons was already the highest peak that Cauldron Forging Tier could reach in Nine Cauldrons, and added with a Fusion Cauldron, that was a top-notch prodigy among top- notch prodigies. capable of standing on the same level as the prodigies of Imperial Clans, right?
The Nine Suns Holy Land decided to give Ling Han all the cultivation resources he needed. As long as Ling Han needed them, they would spare no expense to obtain them and fully nurture him.

Ling Han naturally wouldn’t refuse. He would take advantage of this opportunity to help the empress and the others obtain better cultivation conditions. At the very least, he would have to give them an abode, right?
The elites of the Holy Land only considered for a moment before deciding to agree to Ling Han’s request.
This kind of prodigy was really too rare. Not only was he a prodigy of martial arts, he was also an Alchemy Grandmaster, and what was more important?
His background was clean!

Unlike Lu Qi and Song Lan, who came from powerful forces in the first place, and would not focus on the Nine Suns Holy Land when they became skilled in the future, Ling Han was different. He did not come from any great sect, and could completely think of the Nine Suns Holy Land as his home base.
Thus, this kind of talent was worth nurturing.

Ling Han defeated the prodigies of West Heavenly Realm harshly, turning the tide and winning face and dignity for the North Heavenly Realm. This further spread in the Holy Land, and a great many female disciples used various reasons to go to Ling Han’s place, hoping that something could happen between them.

If they were just ordinary female disciples, it wouldn’t be a big deal. However, seductive beauties like Jie Yingqiu and Tan Meng also frequently threw seductive glances at Ling Han. In fact, Song Lan even visited Ling Han every few days. This naturally incited the strong
jealousy of some people.
For example, Lu Qiqi.
He had joined the Nine Suns Holy Land for the sake of pursuing Song Lan and Ling Han. Now, the woman he had his eye on was repeatedly going to another man’s place. How could he accept this?
Thus, he issued a challenge to Ling Han.

Previously, he had been beaten out of the White Lotus Mystery Realm by Ling Han, and had practically gained nothing. This was already enough to make him suffocate. Now, Song Lan seemed like she was about to throw herself into Ling Han’s arms, and he could no longer bear
it.
Ordinarily, he had already broken through to the Core Formation Tier, so how could he bring himself to challenge Ling Han?
However, there were two types of fairness in the cultivation world.
Firstly, it was naturally equal in cultivation level, and secondly, it was equal in age.
They were of the same age, so even if their cultivation levels differed greatly, it was still a fair battle. If your cultivation speed slowed down, that was your own business.
Thus, though Lu Qi had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, his age was similar to Ling Han’s. This was still considered a fair battle.
Lu Qi issued a challenge, and it was up to Ling Han whether he would accept or not.
Ling Han chuckled, and only sent a single word to the outside world, “Fight.”

“That’s right, kill this b@stard!” The large black dog roared, “Little Han is already close to breaking through to the Core Formation Tier, so it’s time for us to become awesome! Let’s go, we’ll go and snatch Song Lan and Prosperous Heaven over.”
“Refine your divine substance well.” Ling Han gave him a kick. This damn dog was really too restless.

Meanwhile, the perverted pig snickered secretly at the side. Seeing the large black dog being beaten, he was secretly pleased. After all, the large black dog’s tongue was too toxic, and he often bullied him.
Ling Han grabbed the pervert pig over and asked, “What’s wrong with you, pig?”
He used his eye technique and carefully examined the pervert pig.

Previously, his cultivation level was weak, and he only knew that this pervert pig was extraordinary, but he could not tell what exactly was going on. But now that he had fused ten cauldrons into one, he was stronger than even the majority of Core Formation Tier elites. Perhaps, he would be qualified to see some clues.
Yi?
He looked at the pervert pig’s mind, and could vaguely see a dazzling world, but it seemed like a lock had been placed on it, preventing him from truly entering.
“Good lord!” he exclaimed.
“What is it?” The large black dog immediately approached.
Ling Han pointed at the lecherous pig, “This guy is probably at the level of Sect Master.”
“What!” The large black dog was stunned for a moment, then circled around the perverted pig, and shook his head, “It doesn’t look like it.”

“It certainly doesn’t look like it. It’s perverted, lazy, and gluttonous.” Ling Han nodded, “However, I saw that its mind was incredibly expansive. It should be on the level of Sect Master, but it seems to have been sealed.”
“No wonder he has become stupid.” The large black dog sighed.

The perverted pig was furious, and began to bite the large black dog. Its cultivation level had only been sealed, so it could not communicate with its divine sense, nor could it take human form. Furthermore, its battle prowess had all been lost, but its intelligence was still normal! “Dumb pig, you can’t even bite Grandpa Dog, so what’s the point of exerting so much effort? Sure enough, there’s a problem with your intelligence.” The large black dog shook its head, and continued to attack the perverted pig.
The pervert pig snorted. The gist of it was that when Uncle Pig recovered his cultivation level, just see how I will beat you up.

The large black dog snickered, and said, “With Grandpa Dog’s supreme talent, by the time you undo the seal, Grandpa Dog will have long since surpassed the level of Sect Master, and you want to beat me up? In your dreams!”
The perverted pig could only snort and grunt, and decided to ignore this stupid dog.
“Ling Han, there’s no problem, right?” Zhou Heng asked.
Ling Han smiled and said, “You people can refine the divine substance and try to reach the
Nine Cauldrons or even the Ten Cauldrons. As for Lu Qi, hehe, I dealt with him once in the White Lotus Mystery Realm, so there’s naturally no need for me to take him to heart now.”
“Niu’s Ling Han is amazing!” Hu Niu said delicately.
Everyone laughed loudly. Ling Han was indeed freakish. He had been freakish in the Genesis
World, and he was freakish now.
Very soon, Lu Qi responded, wanting to battle Ling Han tomorrow.
When the news spread out, everyone was discussing spiritedly.
Ling Han was indeed strong. He was definitely the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier elite in the
North Heavenly Realm. However, Lu Qi was a Core Formation Tier elite, so how could the Cauldron Forging Tier compare to him in battle prowess?
Only Song Lan knew that Ling Han had defeated Feng Jixing, a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier. Thus, defeating Lu Qi was naturally a piece of cake.
“Sigh, Ling Han is too rash.”

“That’s right. Though he can be considered the number one elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier, compared with the Core Formation Tier, there is still too much of a gap.” “That’s right. The breach between Cauldron Forging Tier and Core Formation Tier is really too wide. Furthermore, Lu Qi was once ranked nineteenth in the Cauldron Forging Tier. Once he has advanced into the Core Formation Tier, his battle prowess would be at least Third Heaven, or even Fourth Heaven.”
“In this battle, Ling Han should definitely lose.”
“It can’t be helped. Haven’t you guys heard? This battle is fought for the sake of Celestial
maiden Song Lan.”
“It is understandable that he would fly into a rage for the sake of his lover, but it is inevitable that Ling Han would lose.”
Amidst everyone’s discussions, the next day quietly arrived. Ling Han and Lu Qi were about to
battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 3958: Defeating Lu Qi Again
paragraphs: To Ling Han, this battle was nothing difficult. He didn’t take it to heart at all, and slept peacefully at night. On the second day, he only got up when the sun rose. After cultivating for half an hour, he finally walked out.

This was too simple. Thus, Ling Han didn’t even have the empress, Hu Niu, and the others come over to watch the battle. In any case, it was only going to beat up a person. Was there any need to be so concerned?
He arrived at the location of the battle. At this moment, Lu Qi had already arrived. He was presently sitting cross-legged on the ground, a sword laid across his knees, his eyes tightly shut.
Core Formation Tier was Core Formation Tier, after all. When Ling Han appeared, he immediately sensed it, and looked towards Ling Han.
The moment he opened his eyes, his killing intent blazed.

He hated Ling Han too much. When he had been in the White Lotus Mystery Realm, Ling Han had played around with him like he was a monkey. In the end, Ling Han had even beaten him out of the Mystery Realm, causing him to have absolutely no chance of obtaining the divine substance and the celestial light.

Very good, he had not broken through to the Core Formation Tier yet. Even if his Nine Cauldrons fused into one, so what? How could this possibly compensate for the gap of a major tier in cultivation level?
Furthermore, it was a supreme prodigy like him.
“I have to say, though you are a despicable person, your courage is commendable,” Lu Qi said calmly, her voice carrying a condescending air of arrogance.

In everyone’s eyes, Lu Qi wasn’t exaggerating in the slightest. A Core Formation Tier cultivator was facing a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, so how could it be that they would still have to be careful?
“A defeated general still has the courage to challenge me again. I can’t help but admire your shamelessness.” Ling Han smiled faintly.
When these words were spoken, it was like a stone that had caused a thousand ripples.
“What, Lu Qi actually lost to Ling Han before?”
“I heard so. In the White Lotus Mystery Realm, he was forced to crush his token by Ling Han, andwasn’t able to even enter the Demonic Origin Realm.”
“Hiss, that’s really terrible.”
“In other words, Lu Qi was forced to break through to the Core Formation Tier?”
“That’s natural. Without obtaining the divine substance, and without the celestial light, the Nine Cauldrons would be the end of the line. If he doesn’t break through, what is he supposed to do?”

Boom, a terrifying power exploded, completely surpassing the level that a Cauldron Forging Tier should have.
