Peng!
With this strike, his figure was instantly sent backwards, leaving behind a very long mark on the ground.
What!
He paled in shock. Was Ling Han really a Cauldron Forging Tier?
Nine Cauldrons fused into one; was it really that terrifying?

He couldn’t help but be filled with jealousy, because he believed that with his talent, if he could enter into the Black Heaven Temple, then the person who would be further chosen by Pseudo-Emperor Doga would definitely not be Ling Han, but rather him.
All of this was because of Ling Han. It was he who had snatched away his fated opportunity!
Ah!
He was incandescent with rage, and he immediately charged at Ling Han. He had completely forgotten the matter about letting Ling Han have the first three moves.
Boom, boom, boom! Lu Qi unleashed the full power of the Core Formation Tier, and his fury solidified. It was as if he were a great demon god.
However, everyone was stunned by Ling Han’s strength, all of them numb with shock.
F***, what kind of monster was this, to actually be able to stand against a Core Formation Tier elite.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t cower. He exchanged blows with Lu Qi, and after a few moves, he had a complete understanding of Lu Qi’s strength.
Lu Qi’s power was about Second Heaven, which was considerably weaker than Feng Jixing’s.

It could not be helped. Who asked that Lu Qi had not received any benefits in the White Lotus Mystery Realm, such as the divine substance, the celestial light, and so on? Thus, while they were both in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, his power was definitely inferior to
Feng Jixing’s.
It was too weak, not challenging at all.
Ling Han shook his head. He didn’t use the celestial technique, but rather burst out with mystical power, exchanging blows with Lu Qiqi.
W-what!
Anyone could clearly see which of them was using techniques. Everyone could clearly see that Ling Han was only using his own power to oppose Lu Qi. This terrified everyone.
Lu Qi was also filled with disbelief. His eyes widened, and he was completely at a loss.
Was this the might of Fusion Cauldron?
No, this must be because Ling Han had obtained a large amount of benefits in the Mystery Realm, and that was why he had become so strong after he fused the cauldrons.
Lu Qi was even more envious. With a furious roar, he unleashed his full battle prowess and channeled a Saint-level technique, launching a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
He refused to believe that a Cauldron Forging Tier was powerful enough to rival Core Formation Tier, even though he had already experienced Ling Han’s strength.

“A Saint-level technique?” Ling Han asked with a shake of his head. Even under such explosive power, Lu Qi’s battle prowess was only at the Fifth Heaven. It was impossible for him to force him to unleash his true strength.
Sigh, how disappointing.
Ling Han casually brandished his fists, appearing to be completely unconcerned. However, he easily dispersed Lu Qi’s attack.
The discussions around them became softer and softer. In the end, everyone only looked at
Ling Han with admiration.
This was definitely the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier in history, and in the future, this might even be a Saint Tier elite!
This was a Saint. Even if he went to the Imperial Clan, he would still receive the highest level of respect. This was the power of the strongest in the world.
In fact, if heaven and earth allowed it, Ling Han even had a chance of breaking through to the
Ancestral King Tier.
Boom!
Ling Han was getting impatient. He threw a heavy punch, and Lu Qi was instantly sent flying.

“When you see me in the future, remember to take a different path,” he said calmly. This was a Holy Land, so it was not convenient for him to commit murder here. Otherwise, just because Lu Qi had repeatedly expressed killing intent towards him, he could not let him off so easily.
Lu Qi didn’t charge forward again. That punch from Ling Han had caused all the blood in his body to churn, and he was in extreme pain.
This allowed him to know that even if there was a gap of a major tier between them, Ling Han
was still stronger than him.
This kind of feeling made him want to die.
Ling Han turned around and left swiftly.
Who would have thought that this spar would end in such a way?
Everyone began to discuss again, all of them exclaiming in shock. And with regards to Lu Qi,
though no one made any sarcastic remarks, no one paid any more attention to him.
Lu Qi clenched his fists tightly, and his eyes were also closed. However, the voices of the
masses could still be heard.
This was like a knife that pierced into his heart, one after another.
He swore that he would definitely get his revenge. Otherwise, the moment he thought of Ling Han’s face, he would feel as if he was being cut by a saber.
Lu Qi left quietly. No one would care about a loser, even if he was still a top-notch prodigy.
This was only a small interlude of the Nine Suns Holy Land. Their enrollment event was still ongoing, and the fourth enrollment had begun.

The third time was coincidentally when the White Lotus Mystery Realm opened, so the quality of the disciples that were recruited was obviously lower, but this time, a great many fierce people had come, as well as some extremely beautiful and bewitching women.

chapters.title: Chapter 3959: Redemption
paragraphs: This fourth enrollment could cause such a commotion, attracting a great many fierce and bewitching people. Ling Han definitely could claim for this.
The Nine Suns Holy Land was very awesome, but it was only one of the many Holy Lands in the universe.
In these millions and millions of years, how many Holy Lands were there in the galaxy?
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that there were definitely tens of thousands. Thus, the Nine Suns Holy Land had a very high status. However, it wasn’t as attractive as this.
The inheritance of the Nine Suns Saint?
Hehe, it hadn’t been found for hundreds of millions of years. Did it really exist? Could it really be found?
Thus, the reason why so many powerful and seductive women had come this time was actually because of Ling Han.

-The news that Ling Han had defeated the Cauldron Forging Tier prodigy of the West Heavenly Realm had already spread out, shaking the universe. Thus, the prodigies of North Heavenly Realm all wanted to come and see how Ling Han looked like, and witness with their own eyes just how strong he was.
Some of these people only wanted to see Ling Han, some wanted to recruit Ling Han into their forces, and some came with ambition. If they could defeat Ling Han, they could replace his
position, and become the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier.
Ling Han was completely unconcerned about this.

The resources of the Holy Land were endlessly sent over. His cultivation level was also increasing steadily, but the only Celestial Cauldron was like a bottomless pit. The advancement of his cultivation level was extremely slow.
Ling Han, on the other hand, did not feel troubled. Instead, he was pleased.

This was because the speed at which he refined the power of heaven and earth hadn’t changed at all. However, his cultivation had slowed down. This signified that he would become even more powerful at the same cultivation level.
According to his estimation, even with a large amount of cultivation resources, there was still a year’s time before he could reach the consummate level of Cauldron Forging Tier
It was a very long time.
Thankfully, this was not the White Lotus Mystery Realm, where people only had a lifespan of about a hundred years. One year’s time was really not much.
Ling Han sat quietly by himself. He took out a bottle.
This was what Extreme Frost Venerate had lost to him. It contained the Divine Source.
He asked the Nine Mountains Venerate about this. He wanted to know what it was used for, and how it should be used.

In truth, the use of this could definitely be found on the Galaxy Network, but it was naturally more convenient and accurate to ask for guidance from a Venerate Tier. Moreover, this was also a way to get closer to Nine Mountains Venerate.

Divine Source was truly extraordinary. If it was used to cleanse one’s body, it could cleanse one’s internal injuries and strengthen one’s foundations, and if it was used when one was breaking through, it could also strengthen one’s Celestial Foundation, Celestial Cauldron, Celestial Core, and so on.
This could not directly increase one’s cultivation level, but was far more valuable than increasing one’s cultivation level. Even a powerful Sect Master elite would view it as a precious treasure.

Only an elite like Extreme Frost Venerate was qualified to obtain it. Didn’t they hear him say? He had also spent some effort to obtain it. At first, he must have wanted to use it on his own disciple. He had never thought that it would benefit Ling Han.
-Who would have thought that such a powerful person would emerge from the North Heavenly Realm?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then put away the Divine Source. He decided to use it when he broke through to the Core Formation Tier.

He was perfecting the various celestial techniques that he had obtained in the White Lotus Mystery Realm. Being able to use them was one matter, but being able to unleash a portion of their might was another matter.
Ling Han rearranged his techniques according to their might.

The most awesome was definitely the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, which had an illusion effect. When it was delivered, it could increase his battle prowess by four Heavens in terms of raw power, which was incredibly terrifying.

The second was the Demonic Monkey Fists. This was an Imperial Technique, which could increase his battle prowess by three Heavens. If he used the two styles consecutively, the might of the second form would be even stronger, but it was still far from reaching the extent of increasing his battle prowess by four Heavens.
Imperial Technique was inferior to Primal Chaos Divine Lightning?
No.

Firstly, he had only mastered two styles of the Demonic Monkey Fists, and had not grasped all the essence. Secondly, only the Ancestral King should be able to unleash the full might of an Imperial Technique. The later generations would only be imitating it, so how could they possibly unleash the full essence?

Ling Han nodded internally. In truth, the strength of the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning did not lie in him, but rather that this thing was strong in the first place, and was only limited by his cultivation level.
Thus, if one wanted to become a true elite, they would need to create a celestial technique that belonged solely to them.
En, his present Celestial Cauldron was incredibly awesome, and could absorb all attacks below Sixth Heaven. Could he use this to create a celestial technique?
Under the Demonic Monkey Fists was the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique.
This was a real Saint Technique, not a weaker version like the Three Styles of the God of War, nor was it an incomplete version like the Wind God Kick.
“Should I get a staff?” Ling Han murmured.
Staff techniques naturally needed a staff to unleash their full might.
In this set of staff techniques, he presently could only unleash 40% of its might. Even so, just how powerful was the Saint Technique? 40% of its might was already very terrifying.
In the White Lotus Mystery Realm, he had robbed a considerable number of people. Of course, he had also confiscated a considerable number of Celestial Tools, and there really was a staff among them.
He found it, then began to channel the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique.
Boom!
With a wave of his staff, a Buddhist circle actually formed behind his head, as if he was an enlightened monk.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel vexed. Why was the celestial technique of the Buddhist Race so unique? Once it was used, it was equivalent to announcing to the world that he was using the secret technique of the Buddhist Race.
“However, the White Lotus Mystery Realm is no secret either. Even if I use Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique, the Buddhist Race probably wouldn’t go to the extent of seeking me
out for an accounting.”
Ling Han mumbled to himself, but right at this moment, he received a report from the Dao Apprentice that someone had come to visit.
“Who?” he asked.
“That person said that he’s Young Master Han’s old friend. Her name is Prosperous Heaven,”
Mingyue said.
Er.
He had just said that the Buddhist Race would not seek him out, when this person from the Buddhist Race came.
Retribution didn’t have to come so quickly, right?
“Please,” Ling Han said. Why had this Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter come to the Nine Suns
Holy Land?

He went to the main hall, and when he arrived, Mingyue had also arrived with Prosperous Heaven. This little Dao Apprentice was now an eighteen-year-old young man, and was in the prime of his youth. He kept glancing at Prosperous Heaven from the corner of his eye, his expression filled with adoration.
This was a seductive beauty ranked tenth on the Exquisite Leaderboard. She was breathtakingly beautiful, so how could his willpower be enough?
“Brother Ling, it’s been a few months since we last met. It’s been a long time.” Prosperous
Heaven gave a Buddhist proclamation. Her snow-white monk robes fluttered in the wind,
untainted by the mortal world.
Ling Han chuckled, “What is it? Are you planning to come here to redeem the world?”
Prosperous Heaven shook her head, and said, “It is the responsibility of Buddha to redeem
the people of the world. I only want to redeem one person.”
Ling Han paused, pointed at himself, and asked, “Me?”
“Brother Ling is truly smart!” Prosperous Heaven generously smiled at Ling Han.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “You really know how to joke. I have many beautiful wives and children, so how could I possibly become a monk?”
Prosperous Heaven also smiled, “Brother Ling has probably misunderstood the Buddhist
Race. Aside from true ascetic monks, the majority of the disciples of Buddhist Race are not
forbidden to marry.”
“Oh, in other words, you can also get married?” Ling Han countered.
Even though this woman was elegant and refined, as if she was untainted by dirt, she was actually extremely two-faced. Ling Han didn’t want to fall into her trap. He immediately counterattacked.

“Brother Ling, it’s been a few months since we last met.
It’s been a long time.” Prosperous
Heaven gave a Buddhist proclamation.
Her snow-white monk robes fluttered in the wind,
untainted by the mortal world.
Ling Han chuckled, “What is it?
Are you planning to come here to redeem the world?”
Prosperous Heaven shook her head, and said, “It is the responsibility of Buddha to redeem
the people of the world.
I only want to redeem one person.”
Ling Han paused, pointed at himself, and asked, “Me?”
“Brother Ling is truly smart!” Prosperous Heaven generously smiled at Ling Han.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “You really know how to joke.
I have many beautiful wives and children, so how could I possibly become a monk?”
Prosperous Heaven also smiled, “Brother Ling has probably misunderstood the Buddhist
Race.
Aside from true ascetic monks, the majority of the disciples of Buddhist Race are not
forbidden to marry.”
“Oh, in other words, you can also get married?” Ling Han countered.
Even though this woman was elegant and refined, as if she was untainted by dirt, she was actually extremely two-faced.
Ling Han didn’t want to fall into her trap.
He immediately counterattacked.

chapters.title: Chapter 3960 Challenge agai
paragraphs: 3960 Challenge agai
Prosperous Heaven gave a Buddhist proclamation, “This poor nun is different. I have dedicated my whole life to Buddha since childhood, and will not marry in this lifetime.”
“Sigh, I was happy for nothing.” Ling Han spread out his hands, deliberately teasing.

Prosperous Heaven was extremely subtle, and didn’t care at all. Instead, she said, “I have come this time to redeem Brother Ling and bring him into our Buddhist Race, so that he can become the Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm.
“Hold on!” Ling Han waved his hand, “Buddha Son of North Heavenly Realm? Your Buddha Race is still divided into north, south, east, and west?”

“Naturally.” Prosperous Heaven nodded, “The true sacred site of the Buddhist Race has been created by Ancestral Buddha outside the Thirty Three Heavens, and is not within the Five Elements. And in the four Heavenly Realms, there is a Thunder Temple each, which is the manifestation of the Buddhist Race in the world.”

“I am the Holy Daughter of the North Heavenly Realm. And the Buddha Son of our North Heavenly Realm, not too long ago, in a sparring match with the Buddha Son of the East Heavenly Realm, has wounded his foundations, and no longer has the ability to hold the position of Buddha Son.”
“I think that Brother Ling is extremely talented, and also has an affinity with Buddha, so I have specially come to redeem Brother Ling.”
Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “How am I fated with Buddha?”
“How could those who are valued by Buddha have no relation with Buddha?” Prosperous Heaven asked in reply.
Er, with such words, Ling Han was actually rendered speechless.

Actually, Pseudo-Emperor Doga valued him, but it wasn’t because he was fated with the Buddhist Race, but rather because he should have sensed that there were dimensional beings inside his body, or he could tell that his Celestial Cauldron was forged from a replica of the Primitive Celestial Gate.
In short, he had absolutely nothing to do with the Buddhist Race.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “Don’t, don’t, don’t. I am a mortal, and I like to do the things of mortals, and also enjoy the life of mortals.”
Prosperous Heaven smiled and said, “It’s fine. The Buddhist Race also has the Mortality Buddha. You would not have to leave the mortal world to become a Buddha.”
‘F*ck! You’ve said everything!’
Ling Han chuckled and said, “In any case, I’m not interested in joining the Buddhist Race.”
Since you are so shameless, then I can only choose not to reason with you.

Prosperous Heaven was completely unconcerned, “This nun has no intention on immediately redeeming Brother Ling. This, in my eyes, is a great merit, and I shall work hard for the sake of this for the long term.”
“Er, then you can work hard slowly.” Ling Han waved his hand. He was not going to be a monk.

Prosperous Heaven was truly shameless, completely ignoring Ling Han’s expulsion order. She just kept talking about the teachings of the Buddhist Race with Ling Han, enlightening this person of the mortal world.
Ling Han couldn’t help but yawn upon hearing this. He didn’t have a bad impression of Buddhist Race beings, but he didn’t have a good impression of them either.

This Emperor-level force had swept through the galaxy in the form of faith. A considerable number of Majestic Empires all believed in Buddhist teachings, and if needed, they could all become warriors of the Buddhist Race.
The Shadow Majestic Empire was an example of this. There was also the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, which had now been overthrown.
He really could not bear it any longer, and directly fled. If you want to blabber here, you can just blabber. I’ll leave, all right?
“Ling Han!”
He had just stepped out of the main doors when he heard a shout, and saw a young man in embroidered robes striding over, “I want to challenge you.”
Ling Han sighed. He had only defeated a minor character from the Western Heaven Heavenly Realm. Was there any need for them to target him and view him as a stepping stone to fame?
“I don’t have time for you.” He delivered a palm strike.
“You’ve come just in time!” The young man immediately greeted the incoming attack with a palm strike, but the moment they came into contact, he retreated continuously.

He wanted to forcefully stabilize himself, but he was completely unable to do so. After retreating more than ten steps, he still flopped onto the ground. Chila, his pants split apart, and even his behind was revealed.
This was naturally deliberate on Ling Han’s part. Who asked you to come here at this time to seek your own suffering?
Thankfully, when Ling Han returned after a walk, he finally did not see Prosperous Heaven again.
However, this didn’t reassure Ling Han, because it was obvious that Prosperous Heaven would treat this as a drawn-out battle.
Ling Han’s troubles had just begun. Hadn’t a great many powerful people entered this time? The majority of them had come to target him.

Every day, there would be people challenging Ling Han, and even if they saw one after another suffer a terrible defeat, the remaining people still did not realize it. Every day, the same scene would play out.

Ling Han was truly impatient, so he decided to simply gather all the challengers together. Then, he would fight one group after another. With the awesomeness of his only Celestial Cauldron, Ling Han would have no problem dealing with a group fight, and easily thrash all his opponents.
In this way, no one challenged him in the end.
—To become famous by challenging Ling Han in a single battle, that was obviously delusional.

Ling Han finally had some peace, but Prosperous Heaven still came to find him every day. Even if he ignored her, this Buddhist Race Holy Daughter would still spread Buddhism and recite the teachings of Buddhist Race outside the abode, completely fixated on Ling Han.

She had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, and furthermore, she was the Buddhist Race’s Holy Daughter, so it was naturally impossible for her to join the Nine Suns Holy Land. However, precisely because she came from the Imperial Clan, if she wanted to “disturb” the Nine Suns Holy Land for a few days, would the Holy Land have the face to chase her away?
Thus, this problem could only be resolved by Ling Han himself.
After a month, the Nine Suns Holy Land suddenly welcomed a group of special guests.
—It was still Extreme Frost Venerate, as well as a few Cauldron Forging Tier juniors.
Their purpose for coming was very simple, and that was to challenge Ling Han and win back glory for the West Heavenly Realm.

They could lose to anyone but the North Heavenly Realm. This would bring shame to the entire West Heavenly Realm. They wouldn’t be able to raise their heads in front of the martial artists from the East Heavenly Realm and South Heavenly Realm.

The West Heavenly Realm had come so aggressively, so the Nine Suns Holy Land naturally could not refuse. Furthermore, this was not just a matter that involved only the Nine Suns Holy Land, but implicated the whole North Heavenly Realm.
This time, Extreme Frost Venerate had also brought three people with him—Wang Huazang, Ning Xingfa, and Ma Ziming.

Among them, Wang Huazang and Ning Xingfa were the super geniuses ranked in the top two in the West Heavenly Realm, while Ma Ziming was the super genius that had just recently risen. His battle prowess was probably not inferior to Wang Huazang and Ning Xingfa. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been brought here.

Only four people from the West Heavenly Realm came, but the Nine Suns Holy Land acted as if they were facing a great enemy. It wasn’t that they were afraid of these four people, but rather that the result of Ling Han’s subsequent battle involved the pride of the North Heavenly Realm.

The first spar was set to be held three days later, and then every three days, a new person would challenge Ling Han to a battle. Of course, if Ling Han lost in the first battle, there would be no need to continue the second and third spar.
When the news spread out, not only were the disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land extremely excited, even the entire North Heavenly Realm was paying attention to this matter.
It wasn’t easy for them to defeat the West Heavenly Realm once, so they definitely couldn’t lose again.

On the Galaxy Network, there was a wave of cheers for Ling Han. Of course, these were all North Heavenly Realm martial artists. Then, West Heavenly Realm martial artists began to mock Ling Han, saying that Ling Han had only won against Ni Wenbai by luck. Now that Wang Huazang and the others had come, they represented the true strength of West Heavenly Realm. Ling Han definitely wouldn’t be able to survive the first round.
The two sides began a war of insults, both of them refusing to yield to the other.
Obviously, before the three sparring rounds ended, it was impossible for this kind of verbal battle to stop.

Afterwards, even the people from the East and South Heavenly Realms joined this war of insults. They were all cheering for the West Heavenly Realm, and thought that the North Heavenly Realm had been weakened for many years, so how could it possibly explode all of a sudden?

chapters.title: Chapter 3961 Leaving in Dejection
paragraphs: 3961 Leaving in Dejection
Under everyone’s expectant gazes, the first sparring match between Ling Han and the Cauldron Forging Tier prodigy of Western Heavenly Realm was about to begin.
This was carried out in the Nine Suns Holy Land. With a Venerate Tier overseer, naturally no one dared to play any tricks.

There were too many people watching the battle. They had all turned on the connection device and carried out a live broadcast, broadcasting the battle live to the Galaxy Network. No matter which corner of the galaxy it was, as long as there was Galaxy Network, and as long as there was a connection device, they could watch it live.
“Ling Han, it’s time for a fight. Hurry up!” Hu Niu urged. She was a violent maniac, and loved fighting the most.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was still sipping tea, not worried at all.
That was indeed the case. This battle was not something that he wanted to fight. Moreover, there were no benefits to be gained!

Previously, with the Divine Source as a reward, he had let it drag out for a long time before stepping out, wanting to get more benefits. This time, it was completely for the sake of the reputation of the North Heavenly Realm. Though he would step out to fight, his enthusiasm was naturally greatly reduced.
“So what if we let them wait for a while longer?” The empress was proud. As she saw it, everyone in the world should revolve around her and Ling Han. What reason was there for them to rush over?

Princess Bixiao merely smiled as she watched from the sidelines. She would never have imagined that Ling Han would one day grow to such a height, and become the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier in a whole Heavenly Realm, no, the entire universe.
In future, he would also become the strongest Core Formation Tier, the strongest True Self Tier, and the strongest True Lord Tier, charging all the way to the peak of martial arts.
After Ling Han finished his tea, he stood up and slowly walked out.
“Ling Han!”
“Ling Han!”
“Ling Han!”
When he reached the martial arts arena, cheers that seemed capable of collapsing mountains and shattering the earth instantly erupted.
At this moment, he was even more important than a Venerate Tier.
That was because no Venerate Tier could redeem pride for North Heavenly Realm, while Ling Han could.
Ling Han smiled at everyone, one after another. Then, he walked out of the crowd, and a large area was cleared ahead of him, so that he could spar with the people of the West Heavenly Realm.
“Come, who will fight me?” Ling Han asked calmly.

“You can only battle me.” Ning Xingfa walked out. He was tall and slender, and his black hair reached his waist. If one looked at him from behind, it was possible that they would misunderstand that he was a slender woman.
“Because you will be defeated today, and there will be no more battles three days later.”

Ling Han glanced at him, and shook his head, “Compared to that Ni Wenbai, you don’t seem to be all that much stronger. How about this? The three of you attack together. If you can withstand ten moves from me, that will be considered your victory.”
Just what kind of contempt was this?

Ning Xingfa couldn’t help but fly into a thunderous rage, his fighting spirit ignited. His head of black hair actually became crimson all of a sudden, causing him to turn from a cultured and refined person into a ferocious and sinister one. The aura he exuded was incredibly terrifying, causing the Cauldron Forging Tier disciples in the surroundings, as well as Foundation Building Tier disciples, to feel fear in their hearts, and it was difficult for their fighting spirit to rise.
With a soft exclamation, he charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t dodge or evade, and he only attacked when Ning Xingfa neared him. He was extremely casual, yet he easily grabbed onto Ning Xingfa’s neck.
This!
Everyone was numb with shock.

Though everyone already knew how strong Ling Han was, to be able to take down the second strongest person in Cauldron Forging Tier in the Western Heavenly Realm with a single move, this still made people feel as if they were in a dream.
They were both Cauldron Forging Tiers, so why was there such a huge gap between them?
How had this guy cultivated to this level?
And this scene was also broadcasted live on Galaxy Network, causing tumultuous waves.

“F***, Ning Xingfa is ranked ninth in Cauldron Forging Tier on the Galaxy Network. But even he was defeated by Ling Han in a single move. Then, even if it was the current number one Cauldron Forging Tier of the Galaxy Network, Zhu Chengyun, the number one prodigy of the Southern Heaven Realm, just how many moves could he take in Ling Han’s hands?”
“I heard that he has created a Fusion Cauldron, and that is why he has such terrifying abilities.”
“Haha, looks like the Western Heavenly Realm is seeking their own humiliation this time.”
“Please add the word ‘again’.”
“To say nothing of the Western Heavenly Realm, even if the Eastern Heavenly Realm and the Southern Heavenly Realm moves, in the level of Cauldron Forging Tier, who would be a match for Ling Han?”
“Unless it’s those mysterious guys.”
“Origin!”
“Myriad Dao!”
“Heaven Crushing!”
“Number One in the Galaxy!”
Ling Han casually tossed Ning Xingfa aside. He then looked at Extreme Frost Venerate and said, “Senior, it’s best that those two attack together. That way, they can save me some time.”
Extreme Frost Venerate was rendered speechless.
Actually, he didn’t want to make this trip, but when he returned last time and told them about the matter, the entire Western Heavenly Realm exploded. They actually lost to the North Heavenly Realm?
What kind of joke was this!
Even if it was only losing a minor battle, they could not abide this. This was a great humiliation.
Thus, they had sent out two stronger members of the Cauldron Forging Tier, as well as Ma Ziming, a super rookie, to win back some face.

Extreme Frost Venerate actually knew very well that Ling Han had insta-defeated Ni Wenbai with a single move at that time. Even if he had sent Wang Huazang, Ning Xingfa and the others, so what? They would only be delivering themselves up to be defeated.
As expected, the gap was too wide.
He waved his hand, and said, “Huazang, Ziming, the two of you attack together.”

Wang Huazang and Ma Ziming both wore solemn expressions. In the West Heavenly Realm, it was only other Cauldron Forging Tiers that would team up to battle them. Now, however, the two of them still needed to team up?
The problem was that even if they joined forces, they did not have the slightest bit of confidence that they could win.
How could this opponent be so strong?
However, no matter how uncertain they were, they still had to fight. If they didn’t even have the courage to fight, would they still have the face to call themselves cultivators?
The two of them walked out together, and approached Ling Han.
“Charge!” The two of them pounced out at the same time.
Ling Han shook his head. Even the strongest elite of the West Heavenly Realm was only so-so. They had just barely touched the battle prowess of the First Heaven of the Core Formation Tier.
He shot out a punch, which was extraordinarily fast. Shua, shua, in an instant, he had delivered two punches. Then, he saw Wang Huazang and Ma Ziming fly into the air.
They were completely outmatched.
After an instant of silence, the whole area erupted, as they all shouted Ling Han’s name loudly.

If it was said that Ling Han being the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier before was only a label that the people of the North Heavenly Realm had called out on their own, then it could be said that it was a sure bet now. Even the East Heavenly Realm and the South Heavenly Realm had to admit it.
How many years had the North Heavenly Realm been suppressed for?

Just look at the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators. The highest ranked Feng Jixing was only ranked 12th, and he hadn’t even made it into the top 10. Now, however, one of their own had suddenly soared to the first place. Moreover, this was the undisputed first place. How could they not be excited?

Extreme Frost Venerate shook his head. This result was within his expectations, but those stubborn old geezers of the Western Heaven Realm didn’t believe him. Now, great, the Galaxy Network was broadcasting live, showing the entire world that the Western Heaven Realm had suffered a terrible defeat.
“Let’s go.” With a wave of his hand, he tore a rip into the Void and left with Wang Huazang and the others.
The battle for revenge of the Western Heavenly Realm ended just like that. They didn’t even have six days to fight three battles.
Ling Han shrugged, turned and left.

He decided to spend his time on familiarizing himself with the celestial techniques, such as the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique, the Eighteen Arhat Palm, and so on. He had not grasped the essence of these techniques, so there was a lot of room for improvement. He would only feel that there was not enough time.
However, only a few days later, another group of people arrived at Nine Suns Holy Land.

He was extremely casual, yet he easily grabbed onto Ning Xingfa’s neck.
This!
Everyone was numb with shock.

Though everyone already knew how strong Ling Han was, to be able to take down the second strongest person in Cauldron Forging Tier in the Western Heavenly Realm with a single move, this still made people feel as if they were in a dream.
They were both Cauldron Forging Tiers, so why was there such a huge gap between them?
How had this guy cultivated to this level?
And this scene was also broadcasted live on Galaxy Network, causing tumultuous waves.
“F***, Ning Xingfa is ranked ninth in Cauldron Forging Tier on the Galaxy Network.
But even he was defeated by Ling Han in a single move.

Then, even if it was the current number one Cauldron Forging Tier of the Galaxy Network, Zhu Chengyun, the number one prodigy of the Southern Heaven Realm, just how many moves could he take in Ling Han’s hands?”
“I heard that he has created a Fusion Cauldron, and that is why he has such terrifying abilities.”
“Haha, looks like the Western Heavenly Realm is seeking their own humiliation this time.”
“Please add the word ‘again’.”
“To say nothing of the Western Heavenly Realm, even if the Eastern Heavenly Realm and the Southern Heavenly Realm moves, in the level of Cauldron Forging Tier, who would be a match for Ling Han?”
“Unless it’s those mysterious guys.”
“Origin!”
“Myriad Dao!”
“Heaven Crushing!”
“Number One in the Galaxy!”
Ling Han casually tossed Ning Xingfa aside.
He then looked at Extreme Frost Venerate and said, “Senior, it’s best that those two attack together.
That way, they can save me some time.”
Extreme Frost Venerate was rendered speechless.
Actually, he didn’t want to make this trip, but when he returned last time and told them about the matter, the entire Western Heavenly Realm exploded.
They actually lost to the North Heavenly Realm?
What kind of joke was this!
Even if it was only losing a minor battle, they could not abide this.
This was a great humiliation.
Thus, they had sent out two stronger members of the Cauldron Forging Tier, as well as Ma Ziming, a super rookie, to win back some face.
Extreme Frost Venerate actually knew very well that Ling Han had insta-defeated Ni Wenbai with a single move at that time.
Even if he had sent Wang Huazang, Ning Xingfa and the others, so what?
They would only be delivering themselves up to be defeated.
As expected, the gap was too wide.
He waved his hand, and said, “Huazang, Ziming, the two of you attack together.”
Wang Huazang and Ma Ziming both wore solemn expressions.
In the West Heavenly Realm, it was only other Cauldron Forging Tiers that would team up to battle them.
Now, however, the two of them still needed to team up?
The problem was that even if they joined forces, they did not have the slightest bit of confidence that they could win.
How could this opponent be so strong?
However, no matter how uncertain they were, they still had to fight.
If they didn’t even have the courage to fight, would they still have the face to call themselves cultivators?
The two of them walked out together, and approached Ling Han.
“Charge!” The two of them pounced out at the same time.
Ling Han shook his head.
Even the strongest elite of the West Heavenly Realm was only so-so.
They had just barely touched the battle prowess of the First Heaven of the Core Formation Tier.
He shot out a punch, which was extraordinarily fast.
Shua, shua, in an instant, he had delivered two punches.
Then, he saw Wang Huazang and Ma Ziming fly into the air.
They were completely outmatched.
After an instant of silence, the whole area erupted, as they all shouted Ling Han’s name loudly.

If it was said that Ling Han being the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier before was only a label that the people of the North Heavenly Realm had called out on their own, then it could be said that it was a sure bet now.
Even the East Heavenly Realm and the South Heavenly Realm had to admit it.
How many years had the North Heavenly Realm been suppressed for?
Just look at the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators.
The highest ranked Feng Jixing was only ranked 12th, and he hadn’t even made it into the top 10.
Now, however, one of their own had suddenly soared to the first place.
Moreover, this was the undisputed first place.
How could they not be excited?
Extreme Frost Venerate shook his head.
This result was within his expectations, but those stubborn old geezers of the Western Heaven Realm didn’t believe him.
Now, great, the Galaxy Network was broadcasting live, showing the entire world that the Western Heaven Realm had suffered a terrible defeat.
“Let’s go.” With a wave of his hand, he tore a rip into the Void and left with Wang Huazang and the others.
The battle for revenge of the Western Heavenly Realm ended just like that.
They didn’t even have six days to fight three battles.
Ling Han shrugged, turned and left.
He decided to spend his time on familiarizing himself with the celestial techniques, such as the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique, the Eighteen Arhat Palm, and so on.
He had not grasped the essence of these techniques, so there was a lot of room for improvement.
He would only feel that there was not enough time.
However, only a few days later, another group of people arrived at Nine Suns Holy Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 3962 Imperial Prince
paragraphs: 3962 Imperial Prince
“Ling Han, my Young Master has summoned you!” A purple-robed man ran to his abode, and then said these words.
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. What was going on?
This was the Nine Suns Holy Land?
“And what is your Young Master?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“How dare you!” The purple-robed man flew into a thunderous rage, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
He was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, and he had used his full power in this strike without any reservations at all.
Ling Han frowned, and dodged to the side.
The purple-robed man didn’t attack again. Instead, he proudly retracted his palm, and said, “Our Young Master is the descendant of Ancestral Fire Clouds, Imperial Son Lin Lang!”
Imperial Son?
With a thought from Ling Han, he said, “Alright, then let’s go and see your Imperial Son.”
He was curious. Why had an Imperial Son come to find him?
Furthermore, was there still a true Imperial Son now? Who knew how many generations of imperial grandsons there had already been.

The purple-robed man only thought that Ling Han was afraid. He revealed an expression of pride. In the present era, the strongest force was naturally the Imperial Clans. As long as they revealed the identity of the Imperial Clan, the Nine Suns Holy Land could only welcome them with open arms.
He led the way ahead, and very soon, brought Ling Han to a pavilion, and in the pavilion, there was presently a white-robed young man sitting upright. Behind him stood a young man and woman.
The woman was as beautiful as a flower, and she was a Core Formation Tier cultivator. She was dressed in red, and she stood with her hands by her sides like a maidservant.
As for the male... yi, Lin Qi!

Hold on, Lin Qi and Lin Lang? Oh, they were a family. However, Lin Qi came from a side branch, and only possessed a sliver of the Imperial Clan bloodline. He was not qualified to be called the Imperial Son at all.
Was he trying to stand up for Lin Qi?

Ling Han turned to look at the white-robed person who was sitting upright. This was a tall, slender man, who looked to be about twenty-three or twenty-four years old. He was handsome and dashing, exuding an extraordinary aura.
So this was the Imperial Son, Lin Lang?
‘Huh? I can’t tell what cultivation level he’s at.’
Ling Han was surprised. This white-robed person seemed to have been enshrouded in a fog, so it was difficult to distinguish his cultivation level, making him appear extremely mysterious.
However...
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, and he immediately saw very clearly that this white-robed person was a Cauldron Forging Tier. Furthermore, he could only vaguely see a Celestial Cauldron.
Was it the Human Cauldron... or a Fusion Cauldron?
“Reporting to Young Master, Ling Han has arrived,” the purple-robed man said respectfully to the white-robed young man.
The white-robed young man was naturally Lin Lang. He nodded, and did not even raise his eyes. He merely lowered his head to look at a jade pendant.
What arrogance.
“How dare you, kneel down!” Lin Qi shouted loudly.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. Why was he putting on airs now?
He couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Lin Qi, do you want to be beaten again?”

Lin Qi’s face involuntarily flushed red. Previously, when he had combusted his Imperial Blood, he had still been unable to defeat Ling Han. Now, his Imperial Blood was still far from recovering, so how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
However, the members of the main clan were right in front of him, so how could he be weaken the might of the Imperial Clan?
“Ling Han, you have to know who the person in front of you is!” he said balefully.

“A guy who doesn’t know proper etiquette,” Ling Han said calmly. “I was invited here, yet the person in charge didn’t even look at me directly. Hehe, who spoiled him to the extent of such poor manners?”
“How dare you!” The purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman both rebuked angrily.

Yet Lin Lang finally raised his head, and stretched out a hand to press down. Instantly, the purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman once again stood, their hands by their sides, indescribably obedient.

“I heard that you defeated a few minor characters of the Western Heavenly Realm, and were thus called the number one elite of the Cauldron Forging Tier. Hehe, what a joke.” He looked at Ling Han and shook his head, looking pitiful, as if he was mocking Ling Han for being a frog at the bottom of a well.
“Are you trying to say that you’re actually the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier elite?” Ling Han asked.

“Hehe, putting aside whether I’m the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier or not, it definitely can’t be you,” Lin Lang said. “How many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters haven’t appeared yet, so what right do you have to rule?”

Ling Han scoffed and said, “When I was fighting for the North Heavenly Realm, where were you enjoying yourself? Now that I’ve defeated the people from the West Heavenly Realm, you come here and tell me that I’m not the strongest Cauldron Forging Tier?”
“I just want to say one thing, are you f despicable?”
When these words fell, the expressions of the man in purple and the woman in red changed drastically, and though Lin Qi also looked furious, there was a hint of a cold smirk on his face.
After offending Lin Lang, Ling Han would definitely be done for.
Lin Lang, on the other hand, was not angered. He only shook his head, “After all, with vulgar birth, there are no manners at all.”
“Young Master, let me cripple him!” the purple-robed man commanded.

This was really overbearing. This was the Nine Suns Holy Land, and Ling Han was also the most valued disciple here. However, this measly Core Formation Tier cultivator dared to declare that he wanted to cripple him.
Lin Lang smiled faintly, “I want to move personally.”
“Young Master!” The purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman called out at the same time, “With your status, how could this brat be worthy!”
Lin Lang waved his hand and said, “Heh, this brat actually dares to claim that he’s the number one Cauldron Forging Tier? I’ll let him know what it means to be a frog at the bottom of a well.”
Hearing Lin Lang’s words, the purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman did not try to persuade him further.
However, they were all proud, and thought that Ling Han would definitely lose.

Lin Lang stood up, crossed his arms behind his back, and slowly walked towards Ling Han, “Having only defeated a few cats and dogs, and you actually dare to call yourself the number one elite of Cauldron Forging Tier. What a joke.”
“Could it be that you don’t know that this world belongs to the Imperial Clans?”
Ling Han shook his head, “Does the strength of the Imperial Clan all come from their mouths?”
“Haha, you are really arrogant!” Lin Lang smirked coldly, his expression finally darkening.
This lowly commoner was really too detestable.
Boom, he released his aura, and instantly, a frightening might swept out like waves, wave after wave.
It was indeed very strong.

Ling Han nodded internally. To be honest, this Lin Lang was indeed stronger than Wang Huazang, Ma Ziming, and the other prodigies of the Western Heavenly Realm. In fact, he had even surpassed their combined forces. No wonder he had seen the live broadcast on the Galaxy Network and still dared to challenge him to a duel.
However, Ling Han hadn’t used much of his abilities at that time. At most, he could only unleash battle prowess at the Second Heaven or Third Heaven of the Core Formation Tier.
“Looks like you still have some talent. In future, follow me, and become my dog!” Lin Lang declared proudly.
“Quickly thank Young Master!” On the side, the purple-robed man immediately shouted.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “How can anyone be so honorable as a dog?”
“Ha, becoming a dog for the Imperial Clan s your greatest honour,” Lin Lang said. Then, he threw a punch at Ling Han.
Boom! Power condensed, turning into a green-colored iron fist that was the size of a human head. It was covered densely with divine patterns, as well as innumerable seals.

The force of the punch surged over, and Ling Han merely snapped his fingers casually. Pa, a burst of power shot over, and this green fist immediately shattered, turning back into the power of heaven and earth.
“That’s all you’ve got?” Ling Han asked in surprise.
A hint of anger appeared on Lin Lang’s face. This lowly commoner actually dared to look down on him?
“You’re seeking death!” He threw another punch, and this time, the force of his punch actually turned into an Azure Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 3963 So what if you are the Imperial Prince?
paragraphs: 3963 So what if you are the Imperial Prince?

The True Dragon, the Divine Phoenix, the Qilin and so on were all Divine Beasts from the ancient era. This could be considered the first generation Ancestral Kings, and was born with the birth of the heaven and earth. However, after they died, there were no more Divine Beasts in the world. They had become legendary symbols.
However, as long as it was associated with the Divine Beast, this meant that it was powerful.
Lin Lang threw a punch, and it actually transformed into an Azure Dragon. Though this was only a simulation, it still showed just how strong he was.
Seeing the might of this punch, the purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman naturally revealed proud expressions. This was their Young Master, a prodigy of the Imperial Clan!

Meanwhile, Lin Qi revealed an expression of jealousy. He admitted that his natural talent was not much inferior to Lin Lang’s, but precisely because he came from a side branch, he was unable to learn the Imperial Technique, and was also unable to get the help of the Imperial Weapon to create a Fusion Cauldron.
Otherwise, he would also be able to stand proudly in front of Ling Han and knock this guy down with a single punch.
Boom! The Azure Dragon surged over, unleashing an indescribable might.

Ling Han estimated Lin Lang’s battle prowess. In terms of power, the latter had reached the First Heaven of the Core Formation Tier and above, but had not touched the Second Heaven yet. It was probable that the former had fused the Nine Cauldrons into one. Furthermore, the quality of the Celestial Cauldron was also very high, and would not be inferior to the Nine Coloured Glass Cauldron. Otherwise, even if the cauldrons were fused, the power of the cauldron could not possibly be so strong.
And this attack had developed into the Azure Dragon. It was very possible that it was a Saint Technique that had pushed the might of this punch to the height of Third Heaven and above.
This was very strong, enough to suppress any ordinary cultivator in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. However, in front of Ling Han, this wasn’t enough.

Ling Han snapped his fingers, and xiu, a gust of wind shot out, just hitting the Azure Dragon’s head. An incredibly deep power surged past, destroying everything in its path, blasting this Azure Dragon into smithereens.
What!

Upon seeing this, Lin Lang instantly wore an expression of disbelief. Meanwhile, Lin Qi was also gaping in shock. Meanwhile, the purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman both wore expressions of constipation.

Lin Qi had indeed seen Ling Han defeat Lu Qi before. That was a prodigy of the Core Formation Tier, which was enough proof that Ling Han could match the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, or even surpass it.
But who was Lin Lang?
Imperial Son!
Hence, he believed that Lin Lang was even stronger, far beyond the reach of Lu Qi and Ling Han.
However, after exchanging blows, he finally realized that he had been wrong. As it turned out, Ling Han’s strength was not inferior to the Imperial Son at all.
Lin Lang frowned slightly, and said, “I have underestimated you.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I didn’t underestimate you, though.”

Lin Lang instantly felt anger rise up from the bottom of his heart. He stared coldly at Ling Han, and said, “You can block a blow from me, but that does not mean that you are really capable of matching me!”
“One blow?” Ling Han asked calmly.
F***, it was another head-on strike!
Lin Lang clenched his fists tightly, his expression even uglier.
With a battle cry, he charged towards Ling Han, and no longer used long-distance attacks to kill him.

—Initially, he had thought that a casual action would be enough to let Ling Han know what true strength was, but now, if he did not use his true strength, it would be impossible for him to deal with this opponent.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He attacked repeatedly, incredibly fierce, wanting to take Ling Han down with thunderous force.
Ling Han parried every move, completely unconcerned.

‘I really can’t underestimate the heroes of the world,’ he thought to himself. ‘Look, just a random person is a prodigy that has fused the Nine Cauldrons into one. Then, would there be a super genius that has fused ten cauldrons into one?’

If Lin Lang knew what he was thinking, he would definitely be very depressed, because how many Imperial Clans were there in the whole universe? Only the most important heirs of the Imperial Clans were qualified to create a Fusion Cauldron, and there were pitifully few of them.
“Kill! Kill! Kill!” Lin Lang shouted loudly.
His hair fluttered in the wind, and each strand of hair was entwined with astonishing energy. If one strand floated down, it would be enough to kill a Nine Cauldrons prodigy.
Ling Han merely defended and did not attack. He wanted to see the true Imperial Technique.
After exchanging a few dozen more blows, Lin Lang felt humiliated.

Previously, he had put on too much airs, and looked down on Ling Han, as if he would be able to deal with Ling Han in a few moves. In the end? They had already fought for so long, and the two of them were still in a tie.
How humiliating.
“Sword, come!” he shouted lightly, and the space between his brows split open, and a dark green long sword instantly flew out.

This was the standard replica of the Lin Clan’s Imperial Weapon, the Jade Water Sword. Any important heir would have it, but with different cultivation levels and different identities, the might of the Jade Water Sword would also be different.
“Die!”
His hand gripped the hilt of his sword, and delivered a slash at Ling Han.
Weng, Sword Qi bloomed, dazzling and resplendent.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and the Starlight Screen spread open, wrapping around his fist, forming a layer of protection as he faced the sharp sword head-on.

Though the only Celestial Cauldron could absorb power, it did not have much protection against the slashes of sharp weapons. Thus, if he wanted to take a sharp weapon head-on, it was better to use the Starlight Screen.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Ling Han’s fist collided with the sword’s blade, sending bursts of light into the surroundings.
Lin Lang shockingly discovered that even if he used his Spirit Tool, he was actually still unable to suppress Ling Han.

It should be known that this was a replica of the Imperial Weapon. It had a sliver of Imperial Might, and could be claimed to be invincible. But now, faced with Ling Han’s fist, it was actually unable to injure him in the slightest. How could he accept this?
“Good one, brat!” he exclaimed lightly, withdrawing the last sliver of his contempt.
This person was powerful enough to rival him.
“Eight Heavenly King Techniques!” He sheathed his sword, then formed his hands into claws, adopting a very peculiar posture.
Imperial Technique!
Ling Han’s heart instantly clenched, and then a strong anticipation rose up in him. He finally had a chance to compete with the Imperial Technique.
Boom, Lin Lang’s claw attacked. It was like an Azure Dragon stretching out its claws, or like a divine phoenix hunting a flood dragon. That aura was majestic and boundless.
The Imperial Technique was created by the Great Emperor, so it was naturally grand and majestic.
Ling Han finally became serious, and greeted the attack with the Great Overarching Heaven Technique.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and instantly, a figure was sent flying.
It was Lin Lang.
Even if he used the Imperial Technique, he could only stimulate his battle prowess to Fourth Heaven and above. Compared to Ling Han, the gap was not just a little bit.
“What!” Lin Lang could not accept this. He was a noble Imperial Son, and was a hundred times nobler than any Dao Child, yet he was actually no match for a lowly commoner. How could he accept this?
“Ah!” His face was flushed red, and a terrifying aura surged from his body.
He was burning his Imperial Blood.

Even if he was the Imperial Son, and had a pure bloodline, it was actually relative. However, he was not the first generation Imperial Son, after all, so the number of times he could burn the Imperial Blood was only a dozen over times more than Lin Qi.
This was his trump card. Originally, he would not use it unless it was crucial, but now, an Imperial Son was actually no match for an ordinary ant. This caused a great blow to his pride.
The pride of the Imperial Clan would not allow him to fail. Thus, he was determined to defeat Ling Han at all costs.
The Imperial Blood ignited, and the effect was instantaneous. His body suddenly expanded, turning into a giant that was as tall as 30 meters, possessing monstrous might.
“In front of the Imperial Clan, all are ants!” Lin Lang shouted loudly. Then, he waved his palm towards Ling Han. An extremely deep power reverberated, so terrifying that it could not be described.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Didn’t the Great Emperor also start off as an ordinary person? On the other hand, has the Imperial Clan produced another Great Emperor?”
He leaped up, greeting Lin Lang’s attack.

sentences.text: 3963 So what if you are the Imperial Prince?
The True Dragon, the Divine Phoenix, the Qilin and so on were all Divine Beasts from the ancient era.
This could be considered the first generation Ancestral Kings, and was born with the birth of the heaven and earth.
However, after they died, there were no more Divine Beasts in the world.
They had become legendary symbols.
However, as long as it was associated with the Divine Beast, this meant that it was powerful.
Lin Lang threw a punch, and it actually transformed into an Azure Dragon.
Though this was only a simulation, it still showed just how strong he was.
Seeing the might of this punch, the purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman naturally revealed proud expressions.
This was their Young Master, a prodigy of the Imperial Clan!
Meanwhile, Lin Qi revealed an expression of jealousy.

He admitted that his natural talent was not much inferior to Lin Lang’s, but precisely because he came from a side branch, he was unable to learn the Imperial Technique, and was also unable to get the help of the Imperial Weapon to create a Fusion Cauldron.
Otherwise, he would also be able to stand proudly in front of Ling Han and knock this guy down with a single punch.
Boom!
The Azure Dragon surged over, unleashing an indescribable might.
Ling Han estimated Lin Lang’s battle prowess.
In terms of power, the latter had reached the First Heaven of the Core Formation Tier and above, but had not touched the Second Heaven yet.
It was probable that the former had fused the Nine Cauldrons into one.
Furthermore, the quality of the Celestial Cauldron was also very high, and would not be inferior to the Nine Coloured Glass Cauldron.
Otherwise, even if the cauldrons were fused, the power of the cauldron could not possibly be so strong.
And this attack had developed into the Azure Dragon.
It was very possible that it was a Saint Technique that had pushed the might of this punch to the height of Third Heaven and above.
This was very strong, enough to suppress any ordinary cultivator in the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
However, in front of Ling Han, this wasn’t enough.
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and xiu, a gust of wind shot out, just hitting the Azure Dragon’s head.
An incredibly deep power surged past, destroying everything in its path, blasting this Azure Dragon into smithereens.
What!
Upon seeing this, Lin Lang instantly wore an expression of disbelief.
Meanwhile, Lin Qi was also gaping in shock.
Meanwhile, the purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman both wore expressions of constipation.
Lin Qi had indeed seen Ling Han defeat Lu Qi before.
That was a prodigy of the Core Formation Tier, which was enough proof that Ling Han could match the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, or even surpass it.
But who was Lin Lang?
Imperial Son!
Hence, he believed that Lin Lang was even stronger, far beyond the reach of Lu Qi and Ling Han.
However, after exchanging blows, he finally realized that he had been wrong.
As it turned out, Ling Han’s strength was not inferior to the Imperial Son at all.
Lin Lang frowned slightly, and said, “I have underestimated you.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “I didn’t underestimate you, though.”
Lin Lang instantly felt anger rise up from the bottom of his heart.
He stared coldly at Ling Han, and said, “You can block a blow from me, but that does not mean that you are really capable of matching me!”
“One blow?” Ling Han asked calmly.
F***, it was another head-on strike!
Lin Lang clenched his fists tightly, his expression even uglier.
With a battle cry, he charged towards Ling Han, and no longer used long-distance attacks to kill him.

—Initially, he had thought that a casual action would be enough to let Ling Han know what true strength was, but now, if he did not use his true strength, it would be impossible for him to deal with this opponent.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
He attacked repeatedly, incredibly fierce, wanting to take Ling Han down with thunderous force.
Ling Han parried every move, completely unconcerned.
‘I really can’t underestimate the heroes of the world,’ he thought to himself.
‘Look, just a random person is a prodigy that has fused the Nine Cauldrons into one.
Then, would there be a super genius that has fused ten cauldrons into one?’
If Lin Lang knew what he was thinking, he would definitely be very depressed, because how many Imperial Clans were there in the whole universe?
Only the most important heirs of the Imperial Clans were qualified to create a Fusion Cauldron, and there were pitifully few of them.
“Kill!
Kill!
Kill!” Lin Lang shouted loudly.
His hair fluttered in the wind, and each strand of hair was entwined with astonishing energy.
If one strand floated down, it would be enough to kill a Nine Cauldrons prodigy.
Ling Han merely defended and did not attack.
He wanted to see the true Imperial Technique.
After exchanging a few dozen more blows, Lin Lang felt humiliated.
Previously, he had put on too much airs, and looked down on Ling Han, as if he would be able to deal with Ling Han in a few moves.
In the end?
They had already fought for so long, and the two of them were still in a tie.
How humiliating.
“Sword, come!” he shouted lightly, and the space between his brows split open, and a dark green long sword instantly flew out.
This was the standard replica of the Lin Clan’s Imperial Weapon, the Jade Water Sword.
Any important heir would have it, but with different cultivation levels and different identities, the might of the Jade Water Sword would also be different.
“Die!”
His hand gripped the hilt of his sword, and delivered a slash at Ling Han.
Weng, Sword Qi bloomed, dazzling and resplendent.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and the Starlight Screen spread open, wrapping around his fist, forming a layer of protection as he faced the sharp sword head-on.
Though the only Celestial Cauldron could absorb power, it did not have much protection against the slashes of sharp weapons.
Thus, if he wanted to take a sharp weapon head-on, it was better to use the Starlight Screen.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Ling Han’s fist collided with the sword’s blade, sending bursts of light into the surroundings.
Lin Lang shockingly discovered that even if he used his Spirit Tool, he was actually still unable to suppress Ling Han.
It should be known that this was a replica of the Imperial Weapon.
It had a sliver of Imperial Might, and could be claimed to be invincible.
But now, faced with Ling Han’s fist, it was actually unable to injure him in the slightest.
How could he accept this?
“Good one, brat!” he exclaimed lightly, withdrawing the last sliver of his contempt.
This person was powerful enough to rival him.
“Eight Heavenly King Techniques!” He sheathed his sword, then formed his hands into claws, adopting a very peculiar posture.
Imperial Technique!
Ling Han’s heart instantly clenched, and then a strong anticipation rose up in him.
He finally had a chance to compete with the Imperial Technique.
Boom, Lin Lang’s claw attacked.
It was like an Azure Dragon stretching out its claws, or like a divine phoenix hunting a flood dragon.
That aura was majestic and boundless.
The Imperial Technique was created by the Great Emperor, so it was naturally grand and majestic.
Ling Han finally became serious, and greeted the attack with the Great Overarching Heaven Technique.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and instantly, a figure was sent flying.
It was Lin Lang.
Even if he used the Imperial Technique, he could only stimulate his battle prowess to Fourth Heaven and above.
Compared to Ling Han, the gap was not just a little bit.
“What!” Lin Lang could not accept this.
He was a noble Imperial Son, and was a hundred times nobler than any Dao Child, yet he was actually no match for a lowly commoner.
How could he accept this?
“Ah!” His face was flushed red, and a terrifying aura surged from his body.
He was burning his Imperial Blood.
Even if he was the Imperial Son, and had a pure bloodline, it was actually relative.
However, he was not the first generation Imperial Son, after all, so the number of times he could burn the Imperial Blood was only a dozen over times more than Lin Qi.
This was his trump card.
Originally, he would not use it unless it was crucial, but now, an Imperial Son was actually no match for an ordinary ant.
This caused a great blow to his pride.
The pride of the Imperial Clan would not allow him to fail.
Thus, he was determined to defeat Ling Han at all costs.
The Imperial Blood ignited, and the effect was instantaneous.
His body suddenly expanded, turning into a giant that was as tall as 30 meters, possessing monstrous might.
“In front of the Imperial Clan, all are ants!” Lin Lang shouted loudly.
Then, he waved his palm towards Ling Han.
An extremely deep power reverberated, so terrifying that it could not be described.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Didn’t the Great Emperor also start off as an ordinary person?
On the other hand, has the Imperial Clan produced another Great Emperor?”
He leaped up, greeting Lin Lang’s attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 3964: Battering the Imperial Son
paragraphs: The Imperial Clan was indeed impressive. They basically had an Imperial Weapon as their overseer, and had deep roots. In fact, there was practically no gap in the ranks of Saints.

However, there was a strange phenomenon, and that was the Imperial Clan was no longer able to produce an Ancestral King. It was as if all their fortune had been used up that Ancestral King of the clan. Their descendants would be despised by the heaven and earth, and would be lacking that sliver of luck.
Becoming an Emperor was not only a matter of natural talent, hard work, and abilities. Luck was really indispensable.
Hence, a great many Great Emperors had all started from being ordinary.
Hearing Ling Han’s words, Lin Lang was speechless at first, then humphed, “You are really thick-skinned, to actually dare compare yourself to a future Great Emperor!”

Boom, his palm descended, and it was as if a house was pressing down, forming a dark mass. Ling Han leaped forwards, and his fist landed on that colossal palm. Instantly, a flash of light bloomed, and masses of seals exploded, forming a terrifying explosion.
However, after combusting his Imperial Blood, Lin Lang was truly too powerful. His battle prowess soared to the Ninth Heaven, and he could practically kill 99% of the Core Formation Tier cultivators.
Ling Han was instantly forcefully pressed down. Peng! The massive palm slammed into the ground, causing dust to fly into the air.
“Young Master is mighty!”
“Young Master is so domineering!”

The purple-robed man and red-clothed woman both called out, their expressions filled with reverence. Even if they were both in the Core Formation Tier, if it was them facing this attack, they could only die immediately.
Thus, Ling Han, who was in the Cauldron Forging Tier, was definitely going to die.
Lin Lang retracted his palm, causing dust to fly into the air again. Amidst the dust, a man was also standing tall like a javelin.
What!
The purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman both gaped, wearing expressions of disbelief. Meanwhile, Lin Qi wasn’t much better off either. His eyes were almost popping out of his head.
How was this possible?

Meanwhile, Lin Lang frowned. His opponent’s power was clearly several levels weaker than his. Logically speaking, with a palm strike from him, his opponent would definitely be turned into mush. How could he still be completely unscathed?
“Combusting the Imperial Blood is indeed very strong,” Ling Han remarked with a nod.

Lin Lang’s raw power could reach above First Heaven. After combusting the Imperial Blood, his power actually rushed up to Eighth Heaven. Then, he cast a Venerate Tier-level celestial technique, and his battle prowess easily broke through to Ninth Heaven.

It could only be said that the Ancestral King was really too strong, so strong that they had surpassed logic. Even if they had long since died, under the influence of the bloodline, it could actually cause their descendants to explode. This was truly terrifying.
Ling Han sighed ruefully on the other side, while Lin Lang was about to go crazy.
He had ignited his Imperial Blood, and he was still unable to defeat a cultivator of the same cultivation level?
Hu!
He waved his hands repeatedly, and rapidly delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Ling Han was unafraid, and brandished his fists in response.

Peng, peng, peng! After every attack, the ground would rumble, as if it was about to tear down the Holy Land. But in truth, the Holy Land had been reinforced by generations of Venerate Tier elites, and even a great battle on the level of Sect Master would only be able to blast down a few rocks.
However, this kind of battle also attracted a great many people.
“Yi, isn’t this Ling Han?”
“It can’t be, right? There is actually someone that can stand against him at the same cultivation level, and even has the upper hand?”
“Who is this monster?”
“Hiss, I get it! Look, Lin Qi is still at the side.”
“I understand now. That’s the descendant of the Ancestral King Fire Clouds!”
“In the case of Cauldron Forging Tier, only one person fits the criteria, and that is Lin Lang.”
“Imperial Son, Lin Lang!”

Everyone inhaled sharply. The Imperial Clan was transcendent, and would not be affected by the division of the four Heavenly Realms. For example, the Buddhist Race was even more so not one of the four Heavenly Realms, which had surpassed the mortal bonds.

And in the Galaxy Network’s rankings, though there were also figures of the Imperial Clan, they were only from a side branch like Lin Qi. It was impossible for a real Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter to appear.

For example, Prosperous Heaven. In fact, she was only the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Sect of North Heavenly Realm. However, only her beauty was ranked, and there was no information on her battle prowess.
However, in terms of battle prowess, she was definitely no weaker than Feng Jixing.
“Who would’ve thought? Ling Han actually alerted the Imperial Clan.”
“Sigh, it can’t be helped. In front of the Imperial Clan, no matter how supremely prodigious you are, you can only bow your head.”
“Because it is an Imperial Clan!”

Everyone felt rueful, and they all shook their heads. Whether it was Ling Han and Zhu Chengyun, the so-called number one person in Cauldron Forging Tier, their reputations were ranked with the Imperial Clan being excluded from consideration. Otherwise, to say nothing of number one, it was impossible for them to even be in the top ten.
However, those Imperial Daughters and Imperial Sons were too low-key, and had not Thus, most of them only left behind a name, and no

one could see their true appearance.
Hong! Hong! Hong
Lin Lang unleashed his might, beating down on Ling Han. In fact, he channelled out the Imperial Techniqueagain, intending to completely dispose of Ling Han.

However, faced with Ling Han’s only Celestial Cauldron, unless his battle prowess overwhelmed him by Six Heavens and above, this kind of attack would be completely disintegrated by the only Celestial Cauldron, and would not cause the slightest bit of effect.
However, Ling Han wasn’t the type to take a beating passively.
You use your ultimate move, and I don’t have any ultimate move?
The only Celestial Cauldron, came out!

With a thought from Ling Han, the massive Celestial Cauldron in his mind appeared above his head. Instantly, a vast and mighty aura circulated, as if an emperor was out on a tour. It was majestic and dignified, causing reverence to rise up from the bottom of one’s heart.

The Foundation Building Tier cultivators and Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators who were watching the battle in the distance instantly fell to their knees. Only the Core Formation Tier cultivators were exempted, though they were also a little terrified, as if they were
blaspheming against a Great Emperor.
Boom, the Celestial Cauldron’s aura surged out. Lin Lang gave a muffled humph, and his palm was instantly unable to continue its descent.

He paled in shock. He had ignited his Imperial Blood, and it was as if he were a Great Emperor from his youth, but now, he was actually feeling fear. Even his legs were weak, and he wanted to kneel down. This was too exaggerated, wasn’t it?
He was the Imperial Son, and the blood flowing in his body was the Imperial Bloodline. Just how high and noble was that? How could he kneel down?

Lin Lang forcefully suppressed it, but the Imperial Blood was cooling down on its own. His body had turned from 30 meters to 27 meters, and then from 27 meters to 24 meters... in a short while, he had returned to his original form.
He felt his head go numb. The burning of the Imperial Blood had not ended, and he had actually been forcefully beaten out of this state. This was practically like a dream.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “It’s my turn now, right?”
Xiu, he pounced out, and shot out a punch.
Peng! Faced with Ling Han’s might, Lin Lang was completely no match. He was sent flying with a single punch, and then fell heavily onto the ground, raising a cloud of dust.
Ling Han charged forward, swinging his fists mercilessly.
Peng, peng, peng! Lin Lang was thrashed, and could only curl his body into a ball, his hands protecting his vital points. Then, he could only allow Ling Han to attack him as he liked.
Seeing this scene, those who were watching the battle all spat out their tongues.
No way.

It had just been said that the Imperial Clan was invincible. The so-called number one Foundation Building Tier cultivator, the number one Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator were all named, with the Imperial Clans being excluded from consideration. Now, however, there was a member of the Imperial Clan that was being pressed onto the ground and thrashed.
How could they trust their own eyes?
Heavens, was he going to rewrite history, and create a legend?
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han was beating him up happily. F*ck, who had he trifled with? He
was really sick. Did he think he was an easy target to bully?
See if I won’t beat you to death, b@stard.

chapters.title: Chapter 3965: Leaving in shame and anger
paragraphs: Ling Han’s punches rained down, and Lin Lang could only take a beating. The Imperial Son was being beaten like a punching bag?
Er.
Everyone was speechless, and could only feel shock and admiration.
“Stop!” The purple-robed man and the red-clothed woman finally came back to their senses, and they both charged towards Ling Han.

Ling Han’s eyes sharpened. Two mere late stage Core Formation Tiers wanted to stop him? The Celestial Cauldron moved. Zi, the Primal Chaos Divine Thunder struck out at the purple- robed man, and a total of ten Divine Beasts appeared from the Celestial Cauldron, attacking the red-clothed woman together.

“Ah!” The purple-robed man immediately screamed in pain. How could he withstand the barrage of attacks above the Eighth Heaven of Core Formation Tier? He was immediately severed into two halves by the lightning, and under the terrifying destructive power, his mind directly exploded. He did not have the ability to burn Celestial Core to extend his life at all. That red-clothed woman was not much better off either. Being ganged up on by ten Divine Beasts, she could only barely defend herself, and she still wanted to save Lin Lang?
‘F*ck! F*ck! F*ck!’
Seeing this scene, everyone wanted to curse to vent the shock in their hearts.

One cultivator at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier had actually been insta-killed by Ling Han, whilke the other was trapped, and at the same time, Ling Han was still beating up an Imperial Son.
No matter how they looked at it, this sounded like a pipe dream, right?
However, this was happening right now.
“Ah! Ah! Ah!” Lin Lang roared in fury, yet could not get up no matter what. Without the support of the Imperial Blood, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
There was still a long way for him to go.

This was really a great humiliation. As a noble Imperial Son, he had come all the way here. Initially, he was just acting high and mighty, but who would have thought that it would become him asking for his own humiliation? How could he endure this?
How humiliating! This was far too humiliating!
Furthermore, after this loss, could he still continue to sit on the position of Imperial Son?
There were a great many people in the Lin Clan that were eyeing his position, waiting for him to make a mistake, and then replace him.
He had not given anyone a chance all this while, but who would have thought that this time, he had merely come out to strut around, and had actually gotten such an end.
When he returned, his status would be on the verge of collapse.
“Ling Han, that’s about enough.” An elite appeared. It was the Nine Mountains Venerate. He couldn’t just watch Lin Lang be beaten to death, right?

In truth, he could have stopped him long ago, but Lin Lang had come here to show off, and just because he had the backing of the Imperial Clan, he did not take the people from the Holy Land seriously. How could he not feel anger?
Thus, he simply watched as Lin Lang was pummeled. Only when he realized that he was about to die did he step forward to stop him.

Ling Han also knew that it was impossible for him to kill Lin Lang. Otherwise, the death of an Imperial Son would be a huge matter. Who knows, the Saints from the Lin Clan might charge over with the Imperial Weapon in hand.
At that time, if the Nine Suns Holy Land insisted on not handing him over, then the Saint could control the Imperial Weapon, which was completely capable of erasing the Nine Suns Saint.

Now, though the fact that the Imperial Son had been thrashed was also a big matter, this could only be blamed on Lin Lang’s incompetence. Just look, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, as the Imperial Son, you had still been defeated. How could you bring yourself to raise a fuss over this matter?
Ling Han retracted his hand and stepped to the side, as if nothing had happened.
Lin Lang stood up, his expression livid. However, he had already been beaten black and blue in the first place, so it was not very obvious. He stared at Ling Han, his eyes spitting fire.

He was outmatched, which only meant one thing. He was not strong enough, and was not qualified to become the Imperial Son.
In other words, losing this battle was not just a matter of pride. It was even possible that he would be stripped of his status as the Imperial Son. This enmity would naturally become
huge.

Lin Lang.

Just ask around, whose disciple could thrash the Imperial Son?

So what if they offended the Imperial Clan?
In the past, the Nine Suns Saint had thrashed quite a number of Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, and hadn’t he still started a domineering business?
