This time, it was Ling Han’s turn to wear a dark expression. F***, was this a compliment?

“Don’t worry. As long as you haven’t killed the heir of the Imperial Clan, the Holy Land will be able to bear any consequences for you. In the future, if you encounter any Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, just go ahead and beat them up boldly.” Nine Mountains Venerate waved
his hand, appearing very bold.
Was there anyone that would educate their disciple like this?
When everyone heard this, they did not know how to complain.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, as if he had only agreed to a small matter, and was completely
unconcerned.
What a pair of maniacs!
Everyone dispersed, and only Lin Qi was left scowling miserably. He was in a tight spot.

This time, Lin Lang had suffered a terrible defeat, and he would definitely be punished by the Lin Clan. Furthermore, in the eyes of the Nine Suns Holy Land, Lin Lang had been drawn here by him, so he would definitely be rejected and treated as an enemy by the disciples of the Holy
Land.
Actually, it was really not him who had invited Lin Lang here. He too felt very wronged.

After this small interlude, Ling Han continued to cultivate, spending most of his time comprehending the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique. At present, he had to learn as many high-level celestial techniques as possible. Then, when his cultivation level had reached a certain level, he would create his own celestial technique.
-All Imperial Technique Techniques were self-created. At most, they would only have some reference, but the main part would definitely be a Great Emperor’s unique understanding of heaven and earth.
The Saint Technique was profound, and Ling Han had cultivated in seclusion for two months in one go. However, he had only increased the might of this staff technique to 60%.
He felt that he had reached a bottleneck. It was already very difficult for him to improve by
just relying on this kind of closed-off method.
Next, he would either experience enlightenment, or go through a bloody battle, and that was what would allow him to have a breakthrough in this Saint-level staff technique.

would still be enduring the “demonic noise” attack of Prosperous Heaven, and at night, he wanted to relax his mind.
After circling around for a while, he suddenly saw a figure appear ahead of him. This person was very thin and lanky.

chapters.title: Chapter 3966: God Slaying Technique
paragraphs: At such a late hour, it was rare for someone else to be as idle and refined as him. Ling Han hurriedly chased after him. At a glance, this was an old man. He looked very, very old, but strangely, after taking a second look, he felt that he was very young.
This kind of feeling was really strange, and incredibly contradictory.
However, this wasn’t the strangest part. Instead, it was because this elder wasn’t a physical being!
He had encountered a ghost!
Ling Han was greatly shocked. This was the Holy Land, and there was actually a Yin soul that could walk around. This Yin soul was a little too strong, wasn’t it?
He hurriedly put on a defensive stance. He had already prepared the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
‘F*ck! Is Prosperous Heaven an idiot? There’s clearly a great yin soul here, yet she, the Holy Daughter of the Buddhist Race, actually didn’t detect it at all. She has failed her duty!’
“Yi, you can see me?” This Yin soul suddenly said. Of course, what he emitted was not sound, but the fluctuation of divine sense.
Ling Han was taken aback. This was a yin soul, but he still had consciousness?
This was a great monster!
“You really can see me!” The Yin soul old man nodded, then counted with his fingers, “Let me think, how many people have seen me?”
Ling Han originally wanted to attack, but when he heard the elder’s words, he forcefully suppressed the urge to attack, and asked, “Senior, how should I address you?”
“You live in my territory, yet you still ask who I am?” the Yin soul elder said with a smile. He then stopped pinching his fingers, and said, “You’re the tenth person to see me.”
Ling Han faltered for a moment, then almost jumped up, “You are the Nine Suns Saint!”
“You can be taught,” the Yin soul elder said with a nod.
No way, this was actually the founder of the Nine Suns Holy Land, the Nine Suns Saint, who had once rampaged through the galaxy and almost become an Ancestral King!
Impressive!
He had clearly been dead for hundreds of millions of years, but the yin soul still did not disperse.
“Brat, are you cursing me?” the Nine Suns Saint asked.
Ling Han spread out his hands, “How could that be!”
“He, how shameless of you. However, only in this way would you be able to live like a fish in water in this kind of world.” The Nine Suns Saint nodded.
Yi, did you make a deal with Nine Mountains Venerate to say the same words?

Ling Han had never imagined that he would actually encounter the Nine Suns Saint’s Yin soul in the Nine Suns Holy Land. Moreover, the Nine Suns Saint’s Yin soul actually seemed to be conscious. What Yin soul was this? It was practically as if he hadn’t died.
Could elites reach this level? They were clearly dead, so why did it seem like they were still alive?
Just look at Buddha Doga, he still had the might of a Pseudo-Emperor!
“Senior, do you have some unfulfilled wish?” Ling Han asked.

The Nine Suns Saint nodded, “At that time, I had not been able to become a Great Emperor, so there was indeed a barrier in my heart. Hence, I deliberately went to snatch a top grade mother tree, which could allow my soul to dissipate at an extremely slow pace. I would be able to see with my own eyes whether there would be any disciples among my descendants that could become Emperors.”

“In the end, ai, to say nothing of becoming an Emperor, not even one has become a Saint.” Ling Han grumbled in his mind. ‘Where the f*ck do you get eyes from? And you even saw it with your own eyes?’ He was extremely shameless, and he immediately said, “Senior, leave the matter of becoming an Emperor or a Saint to me. What supreme inheritance do you have? Why don’t you teach it all to me? Becoming an Emperor or a Saint also requires a foundation.” “In the past few hundred million years, there have been a total of 10 super geniuses that have managed to catch a glimpse of me, but in terms of shamelessness, you are number one,” the Nine Suns Saint said. “Even if that is what others think, you are the only one who could say it out loud.”
Ling Han was not the slightest bit embarrassed, “This only means that I am not the slightest bit of a hypocrite.”
The Nine Suns Saint laughed loudly, and said, “Alright, alright. Since you can see me, I’ll naturally teach you the ultimate technique.”
So that was how it was.
Ling Han sighed. If he had known earlier, he would have been more “shy” and made a good impression.
“Senior, how can I see you?” he asked.
The Nine Suns Saint had been dead for hundreds of millions of years, yet in such a long time, including him, only 10 people had seen his Yin soul. What kind of conditions did this require?
Moreover, he and the large black dog had searched the Holy Land many times before, and they hadn’t seen this ghost at all.
Could it be that he had gone to meet with some female ghost?
Ling Han couldn’t help but complain again.
“Nine Cauldrons fused into one, and it has to be done with one’s own power at that,” the Nine Suns Saint said.
Pu!

Ling Han immediately spluttered. No wonder he hadn’t seen the yin soul of the Nine Suns Saint before. No wonder only a mere 10 people had seen this dead Saint in these hundreds of millions of years. As it turned out, he had such high expectations.
-Though the Imperial Clans also had prodigies that had fused the Nine Cauldrons into one, how many of them had done so on their own?
“Aside from me, who are the other nine people?” Ling Han asked.

The Nine Suns Saint shook his head, and said, “They were all supremely talented individuals in the past. However, it’s a shame that seven of them died while they were still maturing. Two of them were killed because they were too powerful in the early stage, and they also expended too much of their life force. As such, their cultivation stopped at the fourth pinnacle level.” “According to Senior, the Saint Technique that you created has not been lost at all?” Ling Han asked.
“Naturally,” the Nine Yang Saint said. “However, I warned them not to reveal the secret, so they didn’t tell anyone.”
“Oh, that’s right. What kind of secret technique did you create in your old age?” Ling Han
asked in curiosity. At that time, the Nine Suns Saint was a supreme elite. The Nine Suns Finger was invincible against all Saints, and he could rival the Great Emperor, who had yet to attain
Dao.
And after he had failed to contest for the position of Emperor, just how powerful would the secret technique he had created in his later years be? It would definitely surpass the Nine Suns
Finger.
“God Slaying Technique!” the Nine Suns Saint said solemnly.
En, this name sounded domineering.
“At that time, I had touched a sliver of Emperor Tier, but had not managed to cross over into

that crucial step.” The Nine Suns Saint was filled with regret, “This is because what I have learnt all my life is too fierce. Sigh, it is easy to break when it is too strong. Though I have never believed it, and thought that as long as one’s strength reached the pinnacle, he would be able to ascend to the throne of Emperor in any path, reality has proven...”

He shook his head, and continued, “Afterwards, I began to deduce the Imperial Technique, but after all, I had only touched the slightest bit. Thus, this God Slaying Technique is only a semi-finished product. I hope that after I teach it to you, you will be able to complete it completely in future, and make it a true Imperial Technique.”
“Only a technique that you have created yourself is the strongest!”
The old geezer said solemnly.
Ling Han nodded in agreement.
It was not that the Imperial Technique was not strong, but rather that those who came later were all imitating it, and could not possibly obtain all the divine essence, and unleash 100%
of its might.

In the past, the Nine Suns Saint had practically no one in this world that could match him. Even the Imperial Son had to bow his head in submission, and that was because he had invented his own technique.
If Ling Han could complete the God Slaying Technique, it would be considered his own technique, and he would naturally be able to unleash its full might.
“Please teach me, senior!” Ling Han said solemnly.

The Nine Suns Saint did not keep Ling Han hanging. He immediately began to teach Ling Han the God Slaying Technique. However, this God Slaying Technique was really too profound, surpassing the level of Saint Technique, touching the boundary of the Imperial Technique.
Thus, after this night, Ling Han had only learnt a sliver of it.
“The power of the sun is more exhausting on my soul power. Come back at night,” the Nine Suns Saint said. Then, he disappeared in a flash.

However, this God Slaying Technique was really too profound, surpassing the level of Saint Technique, touching the boundary of the Imperial Technique.
Thus, after this night, Ling Han had only learnt a sliver of it.
“The power of the sun is more exhausting on my soul power.
Come back at night,” the Nine Suns Saint said.
Then, he disappeared in a flash.

chapters.title: Chapter 3967: Thick-skinned
paragraphs: A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He was extremely pleased.
Who would’ve thought that obtaining the ultimate inheritance of the Nine Suns Saint would actually require him to fuse the Nine Cauldrons into one?

This requirement was too high, too high. Only the super genius of the Imperial Clan could accomplish this. Furthermore, he had relied on the help of the Imperial Weapon. He had not achieved this with his own power at all.
There was nothing that could be done. The Nine Suns Saint had almost become an Emperor in the past, so his requirements were naturally very high.
He didn’t want to nurture another Saint. Instead, he wanted to nurture a Great Emperor!

However, Ling Han had also promised the Nine Suns Saint that he definitely wouldn’t teach the God Slaying Technique to anyone before he had completed the God Slaying Technique. At times, though he was two-faced, and others would hate him to the core, he had never failed to keep a promise that he had made. Thus, the God Slaying Technique would be a secret in his heart, and he would not reveal it even to the empress and the others.
After cultivating under the sun for half an hour, Ling Han returned.

He took some time to teach the empress and the others ultimate techniques such as the Fiery Sun Subduing Demon Staff Technique, the Eighteen Arhat Palm and others. This included the technique to suppress the Celestial Cauldrons so as to forge more Celestial Cauldrons.

Thinking about it, it was clear that the more Celestial Cauldrons formed by Cauldron Forging Tier, the stronger their battle prowess would be, and the deeper their foundations would be, and they would be able to rush to a higher level in future.

With the help of the divine substance, the empress and the others all formed Nine Coloured Glass Cauldrons, or Celestial Cauldrons of the same level. However, they were still a great distance away from the Primitive Celestial Gate Celestial Cauldron, as if there was a gulf between them.

In the past, if it was not for the Celestial Foundation that had been formed after leaping over the Primitive Celestial Gate, he would not have had the chance to cultivate the corresponding Celestial Cauldron.
This was naturally a great pity, and could only be compensated as much as possible.
Unsurprisingly, Prosperous Heaven was once again promoting the teachings of Buddha in front of his abode. Her willpower could be considered tenacious.
Don’t say, if one listened closely, this dharma of Buddhism was indeed filled with logic, causing one to involuntarily ponder, sinking deeper and deeper.
The power of a Great Emperor was naturally extraordinary.
Ling Han ignored her and focused on cultivating.
At night, he went to find the Nine Suns Saint to learn the God Slaying Technique. Day after day passed, and after seventeen days, he finally grasped the basics of this secret technique.
However, he had only mastered it, and was still some distance away from using it.
The Nine Suns Saint was already extremely stunned by this. This was because out of the nine people from before, the fastest to reach Ling Han’s level had also taken a whopping two months’ time.

He himself was a supreme prodigy, and had also seen countless prodigies. In fact, one of them had even become an Emperor in the end, but compared with Ling Han’s comprehension ability, he seemed to be slightly inferior.
Though having a high comprehension ability did not mean that he would definitely be able to reach the peak stage, he had at least met one condition.

“Brat, it’s extremely likely that you’ll be able to fulfill my long-cherished wish!” the Nine Suns Saint said with emotion. Ling Han’s comprehension ability had moved him greatly. It was extremely likely that he was the number one person in history. As long as he didn’t die, it wouldn’t be difficult for him to become a Saint. However, becoming an Emperor was not definite.
There were too many things that were needed. Fortune, factors, era, none of them could be missing.

Ling Han snickered, “Senior, what other good stuff do you have? Pass it on to this junior as well. You see, since this junior is so outstanding, if I die prematurely in the process, your wish would be completely wasted.”
The Nine Suns Saint was rendered speechless for a moment. After a while, he finally said, “Your comprehension ability is astonishingly high, but it still can’t compare to the thickness of your skin.”
What kind of nonsense was he spouting?
Ling Han simply smiled, not feeling the slightest bit apologetic.

However, what the Nine Suns Saint left behind was only a Yin soul. In fact, it did not have any offensive ability at all. It only had memories, and could pass on his ultimate technique. Otherwise, if the heaven and earth had a spirit, it would have long since sent down divine lightning to shatter this Yin soul.

“Brat, the fact that you were able to comprehend and master the comprehension of the God Slaying Technique is already enough for you to do as you please. Don’t be greedy and insatiable. You still haven’t reached the Saint Tier yet, and are still far from being able to combine the strengths of various fields and create your own celestial technique,” the Nine Suns Saint said seriously.
Sigh, since that was the case, what else could he do?

From now onwards, the Nine Suns Saint would not appear again for a very, very long time. Even if he had the top grade mother tree to nurture his soul, it was still dispersing bit by bit. Thus, since he had found Ling Han in this generation, he planned to go into a long slumber, and reappear in the next generation. If Ling Han did not become an Emperor, he could still find his next target.
He had done this for hundreds of millions of years.

Meanwhile, Ling Han asked this old man some questions, such as what exactly happened ten million years ago that actually caused the fortune of the North Heavenly Realm to drop to rock bottom, that it became far inferior to the other three Heavenly Realms.
The Nine Suns Saint couldn’t explain it either. He only knew that an earth-shattering battle had once taken place at the North Heavenly Realm.
This battle was far too brutal. In fact, it even shattered the fortune of the North Heavenly
Realm.

“There are a great many danger zones in this galaxy, and we definitely cannot go there. There would be great misfortune.” In the end, this Saint still gave a serious warning. He could tell that this disciple of the future generation was very bold.
“All right, I understand.” As Ling Han nodded, he memorized those secret places. When his cultivation level was higher in the future, he naturally would go and take a look.

The Lin Clan’s Imperial Son had been beaten, and this matter caused a great commotion on the Galaxy Network. A considerable number of Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all spoke on the Galaxy Network through others, saying that Lin Lang was only the weakest of the three Imperial Sons of the Lin Clan. If he encountered Lin Xuan or Lin Yun, then Ling Han would definitely have no option but to kneel.

Lin Xuan, the most outstanding Imperial Son of the Lin Clan. Supposedly, he had awakened his ancestral bloodline, and had a little of the might that Ancestral King Fire Clouds had once possessed. It was difficult to match him in the same cultivation level, and at present, he was already on the level of Sect Master.
Lin Yun was a True Self Tier elite. Though he was slightly inferior to Lin Xuan, he was even stronger than Lin Lang, who was at the same cultivation level as him.
Lin Xuan announced that although Lin Lang was no match for Ling Han because he wasn’t skilled enough, the Imperial Clan was not to be trifled with. If he saw Ling Han, he wouldn’t
mind casually erasing him.
When these words fell, everyone was worried for Ling Han.

If Lin Xuan really made a move, Ling Han’s only fate would definitely be death. “B@stard, if you anger me, I’ll use the Heavenly Dao Flame to burn you to death!” Ling Han thought to himself. If he was really angered, who would be afraid of whom?
Right at this moment, a piece of news spread out, once again alerting the galaxy, and also causing the hearts of the young prodigies to beat wildly.
-The Donglin Imperial Clan sent out an invitation, inviting all the prodigies of the world to participate in the Dao Tournament.
Being able to participate in this kind of gathering was a kind of approval. Furthermore, sparring and discussing dao with a top prodigy would definitely be extremely helpful in
improving one’s strength.
More importantly, the Imperial Daughter of the Donglin Clan also wanted to take advantage
of this opportunity to choose a husband, and cultivate the supreme ultimate technique, Heavenly Brilliance Technique, with her.
“Ao, ao, ao!” The large black dog scuttled over, “Little Han, let’s set out quickly and marry
the Imperial Daughter!”
“You don’t even know what she looks like, and you want to marry her?” Ling Han asked with a
smile.

“Hehe, you’re really too ignorant and ill-informed. Could it be that you don’t know that this Imperial Daughter is the third most beautiful woman on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard?” the large black dog called out. “And this is only because she only showed her face occasionally, and did not leave behind any pictures. It’s said that those who have seen her all think that she is the number one beauty in the world!”
“Oh.” Ling Han nodded, but was not the slightest bit moved.

chapters.title: Chapter 3968 Disdain
paragraphs: 3968 Disdain

“Little Han, Imperial Technique, Imperial Technique!” When the large black dog saw that Ling Han was completely unmoved, he hurriedly continued, “Just think, as long as you marry this Chi Menghan, you would be the son-in-law of the Imperial Clan. Whatever Imperial Technique there is, you can learn as you like.”
“Sure, you can go and marry her. Even if you take human form, you still look fine. In future, you can just teach me,” Ling Han said. He did not want to use a honey trap.
“Pei, there is a natural gulf between Grandpa Dog and her. I only like the beauties of the Dog Race,” the large black dog immediately protested.
Meanwhile, the pervert pig rolled his eyes. These two shameless guys. Did they really think that they would be able to marry the Imperial Daughter if they went?
However, as he imagined how the third most beautiful woman in the world would be beautiful, the pervert pig couldn’t help but gape and drool.

“Sigh, Little Han, it’s better for you to go,” the large black dog egged him on. “Grandpa Dog is also mighty and extraordinary, but I haven’t cultivated Ten Cauldrons or Fusion Cauldron yet, after all. Thus, your chances are higher.”
It was rare to see the large black dog act so modest. Ling Han chuckled, but still didn’t agree.
This matter was set aside for the moment, but three days later, there was further news.
As it turned out, though the Donglin Imperial Clan had sent out invitations widely, they had left out only the North Heavenly Realm.
The prodigies from the East, South and West Heavenly Realm had all begun getting invitations, but the North Heavenly Realm was an exception. None of them received an invitation.

Afterwards, the Donglin Imperial Clan even made a special clarification on the Galaxy Network, saying that the North Heavenly Realm’s fortune had declined, and someone from there attaining even Saint Tier would be as difficult as ascending the heavens, so how could he be qualified to participate in such a gathering of prodigies?
Hence, they did not even bother to send out an invitation, to avoid wasting time.
When the news spread out, all of the North Heavenly Realm was in an uproar.
F***, this was looking down on them too much, wasn’t it?
That’s right. The North Heavenly Realm had indeed been weaker all this time, but was it that bad, that they disdained from even issuing them an invitation?
When they found out about this, there was naturally another round of heated discussions on the Galaxy Network.
Theelites from the Eastern, Southern, and Western Heavenly Realms all expressed that the Donglin Imperial Clan had done a good job.
Although a powerful guy had appeared in the North Heavenly Realm, this could not change the present state of its weakness. Furthermore, could one person be capable of changing a whole Heavenly Realm?
No!
Unless he was a Great Emperor.
“Just obediently stay in the North Heavenly Realm, don’t come out and embarrass yourself.”
“Weaklings need to have self-awareness.”
“Hehe, when has it ever been the turn of the North Heavenly Realm’s people to call themselves prodigies? What a joke.”

Under the barrage of mockery, the North Heavenly Realm elites were naturally filled with anger. However, this was indeed the case, so what could they say? Moreover, this bomb had been thrown by the Donglin Imperial Clan, so who dared to question an Imperial Clan?
When Ling Han found out, he came to a decision.
He wanted to go to the Donglin Imperial Clan!

If they didn’t send him an invitation, he would go on his own and win a spot. At that time, he would win first place in the prodigy gathering. He would flee after learning the Imperial Technique, and also slap the Donglin Imperial Clan in the face.

Of course, he definitely couldn’t use his original appearance. It didn’t matter. He had the Soul Forming Technique, so after changing his appearance and soul fluctuation, he would have nothing to do with him in the future.

“Little Han, have you decided to go?” When the large black dog found out, he immediately jumped up and down, appearing to be extremely excited, “That’s right. Grandpa Dog also thinks that they have gone too far. Is there any need to mock others like this?”

At first, Ling Han had planned to set out alone. That way, he would not leave behind any clues, but the large black dog insisted on going with him. Ling Han thought for a moment, and decided to bring it along with him.

The large black dog’s cultivation level wasn’t low, and he was already at the Six Cauldrons. Apart from the Demonic Monkey Fists, he had also mastered a considerable number of Venerate Tier-level Techniques and Saint Techniques. He could be considered a powerful helper.
“Sure, but you have to disguise yourself.”
“No problem. When it comes to disguise, Grandpa Dog is best at it.”

The two troublemakers moved out. Since the Donglin Imperial Clan didn’t send invitations to the North Heavenly Realm, the first thing they had to do was leave the North Heavenly Realm and head to the East Heavenly Realm or the West Heavenly Realm.
Territory-wise, their journey to the Western Heaven Realm was slightly closer.
Ling Han went to pay a visit to Nine Mountains Venerate, and said that he wanted to ask for his help to send them to the West Heavenly Realm.
If a Venerate Tier elite was willing to make a move, and directly tear a rip into space to travel, then they would probably be able to reach the West Heavenly Realm in ten days at most.
Nine Mountains Venerate considered for a moment before asking, “Are you going to the Donglin Imperial Clan?”
“Yes.” Ling Han didn’t hide anything, and said, “However, I’ll conceal my identity so that no one can see through me.”
As he spoke, he had already channeled the Soul Forming Technique, and the fluctuation of his soul immediately underwent a slight change.
Nine Mountains Venerate was astonished. He then nodded, and said, “It’s indeed amazing. However, it might be a bit difficult to fool a Saint.”
“I will be careful,” Ling Han said.

Nine Mountains Venerate was silent for a moment before saying, “Fine, I’ll send you to the Western Heaven Realm! Humph, it is not like no Ancestral Kings or powerful Saints have ever walked out of the North Heavenly Realm. We have only been silent for a while, and they actually dare to look down on us so much!”
“Brat, go and make a good fuss!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but think, ‘This guy is actually also hot-tempered.’

Nine Mountains Venerate was not the slightest bit sloppy in his actions. After Ling Han called the large black dog over, he immediately grabbed the human and dog, tore a rip into space, and headed towards the West Heavenly Realm.

There was no need for them to travel through Transfer Formations one after another, and there was no need for them to take a detour at all, so it was naturally extremely time-saving. In just ten days, they had arrived at the West Heavenly Realm.

And this was still because Ling Han and the large black dog’s physiques were relatively weak. During this period, they would have to stop to rest and recover. If it was the Nine Mountains Venerate alone, then he would be able to reach here in five days, at most.
“Be careful and act according to the circumstances,” Nine Mountains Venerate said to Ling Han.
“Thank you, Senior,” Ling Han said with a bow.
Nine Mountains Venerate tore a rip into space and left, leaving only Ling Han and the large black dog behind.
“Little Han, what do we do next?” the large black dog asked.
“Change your appearance first,” Ling Han said. “In future, others only need to investigate where there is a perverted large black dog, and they would be able to immediately find Nine Suns Holy Land.”
“Woof! Grandpa Dog is so brilliant and mighty, so how is he perverted?!” the large black dog said in defiance.
However, his appearance definitely had to be changed. The large black dog transformed into a black bull, but that vulgar air couldn’t be erased no matter what it transformed into.
Ling Han sighed, but whatever, as long as it was not related to the image of a dog.
He also changed his appearance. The Soul Forming Technique was activated, and the wave of his soul also underwent a slight change.
“From now onwards, my name is... Ding Yi!” he said, stroking his chin.
“Then Grandpa Dog, no, Grandpa Bull’s name is Ding Er,” the large black dog immediately said.
In any case, it was only a pseudonym, so there was no need for him to have a name with a noble air. Thus, Ling Han did not consider it seriously.
“What do we do now?” the large black dog asked.
“Naturally, to get a name for ourselves, and only then would we be able to gain the attention of the Donglin Holy Land and obtain an invitation.”
The large black dog connected to the Galaxy Network and grinned. “A prodigy from the West Heavenly Realm just happened to come here, so let’s go beat him up!”

Apart from the Demonic Monkey Fists, he had also mastered a considerable number of Venerate Tier-level Techniques and Saint Techniques.
He could be considered a powerful helper.
“Sure, but you have to disguise yourself.”
“No problem.
When it comes to disguise, Grandpa Dog is best at it.”
The two troublemakers moved out.

Since the Donglin Imperial Clan didn’t send invitations to the North Heavenly Realm, the first thing they had to do was leave the North Heavenly Realm and head to the East Heavenly Realm or the West Heavenly Realm.
Territory-wise, their journey to the Western Heaven Realm was slightly closer.
Ling Han went to pay a visit to Nine Mountains Venerate, and said that he wanted to ask for his help to send them to the West Heavenly Realm.
If a Venerate Tier elite was willing to make a move, and directly tear a rip into space to travel, then they would probably be able to reach the West Heavenly Realm in ten days at most.
Nine Mountains Venerate considered for a moment before asking, “Are you going to the Donglin Imperial Clan?”
“Yes.” Ling Han didn’t hide anything, and said, “However, I’ll conceal my identity so that no one can see through me.”
As he spoke, he had already channeled the Soul Forming Technique, and the fluctuation of his soul immediately underwent a slight change.
Nine Mountains Venerate was astonished.
He then nodded, and said, “It’s indeed amazing.
However, it might be a bit difficult to fool a Saint.”
“I will be careful,” Ling Han said.
Nine Mountains Venerate was silent for a moment before saying, “Fine, I’ll send you to the Western Heaven Realm!
Humph, it is not like no Ancestral Kings or powerful Saints have ever walked out of the North Heavenly Realm.
We have only been silent for a while, and they actually dare to look down on us so much!”
“Brat, go and make a good fuss!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but think, ‘This guy is actually also hot-tempered.’
Nine Mountains Venerate was not the slightest bit sloppy in his actions.
After Ling Han called the large black dog over, he immediately grabbed the human and dog, tore a rip into space, and headed towards the West Heavenly Realm.
There was no need for them to travel through Transfer Formations one after another, and there was no need for them to take a detour at all, so it was naturally extremely time-saving.
In just ten days, they had arrived at the West Heavenly Realm.
And this was still because Ling Han and the large black dog’s physiques were relatively weak.
During this period, they would have to stop to rest and recover.
If it was the Nine Mountains Venerate alone, then he would be able to reach here in five days, at most.
“Be careful and act according to the circumstances,” Nine Mountains Venerate said to Ling Han.
“Thank you, Senior,” Ling Han said with a bow.
Nine Mountains Venerate tore a rip into space and left, leaving only Ling Han and the large black dog behind.
“Little Han, what do we do next?” the large black dog asked.
“Change your appearance first,” Ling Han said.
“In future, others only need to investigate where there is a perverted large black dog, and they would be able to immediately find Nine Suns Holy Land.”
“Woof!
Grandpa Dog is so brilliant and mighty, so how is he perverted?!” the large black dog said in defiance.
However, his appearance definitely had to be changed.
The large black dog transformed into a black bull, but that vulgar air couldn’t be erased no matter what it transformed into.
Ling Han sighed, but whatever, as long as it was not related to the image of a dog.
He also changed his appearance.
The Soul Forming Technique was activated, and the wave of his soul also underwent a slight change.
“From now onwards, my name is...
Ding Yi!” he said, stroking his chin.
“Then Grandpa Dog, no, Grandpa Bull’s name is Ding Er,” the large black dog immediately said.
In any case, it was only a pseudonym, so there was no need for him to have a name with a noble air.
Thus, Ling Han did not consider it seriously.
“What do we do now?” the large black dog asked.
“Naturally, to get a name for ourselves, and only then would we be able to gain the attention of the Donglin Holy Land and obtain an invitation.”
The large black dog connected to the Galaxy Network and grinned.
“A prodigy from the West Heavenly Realm just happened to come here, so let’s go beat him up!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3969 Perverted large black dog
paragraphs: 3969 Perverted large black dog
“Who is it?” Ling Han asked.
“Chen Dong,” the large black dog said. “Ranked in the 300s on the Galaxy Network.”
“So low?” Ling Han frowned.

“Don’t look down on him. Even among the Cauldron Forging Tier elites of the Western Heavenly Realm, he can rank in the 100s.” The large black dog said, “Now, those who are ranked higher have already received invitations from the Donglin Imperial Clan. Thus, those who haven’t received invitations and are ranked higher can no longer sit still, wanting to prove through actual battle that they are worthy of being invited by the Donglin Imperial Clan.”
“All right, then we’ll knock down this Chen Dong first,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Let Grandpa Dog do it, no, Grandpa Bull do it.” The large black dog seemed to be in high spirits.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “If he is ranked in the top 400 of the Galaxy Network, he is probably Six Cauldrons. You do indeed have a chance of winning.”

“That’s for sure. Grandpa Bull has cultivated the Saint Technique!” The large black dog summoned a black staff, which he slammed onto the ground, “From now onwards, Grandpa Bull is the Herculean Bull Demon King, Ding Er!”
“Let’s go.”

Ling Han and the large black dog set off. The two of them soon arrived at a city, and after some investigation, they found out that Chen Dong was hosting a tournament at the summit of the Long Mountains.

Hehe, in truth, Chen Dong’s thoughts were more or less the same as Ling Han and the large black dog. He wanted to show off his strength through battle, so that he could gain the notice of the Donglin Imperial Clan, so they would send him an invitation.

The Long Mountains was the most famous place on this planet. Because no Saint had ever appeared here, and there was a Venerate Tier cultivator that attempted to break through to Saint Tier in the Long Mountains. Though he ultimately failed and died, this was considered a Holy Land by the people of this planet.
Now, there was still a powerful pressure enshrouding this place. Those whose willpower was not strong enough would not be qualified to ascend the mountain at all, what more reach the summit.
Thus, a great many prodigies liked to use the Long Mountains as a place for sparring, so that it would appear grand and noble.
Ling Han and the large black dog arrived at the foot of the mountain, and gazed at the summit.
Ling Han and the large black dog arrived at the foot of the mountain, and gazed at the summit.
“So tall,” the large black dog sighed ruefully.
“Stop pretending to be profound. Let’s go.”
Ling Han took the lead, clasping his hands behind his back, every step very leisurely.
“Wait for Grandpa Bull!” the large black dog shouted, and hurriedly followed after him.

One of them was Ten Cauldrons fused into one, while the other had also formed Six Cauldrons. Walking here was completely effortless on their part, and the so-called pressure could be considered ordinary.

In less than ten minutes, they had arrived at the summit, and saw that there were indeed a great many people here. They were standing in a circle around the platform in the centre, and on the platform, there were presently two people sparring.

This platform was extremely sturdy. In the past, it had been the place where that Venerate had comprehended the Dao of Saint Tier. Thus, though he had failed in his attempt to break through to Saint Tier, there was still a sliver of Dao left behind, which strengthened this platform. It was definitely not something that the Core Formation Tier or even the True Self Tier could shatter.
When Ling Han and the large black dog arrived, the battle on the platform was also drawing to a close. A person was sent flying, and fell off the platform.
“Lost again!”
“Sigh, as expected of Chen Dong. His Galaxy’s Network ranking of over 300 isn’t just for show.”
“As I see it, his battle prowess should be more than three hundred by now. It is very possible that it has reached more than two hundred, or even more than a hundred in fact.”
Everyone was rueful, and then their expressions were filled with admiration.

In truth, as long as one could squeeze into the top 10,000 of the Galaxy Network, they could be considered one of the top prodigies in any galaxy. Thus, Chen Dong’s ranking was as high as 300, so he was naturally chillingly strong.

Ling Han looked towards the platform, and saw that the only man standing proudly looked to be about twenty-four or twenty-five years old. He had a sturdy build, and his hair was slightly golden. His eyes were very special, and his pupils were yellow in colour.
“This guy doesn’t seem to be a human,” the large black dog said softly.
“He really doesn’t look like it,” Ling Han said with a nod.

“Haha, the two of you are really too ignorant and ill-informed. Could it be that you don’t know that Chen Dong is a prodigy of the Ice Wolf Tribe?” Someone beside them heard them, and immediately said proudly to them, as if he was introducing his son.
Sure enough, he wasn’t a human.
Ling Han sighed. The large black dog also sighed. Although it wasn’t a human, it had developed intelligence after all, so it couldn’t be treated as meat. It was a pity.
The person beside him was baffled. Why was he sighing?

“Is there anyone else who would like to spar with me?” Chen Dong asked from the stage. He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his demeanor elegant. He had indeed lived up to his reputation as a young prodigy.

Everyone shook their heads. This was far from enough. Previously, they had only heard of Chen Dong’s strength, and thought that no matter how strong he was, he would not be able to surpass them by much, but after the actual battle, they finally knew just how wide the gap was.
“Chen Dong, let me spar with you!” Right at this moment, a voice suddenly rang out.
Shua, everyone looked towards the source of the sound, and saw that the speaker was actually a sturdy black bull. The fur all over its body was as smooth as satin, and it looked extremely handsome.
However, this black bull’s behind was actually covered with a pair of iron underwear. This instantly destroyed its handsome aura completely, turning it completely into a pervert.

Everyone was astounded. He could even open his mouth and speak like this, so it was obvious that this was not a wild beast, but rather a Demonic Beast. Since it was a Demonic Beast, it should have taken human form after advancing into Celestial Path.
Everyone knew that the form of a human was the most suitable for cultivation. Looking at history, the Great Emperors that the Demon Race had produced were also human forms.
He, this black bull was really unique.

Chen Dong frowned. He was unafraid of challenges. In fact, he hoped to encounter elites. The stronger they were, the better. That was because only by defeating this kind of elite would his impact be heavy enough, winning him a ticket to the Donglin Imperial Clan.
However, it would be too demeaning for him to spar with such a large black bull that was exuding a perverse aura all over its body.
However, with a leap, the large black dog arrived on the platform.
It stood up on its hind legs, then peered down at its surroundings, and said ruefully, “Sigh, being invincible is really lonely!”
‘Holy f*ck!’
Everyone was complaining endlessly. You haven’t even f started fighting, and you are already boasting that you are invincible and lonely. How could there be such a shameless pers... bull!

“Humph, this must be a hybrid bull. Our Azure Sky Black Demon Bull Tribe does not recognize it as a member of our tribe!” On the sidelines, a large man with horns on his head declared, hurriedly drawing a dividing line between himself and the large black dog.
This caused everyone to roar with laughter. He was actually despised by his own clansmen; this was too much of a failure.
The large black dog snickered, and with a low growl, he had already charged towards Chen Dong.
The moment they clashed, Chen Dong’s expression changed drastically, and everyone was gritting their teeth.

This was because the large black dog’s attacks were far too despicable. He focused on attacking below the waist, with Chen Dong’s crotch as his main target. Meanwhile, his behind was naturally also a target of special attention. It could be said that he was extremely despicable.
They were really dumbfounded. This large black ox clearly looked sturdy and bold, but why was it so vulgar the moment it attacked?
One couldn’t judge a book by its cover, and it was the same to be said for a bull.
Chen Dong was beside himself with rage, and he roared, “You’re seeking death!”
Boom! He unleashed a devastating aura as he unleashed his full power. He was going to dispose of the large black dog as quickly as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 3970 Double Kill
paragraphs: 3970 Double Kill

Although the large black dog hadn’t fought many times since arriving in this world, he had fought all the way to the Heavenly Venerable Tier in the Genesis World, so his battle experience was naturally impressive.
From the very beginning, it was vulgar and obscene. This was indeed in line with its style, but part of it was also deliberately trying to anger Chen Dong.
In a state of rage, the might of the attack would indeed increase accordingly, but it would also affect judgement, and reveal flaws.
Sure enough, Chen Dong’s attacks were extremely domineering. Each of his attacks possessed astonishing power, yet his accuracy was still below par. The large black dog easily dodged his attacks.
Repetitively attacking in this way, he was ultimately exhausted. Once Chen Dong’s burst of power had passed, his battle prowess clearly declined.
“If Grandpa Bull doesn’t show his might, do you think i am a sick cat?” The large black dog began to launch a powerful counterattack.
It was really very strong.

In truth, those that had come out of Genesis World were all incredibly prodigious beings. After all, they had fought their way out of millions and millions of living beings, so how extraordinary was it to be able to reach the Heavenly Venerable Tier?

Though the large black dog had leaped over the Golden Celestial Gate, with the help of the divine substance, it had now formed the Obsidian Celestial Cauldron. Its grade was completely not inferior to the Nine Colored Glass Cauldron. Thus, with both of them being Six Cauldrons, its strength was actually superior to Chen Dong’s.
However, as a screw-over, if he could screw his opponent over, why did he have to do it head-on?
Thus, the large black dog would first exhaust Chen Dong’s explosive power before launching a counterattack. This would naturally be even more effective.
The pitiful Chen Dong was instantly suppressed by the large black dog after losing this opportunity. He was completely unable to counterattack.
“Look at Grandpa Bull’s Strength Demon Ox Palm!”
“Black Horn Charge!”
“Divine Bull’s Tail Swing!”

The large black dog continued to bark as he fought. He wasn’t simply reciting the names of his techniques, and he didn’t stop cursing either. He was already cursing all the way from Chen Dong’s father to his seventh ancestor.
Chen Dong was infuriated upon hearing this. In fact, he was even more infuriated than when the large black dog pressed him to the ground and pummeled him.
Everyone was also rendered speechless.
They could see very clearly that this black bull’s battle prowess was really not weak. It was not inferior to Chen Dong at all. In fact, it had even surpassed him.
Since he was so awesome, why didn’t he defeat Chen Dong in an open and aboveboard manner?

You are so mean, coming up first to anger him, so that he would waste his ultimate move, and then spouting vulgarities, causing him to continue to be fuming with anger, and his attacks to become even more chaotic. This was completely an unjust victory.
If he won like this, who would recognize his victory?
Yet the large black dog was completely unconcerned. All he cared about was the result. It was fine as long as he won. As for the rest, what did it have to do with him?
“Last move, Demonic Bull Charge!”
Peng!
The large black dog charged over and rammed its horns into Chen Dong, instantly sending him flying.
However, the large black dog also rubbed his head, feeling a slight pain.
It couldn’t be helped. Its horns were only manifestations, and it wasn’t a real bull. Could its horns compare to a Spirit Tool of the same level?
“Ai, really too weak, too weak!” The large black dog shook its large black bull hooves, “It can’t be helped. Us brothers are men who are going to trample that Ling Han from the North Heavenly Realm!”
Even if the large black dog won, everyone felt an urge to rush up and give him a thrashing. Why was this guy so detestable?
But from what this black bull had said, it actually still wanted to challenge Ling Han?
“Hehe, though I also look down on the weaklings of the North Heavenly Realm, Ling Han is indeed strong, defeating even an Imperial Son.”
“Black Bull, you are still a million miles away from Ling Han!”
“Hurry up and scram. You are not welcome here.”
Everyone said.

The large black dog stood on the platform with his hands clasped behind his back, showing off endlessly, “Sigh, since ancient times, elites have all been lonely. How could you mortals know of Grandpa Bull’s invincible heart?”
Everyone was speechless. Once this person was thick-skinned to the point of being shameless, what else was there to say?

“No one has come out to battle yet?” The large black dog started to attract animosity everywhere, “Grandpa Bull disdains from bullying you guys, so just let my little brother move. Whoever can take ten moves from him will be considered as Grandpa Bull’s loss.”
It pointed at Ling Han.
Shua, instantly, a great many eyes turned towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and leaped onto the platform, his expression proud.
This Ding Yi’s persona was arrogant and domineering, so he could be as arrogant as he liked.
Immediately, some were dissatisfied and jumped onto the stage to issue a challenge. They were no match for this large black bull, so could it be that this person could also be so awesome?
Ling Han made a tapping motion with his finger. Peng! The person was sent flying.
The first battle was won.
Everyone shuddered upon seeing this. This person was far too powerful!
One after another, more people stepped forward to challenge Ling Han. However, they were all defeated by Ling Han with a single strike. No one could withstand a second strike.
The truth was indeed so. Aside from Origin, Myriad Dao, Imperial Sons or Imperial Daughters, who else in Cauldron Forging Tier could withstand a single move from Ling Han?
After Ling Han defeated thirteen people in a row, no one dared to challenge him again.
Anyone could tell that though this person did not have as bad a mouth as the large black dog, but his abilities were not the slightest bit inferior, and he was overwhelmingly strong.
Peng! A figure landed on the platform. It was none other than Chen Dong.
He had already recovered. Furthermore, he also clearly realized that he had been too rash previously, and had been tricked by the large black dog’s psychological tactic.
Since he knew this, he would definitely not fall for it again if they battled again.
“Step aside!” he said coldly to Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and gave Chen Dongjian the middle finger.

Originally, with one person and one bull, the large black bull insulting them, and Ling Han being so arrogant and domineering, no one would believe they were brothers, but when they saw Ling Han raising his middle finger, everyone felt a sense of familiarity.
F***, the style was similar.

“You’re seeking death!” Chen Dong roared. However, he immediately composed himself and suppressed his anger. He didn’t want to make the same mistake again. As a prodigy, he still had some self-control.
“You brothers are indeed the same type of people!” he said through gritted teeth, “I will teach you a good lesson!”
Xiu, his figure darted out, and charged towards Ling Han.
This pounce was extraordinarily fast, like a bolt of lightning.
Ling Han smiled faintly. How could this kind of speed escape his eyes? He casually raised his fist, placing it in front of him.
Then, everyone saw an incredibly strange scene. Chen Dong seemed to be deliberately making things difficult for himself, and crashed his face into Ling Han’s fist.
Peng!
There was a loud bang, and this collision was solid. Then, Chen Dong’s whole person was seen to be sent flying, drawing out an arc in the air, and falling onto the platform.
This...
Everyone was surprised. It was a coincidence?
How was this possible!
It could only be that Ling Han had grasped the trajectory of Chen Dong’s attack in advance, and had then gotten into position, waiting for Chen Dong himself to crash head-first into him.
Furthermore, just how terrifying was Ling Han’s power, to be able to use stillness to restrain movement, and send Chen Dong flying backwards?
Strong, so strong!

“This is what a good son of our Bull Tribe should be like!” The cultivator from the Bull Tribe from before immediately cheered loudly. This victory was too beautiful. He did not look at all like the large black dog that kept screwing over his opponent.
Ling Han’s expression involuntarily darkened. “I’m a human!”
Er!
That Bull Tribe cultivator’s mouth was half-gaping, his face filled with astonishment. ‘Aren’t you two brothers?’
“Brother, you can’t forget your roots as a bull!” he said with a serious expression. “You can’t forget our roots just because you’ve taken human form!”

Thus, the large black dog would first exhaust Chen Dong’s explosive power before launching a counterattack.
This would naturally be even more effective.
The pitiful Chen Dong was instantly suppressed by the large black dog after losing this opportunity.
He was completely unable to counterattack.
“Look at Grandpa Bull’s Strength Demon Ox Palm!”
“Black Horn Charge!”
“Divine Bull’s Tail Swing!”
The large black dog continued to bark as he fought.
He wasn’t simply reciting the names of his techniques, and he didn’t stop cursing either.
He was already cursing all the way from Chen Dong’s father to his seventh ancestor.
Chen Dong was infuriated upon hearing this.
In fact, he was even more infuriated than when the large black dog pressed him to the ground and pummeled him.
Everyone was also rendered speechless.
They could see very clearly that this black bull’s battle prowess was really not weak.
It was not inferior to Chen Dong at all.
In fact, it had even surpassed him.
Since he was so awesome, why didn’t he defeat Chen Dong in an open and aboveboard manner?

You are so mean, coming up first to anger him, so that he would waste his ultimate move, and then spouting vulgarities, causing him to continue to be fuming with anger, and his attacks to become even more chaotic.
This was completely an unjust victory.
If he won like this, who would recognize his victory?
Yet the large black dog was completely unconcerned.
All he cared about was the result.
It was fine as long as he won.
As for the rest, what did it have to do with him?
“Last move, Demonic Bull Charge!”
Peng!
The large black dog charged over and rammed its horns into Chen Dong, instantly sending him flying.
However, the large black dog also rubbed his head, feeling a slight pain.
It couldn’t be helped.
Its horns were only manifestations, and it wasn’t a real bull.
Could its horns compare to a Spirit Tool of the same level?
“Ai, really too weak, too weak!” The large black dog shook its large black bull hooves, “It can’t be helped.
Us brothers are men who are going to trample that Ling Han from the North Heavenly Realm!”
Even if the large black dog won, everyone felt an urge to rush up and give him a thrashing.
Why was this guy so detestable?
But from what this black bull had said, it actually still wanted to challenge Ling Han?
“Hehe, though I also look down on the weaklings of the North Heavenly Realm, Ling Han is indeed strong, defeating even an Imperial Son.”
“Black Bull, you are still a million miles away from Ling Han!”
“Hurry up and scram.
You are not welcome here.”
Everyone said.
The large black dog stood on the platform with his hands clasped behind his back, showing off endlessly, “Sigh, since ancient times, elites have all been lonely.
How could you mortals know of Grandpa Bull’s invincible heart?”
Everyone was speechless.
Once this person was thick-skinned to the point of being shameless, what else was there to say?
“No one has come out to battle yet?” The large black dog started to attract animosity everywhere, “Grandpa Bull disdains from bullying you guys, so just let my little brother move.
Whoever can take ten moves from him will be considered as Grandpa Bull’s loss.”
It pointed at Ling Han.
Shua, instantly, a great many eyes turned towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and leaped onto the platform, his expression proud.
This Ding Yi’s persona was arrogant and domineering, so he could be as arrogant as he liked.
Immediately, some were dissatisfied and jumped onto the stage to issue a challenge.
They were no match for this large black bull, so could it be that this person could also be so awesome?
Ling Han made a tapping motion with his finger.
Peng!
The person was sent flying.
The first battle was won.
Everyone shuddered upon seeing this.
This person was far too powerful!
One after another, more people stepped forward to challenge Ling Han.
However, they were all defeated by Ling Han with a single strike.
No one could withstand a second strike.
The truth was indeed so.
Aside from Origin, Myriad Dao, Imperial Sons or Imperial Daughters, who else in Cauldron Forging Tier could withstand a single move from Ling Han?
After Ling Han defeated thirteen people in a row, no one dared to challenge him again.
Anyone could tell that though this person did not have as bad a mouth as the large black dog, but his abilities were not the slightest bit inferior, and he was overwhelmingly strong.
Peng!
A figure landed on the platform.
It was none other than Chen Dong.
He had already recovered.
Furthermore, he also clearly realized that he had been too rash previously, and had been tricked by the large black dog’s psychological tactic.
Since he knew this, he would definitely not fall for it again if they battled again.
“Step aside!” he said coldly to Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and gave Chen Dongjian the middle finger.

Originally, with one person and one bull, the large black bull insulting them, and Ling Han being so arrogant and domineering, no one would believe they were brothers, but when they saw Ling Han raising his middle finger, everyone felt a sense of familiarity.
F***, the style was similar.
“You’re seeking death!” Chen Dong roared.
However, he immediately composed himself and suppressed his anger.
He didn’t want to make the same mistake again.
As a prodigy, he still had some self-control.
“You brothers are indeed the same type of people!” he said through gritted teeth, “I will teach you a good lesson!”
Xiu, his figure darted out, and charged towards Ling Han.
This pounce was extraordinarily fast, like a bolt of lightning.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
How could this kind of speed escape his eyes?
He casually raised his fist, placing it in front of him.
Then, everyone saw an incredibly strange scene.
Chen Dong seemed to be deliberately making things difficult for himself, and crashed his face into Ling Han’s fist.
Peng!
There was a loud bang, and this collision was solid.
Then, Chen Dong’s whole person was seen to be sent flying, drawing out an arc in the air, and falling onto the platform.
This...
Everyone was surprised.
It was a coincidence?
How was this possible!
It could only be that Ling Han had grasped the trajectory of Chen Dong’s attack in advance, and had then gotten into position, waiting for Chen Dong himself to crash head-first into him.
Furthermore, just how terrifying was Ling Han’s power, to be able to use stillness to restrain movement, and send Chen Dong flying backwards?
Strong, so strong!
“This is what a good son of our Bull Tribe should be like!” The cultivator from the Bull Tribe from before immediately cheered loudly.
This victory was too beautiful.
He did not look at all like the large black dog that kept screwing over his opponent.
Ling Han’s expression involuntarily darkened.
“I’m a human!”
Er!
That Bull Tribe cultivator’s mouth was half-gaping, his face filled with astonishment.
‘Aren’t you two brothers?’
“Brother, you can’t forget your roots as a bull!” he said with a serious expression.
“You can’t forget our roots just because you’ve taken human form!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3971 Feng Lin Stone
paragraphs: 3971 Feng Lin Stone
Ling Han glanced at this large man from the Bull Tribe, feeling a sense of helplessness.
This was a b@stard. He had already told him that he was not a member of the Bull Tribe, so why did he have to acknowledge him as family?
“I’m sworn brothers with this black bull. I’m a pure human,” Ling Han emphasized again.
“Dare I ask your name?” someone asked. This person was far too powerful, and he had easily defeated Chen Dong.
“Ding Yi,” Ling Han replied calmly.
“Grandpa Bull’s name is Ding Er,” the large black dog interrupted.
When the large man from the Bull Tribe heard this, he wanted to open his mouth to speak again. See, one was called Ding Yi, and the other was called Ding Er. How could they not be blood brothers?
However, someone beside him immediately covered his mouth. Didn’t he see that Ling Han was already angered? Was he courting death?
“Yi, I have never heard the names of these two Brothers Ding before,” another person said.

The large black dog hurriedly said, “Previously, us brothers have been cultivating in the depths of the mountains, and have just come out. In the end, we heard that Ling Han person from the North Heavenly Realm actually beat you guys to the point that you can’t even raise your heads. Hence, we decided to seek out that guy for a spar, so that he will know that there are still elites in the West Heavenly Realm!”

Everyone shook their heads. Although Ling Han and the large black dog were both very strong, the large black dog’s strength was only around the ranks of 100 or so on Galaxy Network, while Ling Han’s strength was only in the top 50. Compared to that monster from the North Heavenly Realm, the gap was not just a little bit.
There was no hope. That was a monster that had even defeated an Imperial Son.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han beckoned the large black dog over. This time, he only showed himself, announcing the appearance of Ding Yi and Ding Er, making up a story about their origins.

In the future, he would find even stronger people to fight a few more rounds with, and naturally, he would be able to win the notice of the Donglin Imperial Clan. He would then be able to obtain an invitation.

The large man from the Bull Tribe still wanted to catch up to them and worm his way into being friends with them, but Ling Han and the large black dog were walking very quickly, and he could not catch up to them.
Ling Han and the large black dog stayed here for two days, scouting everywhere for information.
They were really lucky, because another Cauldron Forging Tier prodigy had come.
His name was Zhou Yun, and he was ranked 84th on the Galaxy Network. Moreover, he had come here for a treasure called Feng Lin Stone.
What was the use of this?

In the early stage of Core Formation Tier, hadn’t one melted down the Celestial Cauldrons as fertilizer to nurture the Celestial Core? Feng Lin Stone was a treasure that could speed up the rate of refining.

Thus, when the news of the Feng Lin Stone spread out, those Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators that were close to breaking through to the Core Formation Tier, as well as those martial artists that were already in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier all moved upon hearing the news, wanting to snatch this kind of precious stone.

Ling Han’s heart also throbbed wildly. In the early stage of Core Formation Tier, there were also alchemical pills that could increase the speed of cultivation, but the main ingredient was the Feng Lin Stone.
Thus, if he could obtain the Feng Lin Stone, he would be able to unleash 200% or even 300% of the value of this precious material.
“Little Han, let’s go,” the large black dog immediately said. He knew that Ling Han definitely wouldn’t miss such a good opportunity.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Let’s go!”
The man and dog set out, heading towards the Sleeping Dragon Forest.

It was said that in the ancient times, the descendant of a True Dragon had slumbered here, so dragon-shaped trees grew everywhere in the whole forest. The trunk of this kind of tree looked very much like a True Dragon that was so furious that it soared into the skies.

The news of the Feng Lin Stone had come from here. It was said that someone had accidentally entered the lair of a wild beast and picked up a fragment of the Feng Lin Stone. Thus, he deduced that there was another large Feng Lin Stone in the lair of that wild beast.

At present, there were a great many people gathered in this forest, and there was no shortage of Cauldron Forging Tiers that were ranked highly in the Galaxy Network. Though they had not yet advanced into the Core Formation Tier, no one would mind preparing some treasures for themselves, right?
Ling Han strolled slowly, his eyes slightly vacant, because his mind was completely immersed in comprehending the God Slaying Technique.
This could be seen as a Pseudo-Emperor Technique, which was filled with the amazing ideas of the Nine Suns Saint. Every time Ling Han comprehended a bit more of it, he would be filled with praise.

No wonder the Nine Suns Saint had such a high reputation. If he were ranked in the battle prowess leaderboard of the strongest Saints in history, he would definitely be able to rank in the top ten. As for what ranking he would be ranked in, that was uncertain. After all, there would always be talented people appearing in the future generations.
Previously, Ling Han had only swallowed it in a hurry, and memorized this celestial technique, but he was still a little bit away from channelling it.
He wasn’t in battle mode now, so he could completely multitask and deduce the celestial technique with all his might. He only had to instinctively follow the large black dog’s steps.

They walked for a while, and saw a group of people appear in front of them. The majority of them were men, but the person they surrounded was a woman. She was astonishingly beautiful, but did not appear weak in the slightest. She was filled with heroic spirit, as if she was a goddess of war.
“Someone’s here again!”
“Call them in as well.”
A few people asked, and soon won the agreement of the others. A man walked over, and asked Ling Han, “Brother, are you cultivating the art of beast taming?”

“Scram!” The large black dog immediately stood up on his hind legs, and sent that person flying with a kick. “Don’t you have eyes? Can’t you see that Grandpa Bull is the master here? That this is Grandpa Bull’s human pet?”

At present, Ling Han was in a deep level of seclusion. If it was not for the threat to his life, he would stay muddleheaded like this. Thus, the large black dog naturally wanted to take this opportunity to mess around with Ling Han.
The person who had been sent flying clutched his chest and cried out in pain, yet dared not speak out in anger.
This world revered martial arts. The large black dog’s attack made him realize that there was a huge gap in strength between the two of them, so he naturally didn’t dare to seek his own suffering.
“Yi, big brother!” An enthusiastic voice rang out, and a large man with horns on his head rushed out, stretching out his arms to embrace Ling Han.

The large black dog smiled happily, and said, “This brother of mine has gone mad from cultivation. Aside from Grandpa Bull, no one can approach him at all. Otherwise, he would instinctively attack you out of self-preservation.”
“Grandpa Bull advises you to stop immediately.” The large black dog crossed his arms over his chest.

The large man from the Bull Tribe naturally would not listen, and continued to embrace him. Then, he saw a fist smash towards him. It was clearly not very fast, but it was as if he had been possessed. He did not have any intention of resistance at all.
Peng, he was sent flying with a single punch.

The large black dog smiled happily, and said, “This brother of mine has gone mad from cultivation. Aside from Grandpa Bull, no one can approach him at all. Otherwise, he would instinctively attack you out of self-preservation.”
“Yi, so the two of you are the newly risen Ding Yi and Ding Er?” someone exclaimed in surprise.
Ding Yi and Ding Er had risen to fame recently. One had defeated Chen Dong, while the other had crushed him. Moreover, the two of them had even shouted a resounding slogan of defeating Ling Han.

Even the valiant beauty turned her gaze over, a hint of surprise on her face, as if she could not believe that this foolish-looking man in front of her had defeated a super genius like Chen Dong with a single punch.

“Brother, have you gone mad?” That large man from the Bull Tribe ran back, and instantly wailed, “The heavens are blind. It was not easy for our Bull Tribe to produce a supreme prodigy, but I had never thought that he would have fallen to this extent!”
Everyone couldn’t help but wear strange expressions. Previously, hadn’t Ding Yi said that he had only become sworn brothers with Ding Er? They weren’t blood brothers and he was a pure human.
You are really too shameless, aren’t you, just to ride on his popularity?
The soldierly beauty strode over, and said, “I know medicinal arts. I will take a look at him.”
She stretched out a hand to touch Ling Han’s forehead.
Out of instinct, Ling Han immediately launched a counterattack. He delivered a palm strike right at the chest of the soldierly beauty.

chapters.title: Chapter 3972: Trap
paragraphs: The soldierly beauty immediately humphed, and the palm she stretched out changed to a slash, striking out at Ling Han’s pulse.
The palm landed, and Ling Han’s right arm instantly sank. However, his fingertips still grazed the soldierly beauty’s chest.
All of a sudden, a dead silence fell.
“I say, brother, you’ve already gone mad, but your flirtatious nature hasn’t changed at all.”
The large black dog immediately clicked his tongue in amazement. It was obvious that he was deliberately trying to attract animosity.
However, Ling Han didn’t know this at all. He instinctively counterattacked, and didn’t realize at all whether his enemy was male or female.
Hearing these words, everyone’s expressions turned from shock to fury.
This was too much, too much, to actually dare make a move on their goddess! F***, are you faking it, and deliberately taking advantage of her?
However... their goddess had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so how could a Cauldron Forging Tier take advantage of her?
Hiss, this guy was very strong!

This valiant beauty was called He Yafu. Though she had not managed to enter into the Exquisite Leaderboard, she was publicly acknowledged as the number one beauty on this planet. Furthermore, she had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so her natural talent in martial arts was astonishing.

At first, she was shocked, because the aura that Ling Han was exuding was clearly only the Cauldron Forging Tier, but his power was incredibly strong, practically not inferior to hers. However, very quickly, a strong feeling of shame and anger rose up in her.
Someone had actually assaulted her breasts!
Though he had only grazed her and there was still a layer of clothes, she was still as pure, so how could she allow herself to be tarnished like this?
With a soft exclamation, she moved again.
This time, it wasn’t for Ling Han’s inspection. Instead, it was an attack filled with fury, her offensive fierce.

Ling Han instinctively moved to parry. At present, he did not have any offensive ability at all, but his basic power had reached Third Heaven. Even if he did not go all out, he was not the slightest bit inferior to He Yafu.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The two of them clashed endlessly. He Yafu’s snow-white slender figure was presently even tougher than Divine Metal. She delivered palm strikes, her might boundless.

However, no matter how she attacked, she was still unable to penetrate Ling Han’s defenses. -In truth, to say nothing of the fact that she was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, her original power was only Second Heaven. Even if her power surpassed Ling Han’s by a few Heavens, it would be useless. That was because Ling Han still had the only Celestial Cauldron that could absorb all power attacks within six Heavens, and could not wound Ling Han at all.

He Yafu continued to attack. She had already realized that Ling Han wasn’t deliberately taking advantage of her. Instead, he had truly fallen into a dazed state. However, it was in this state that he instinctively moved to parry, not losing at all.
This guy’s strength was too shocking, wasn’t it? A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator could actually be this strong?
After fighting for a while, He Yafu finally stopped on her own volition.
There was no point in continuing the battle. She was completely unable to suppress Ling Han.
“Er, sister-in-law, can we set out now?” the large black dog asked. He appeared to be very serious, but he was actually acting cheeky.
He Yafu was furious, and immediately delivered a palm strike at it.
The large black dog wasn’t Ling Han. Even if He Yafu didn’t use her full power, how could he withstand the attack of a Core Formation Tier cultivator?
Peng! The large black dog instantly started to roll around on the ground. It only came to a stop after rolling over a dozen times.
It had finally gotten a taste of the evil consequences of having a cheap mouth.
“Come, let’s go to the lair of the wild beast,” He Yafu turned around and said to everyone.
Everyone set out, heading towards the lair of the wild beast. Someone knew the location, and led the way ahead.
“Oh, that’s right. What kind of ferocious beast is that?” How could the large black dog bear to remain silent for a moment? He immediately approached and asked everyone.

“A great beast at the late stage of Core Formation Tier,” someone said. “We only have four Core Formation Tier elites here, and only one of them has reached the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier. Thus, we have to rely on the advantage of numbers to kill this great beast.”
“Don’t worry. It’s said that Feng Lin Stone is very big, and there’s enough for us to share.” Was that really the case?
The large black dog grumbled. He had always been devious, screwing people over without a care. Thus, whenever he encountered something, he would first consider if there was any
conspiracy.
It couldn’t be helped. It was purely his nature.
However, everyone was in high spirits, and thought that if they worked together, it would be enough to kill a late stage Core Formation Tier great beast. There would be absolutely no
problem.

“I hope so,” the large black dog said softly. When he recalled that he still had Ling Han by his side, he felt much more at ease. That was because he knew Ling Han’s trump card. If he couldn’t, there was still the Heavenly Dao Flames, and even Venerate Tier elites would have to run if they saw it.
It wasn’t long before they arrived at a small valley. The lair of the wild beast was inside.
“Be careful.”
They all drew their Spirit Tools. After all, they had to face a late stage Core Formation Tier great beast, so they had to be extremely careful.

“Ang!” Amidst the roar of a beast, peng, peng, peng, the ground trembled madly, and a massive wild beast rushed out. It looked like a bear, but its whole body was covered with spikes like a porcupine. Each spike was close to three meters long, and looked very terrifying. This was a vicious beast at the late stage of the Core Formation Tier. With this roar, everyone felt a chill run down their spines.

“Follow me!” He Yafu leaped out, and with a command, three prodigies of the Core Formation Tier also stepped out. They were the main force of the assault against the fierce beast. If the Cauldron Forging Tiers were to block a late stage Core Formation Tier great beast, the mortality rate would be frighteningly high.
Everyone moved, and charged towards this fierce beast.

The progress of the matter was very smooth. As the saying goes, an abundance of ants could bite an elephant to death, what more when everyone was much stronger than ants. They could completely be considered wolves, a pack of wolves devouring a tiger, blasting this fierce beast
into smithereens.

sentences.text: The soldierly beauty immediately humphed, and the palm she stretched out changed to a slash, striking out at Ling Han’s pulse.
The palm landed, and Ling Han’s right arm instantly sank.
However, his fingertips still grazed the soldierly beauty’s chest.
All of a sudden, a dead silence fell.
“I say, brother, you’ve already gone mad, but your flirtatious nature hasn’t changed at all.”
The large black dog immediately clicked his tongue in amazement.
It was obvious that he was deliberately trying to attract animosity.
However, Ling Han didn’t know this at all.
He instinctively counterattacked, and didn’t realize at all whether his enemy was male or female.
Hearing these words, everyone’s expressions turned from shock to fury.
This was too much, too much, to actually dare make a move on their goddess!
F***, are you faking it, and deliberately taking advantage of her?
However... their goddess had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so how could a Cauldron Forging Tier take advantage of her?
Hiss, this guy was very strong!
This valiant beauty was called He Yafu.
Though she had not managed to enter into the Exquisite Leaderboard, she was publicly acknowledged as the number one beauty on this planet.
Furthermore, she had already advanced into the Core Formation Tier, so her natural talent in martial arts was astonishing.
At first, she was shocked, because the aura that Ling Han was exuding was clearly only the Cauldron Forging Tier, but his power was incredibly strong, practically not inferior to hers.
However, very quickly, a strong feeling of shame and anger rose up in her.
Someone had actually assaulted her breasts!
Though he had only grazed her and there was still a layer of clothes, she was still as pure, so how could she allow herself to be tarnished like this?
With a soft exclamation, she moved again.
This time, it wasn’t for Ling Han’s inspection.
Instead, it was an attack filled with fury, her offensive fierce.
Ling Han instinctively moved to parry.

Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
The two of them clashed endlessly.
He Yafu’s snow-white slender figure was presently even tougher than Divine Metal.

Peng!
The large black dog instantly started to roll around on the ground.
It only came to a stop after rolling over a dozen times.
It had finally gotten a taste of the evil consequences of having a cheap mouth.
