chapters.title: Chapter 3973: Trapped
paragraphs: The large black dog wasn’t afraid at all, and he glared back, saying, “What is it? Is Grandpa Bull wrong?”
Meanwhile, He Yafu pressed her hands down, and said, “This matter is indeed strange. Everyone, calm down first.”
Though her cultivation level was not the highest, but as an exquisite beauty, her words naturally had considerable weight, and immediately silenced everyone.
“Hehe, never would I have thought that there would be a smart person.” A voice rang out, yet it was completely indistinguishable from where it had come from, as it reverberated
throughout the entire valley.
“Who?” everyone shouted.
“Your nightmare, the reaper of life!” This voice rang out again, but it was very airy. It could not even be distinguished whether it was male or female.
“Enough with the pretense. Show yourself!”
“Were you the one who took the Feng Lin Stone away?”
“Who exactly are you?”
Everyone was talking at once, calling out one after another.
“You’re about to die, so why are you asking so many questions?” the voice said calmly. It was filled with mockery.

The large black dog sneered, and said, “Stop pretending. Don’t you just want to show off your superiority? Otherwise, you could have just directly activated the formation to attack. Why would you still speak?”
“Grandpa Bull looks down on people like you the most.”
The voice didn’t ring out at the first instant. After a while, it flew into a humiliated rage and said, “Fat cow, later, I’ll cut you into pieces of beefsteak and roast you to eat!”

Everyone gradually calmed down. The present situation was that they were trapped in a formation, but they had completely no idea exactly how powerful this formation was. “What benefits do you have from trapping us here?” He Yafu asked.
The voice was silent for a moment before saying, “Alright, since you’re a beauty, I’ll answer you.”

“My Master plans to concoct a Divine Pill, which requires at least 10,000 types of blood. The higher the cultivation level of the person who provides the blood, the better his natural talent, and the better the effects of the Divine Pill that he concocts.”
“Especially for so-called prodigies like you guys. That blood is an excellent ingredient.”
“If I asked you guys for it, you guys would definitely not agree. Hence, I only used a small scheme, using the Feng Lin Stone as bait, and you guys scrambled over.”
When everyone heard this, their expressions turned ugly. As it turned out, this matter had only been a deception from beginning to end.
“Is that Feng Lin Stone real or fake?” Someone still had a sliver of hope.
“Hahaha, to be able to ask such a question, you are really pitifully stupid!” the voice said.
He Yafu nodded, “Looks like the person who spread the news of the Feng Lin Stone is you, right?”
What were they supposed to do?
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically.
Right at this moment, xiu, a figure leaped out, and barged into the formation.
Ling Han!
Was he seeking death?
Xiu, an ice sword immediately appeared, stabbing towards Ling Han.
Peng! Ling Han threw a punch, and the ice sword was instantly shattered. However, blood also bloomed from his fist. Thankfully, the remaining power was automatically dispersed by the
Celestial Cauldron.
What a powerful guy!
Everyone was stunned. That was the attack of late stage Core Formation Tier, yet it was actually blocked by Ling Han. Furthermore, Ling Han was still in a state of “madness”.
‘F*ck! This is only a Cauldron Forging Tier!’
If this guy could leave here alive, could he really be able to challenge the freakish person from
the North Heavenly Realm? Or even be able to win?
Of course, the prerequisite was that he had to survive the current dilemma first.
Shua, another ice sword appeared, slashing towards Ling Han.
Ling Han still hadn’t exited his state of comprehension. His hands naturally danced, pressing
down on the ice sword. Frighteningly, there was a black light connecting his hands, exuding
an incredibly deep aura.
When everyone saw this, a chill rose up from the bottom of their hearts. What kind of
technique was this, or was it a high-level energy?
Peng!
Ling Han’s attack landed on the ice sword, and the ice sword shattered again, turning into
pure heaven and earth energy, while his hands were completely unscathed this time.
Everyone’s eyes widened, feeling a sense of disbelief.
You are too f strong, aren’t you?

chapters.title: Chapter 3974: Ling Han breaks the formation
paragraphs: Ling Han appeared to be unconscious, but in truth, in the depths of his mind, his intent was presently at a crucial moment of comprehending the God Slaying Technique. Thus, he
couldn’t help but begin to practice it.
When he encountered an attack, he would naturally use the God Slaying Technique to deal with it.
What he channeled now was not the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, but rather the Nine Suns Divine Scroll, a cultivation technique created by the Nine Suns Saint.
-The cultivation technique was matched with the celestial technique, and that was what allowed the might of the celestial technique to be activated to its fullest.
Of course, this pinnacle level was only relative. Very few people had reached or even surpassed the level of the creator.

Cultivation techniques were the true foundations of a force. Any celestial technique would be deduced from this. For example, the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Why was the might of Ling Han’s roar inferior to Prosperous Heaven? It was because he hadn’t cultivated the Buddhist Race cultivation technique.
It being a castrated version was also one of the reasons.

The Nine Suns Saint held Ling Han in such high regard, so he naturally would not be stingy. Teaching him all of the Nine Suns Divine Scroll would allow Ling Han to cultivate all the way to Saint Tier without a hitch.
With the boost of the Saint-level cultivation technique, the God Slaying Technique began to unleash its might, its might boundlessly terrifying.

Shua, shua, shua! The ice swords continued to slash, slash, and pierce. This was a formation that had been formed by extracting the power of heaven and earth, and the power of heaven and earth was endless, so its attacks were naturally endless.

Ling Han waved his hands continuously. The God Slaying Technique unleashed its might, and dispersed one attack after another. Even if there was still energy left to attack, the only Celestial Cauldron could still easily disperse it.
However, after blocking a few dozen moves, his face involuntarily paled, and he could not catch his breath.
He could no longer channel the God Slaying Technique.
This was very normal. This was a Saint Technique, so how could a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator channel it for a long time?
Shua, an ice sword slashed over.

Ling Han’s eyes instantly became clear again. He had already withdrawn from the comprehension of the God Slaying Technique. Immediately, he threw a punch, and the Starlight Screen wrapped around his fist, forming an effective protection.
Peng, with a single punch, the ice sword was immediately shattered, but the deep power continued to blast over, enough to kill even a martial artist in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Unfortunately, Ling Han was a freak. The only Celestial Cauldron trembled slightly, and the impact was instantly dispersed completely.
“Formation?” Ling Han frowned. The events from before surged into his mind like a tidal wave, and he was able to receive these memories.

He had been cultivating all this while, so he had automatically blocked out everything else. However, what he could see and hear would not disappear. It was only now that he could receive and deal with everything.
He humphed lightly, and used his eye technique. Instantly, he saw something that others could not.
The direction of the power of heaven and earth.
What was the source of formations? The power of heaven and earth.
“It’s all thanks to Brother Ding this time!”
“Brother Ding, if there’s anything you need, just say the word, and I’ll put my life on the line
for you!”
Everyone gathered around him, saying words of gratitude. Some were even willing to sacrifice
their lives for him.

These people might not really be hot-blooded, though. Instead, they had deliberately said this to gain a connection with Ling Han. After all, this guy was too freakish. If they really had such a friend, it would naturally be greatly beneficial in future.
Ling Han maintained Ding Yi’s arrogant style, and only nodded indifferently at everyone’s goodwill. He wasn’t enthusiastic at all.
“Brother, that b@stard wants to make the old bull into a beefsteak. Let’s go and kill him!” The large black dog ran over, still looking very angry, though he could only be made into a
dog chop, at most.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.

Both he and the large black dog had been screwed over, so he naturally couldn’t let things slide just like that. Moreover, he was also extremely curious about what pill that person’s Master was going to concoct. How could he be so cruel?
“Brother Ding-” Seeing that Ling Han and the large black dog were about to leave, He Yafu
hurriedly called out.
“En?” Ling Han stopped, and turned around to look at her, a puzzled expression on his face.
“N-nothing.” At first, He Yafu wanted to urge him to stay, or go with her, but when she saw Ling Han’s expression, she swallowed her words.
Ling Han wore an aloof expression as he continued to advance with the large black dog.
After leaving the valley, the large black dog couldn’t help but ask, “Brat, did you know that you touched her breasts?”
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel awkward but his expression darkened. Was it as exaggerated
as you say?
“Alright, even if it’s just a slight touch, you’re the one who’s taken advantage of her,” the large black dog continued. “Now, she’s clearly attracted by the domineering aura that you’re
exuding. Why don’t you take her!”
“You see, since the West Heavenly Realm looks down on us, let’s kidnap all their beauties.
When the time comes, let’s see how those guys will cry.”
“Little Han, what do you say?”
“Hey, hey, hey, why are you walking so fast? Wait for the Grandpa Do-Grandpa Bull!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3975: Culprit
paragraphs: Ling Han naturally remembered everything.

However, firstly, he did not have the slightest interest in He Yafu. Secondly, he had not come here to pick up a girl. Furthermore, this was a false identity. What need was there for him to cause a girl to miss him so much, and waste her feelings?
Thus, he remained calm and collected, putting everything out in the bud.
He actually didn’t have any ill feelings toward the West Heavenly Realm. He was only displeased with the actions of the Donglin Imperial Clan.

“Let Grandpa Dog recall the appearance and smell of that person,” the large black dog said. Being able to become a Cauldron Forging Tier, its memory was naturally very good. After it recalled for a while, it sniffed with its nose, and said, “Come with Grandpa Dog.”
The large black dog walked in front, while Ling Han followed behind.

However, looking at a large black ox sniffing around on the ground, climbing onto a tree one moment, and then flying into the air on a Spirit Tool the next, Ling Han only felt that this scene was filled with humor.
“What are you laughing at?” The large black dog turned around.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and said, “Nothing, nothing.”
“There must be something!” The large black dog’s expression was filled with suspicion.
“It’s really nothing,” Ling Han emphasized.
As they spoke, they had arrived at another valley.
“That b@stard is inside,” the large black dog said.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Let’s give him a surprise.”
They quietly entered into the valley, and saw that this method was more or less the same. Another group of people had been enticed by the Feng Lin Stone, and had themselves stepped into a trap.
However, now that the mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind it, that person would never think that Ling Han and the large black dog were presently looking for him from behind.
At this moment, there was no need for the large black dog to use his dog’s nose anymore. Ling Han released his divine sense, and had a complete grasp of the situation in the entire valley. Found him.
Although Ling Han didn’t know what that person’s divine sense fluctuation was like, there was only a single divine sense fluctuation. Thus, this person must be the mastermind.
He walked quietly, approaching that person.
It wasn’t long before they saw a person standing at the peak of the mountain. He wore a cold smile as he looked down at them, a hint of disdain in his expression.
“Bunch of idiots!” he mumbled to himself.
“Oh, how are they idiots?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
Shua, that person immediately turned around, and saw that it was a man in his thirties. He looked ordinary, and his cultivation level was only Cauldron Forging Tier.

“It’s you!” the man exclaimed in astonishment. There was a look of disbelief on his face. Indeed, how could he believe this? Ling Han should have been trapped in the formation. Ling Han cracked a smile, “Did you get a little scare?”

The man frowned deeply. He knew himself well. He was only in the Cauldron Forging Tier, and this Ding Yi was actually capable of resisting He Yafu, who was in the early stage of Core Formation Tier. His abilities were naturally far superior to his.
Hence, he would definitely die if he faced him head-on.
“Hehe, we can talk things over,” the man hurriedly said with a smile.
Ling Han also smiled, “All right, then let’s start with your name.”
“My name is Lu Bo,” the man said very frankly. Of course, it was unknown whether this was a fabrication or not.
“You want to kill me in a trap and extract blood for pill concoction, so how should we calculate this debt?” Ling Han asked again.
Lu Bo’s expression was serious, “Brother, I am only obeying the commands of others. There is absolutely nothing I can do.”
“By whose command?”
Lu Bo’s eyes darted around, and he finally said, “A mighty figure! Brother, don’t ask anymore. If I speak, not only will I lose my life, but you will also be silenced.”
“Brother your sister!”
Peng!
A hoof immediately landed on the back of Lu Bo’s head, and the large black dog jumped out, “Bast@rd, didn’t you want to eat some beefsteak?”

A muscle twitched in Lu Bo’s cheek. How could he have imagined that Ling Han would still be able to escape at that time? Naturally, he had not taken the large black dog seriously, and mocked him casually. If he had known that this would happen, he would have accumulated some declaration of goodwill.
“Er, Grandpa Bull, everything is a misunderstanding,” he carefully apologized.
“Misunderstanding your sister!” The large black dog’s hoof struck again.
Lu Bo didn’t dare to dodge at all. He gritted his teeth in pain as the large black dog landed a solid hit on him.
“Milords, milords, calm down,” he said humbly. In order to survive, he naturally couldn’t be stubborn now.
“Who’s your master?” the large black dog interrogated on Ling Han’s behalf.

“I really can’t say.” Lu Bo looked very anxious, “My two Lords, I am really thinking for your sakes. My Master’s background is too powerful. If I say his name, something will happen.” “You’re not going to tell me? Then I can only search your soul,” the large black dog balefully said.

A look of shock immediately appeared on Lu Bo’s face. With a soul search, no secret could be kept. Furthermore, a soul search would also have a very strong effect on the victim. It would not be strange for him to become an idiot, or even have his mind actually shattered.
He did not want to become an idiot or die in the slightest.
“Lords, I really can’t say, I really can’t!” he wailed miserably.
“Looks like you’re not going to give up until you see the coffin!” The large black dog
stretched out a hoof.
“I’ll speak! I’ll speak!” Lu Bo couldn’t hold on any longer, and hurriedly compromised, “My Master is Fu Huoyang.”
“Fu Huoyang?” Ling Han looked towards the large black dog. He had never heard of this name
before.
“Yi, you haven’t even heard of my Master’s name?” Lu Bo was shocked, and hurriedly asked. “What is it? Should I know?” Ling Han asked.
“My Master is a descendant of the Imperial Clan!” Lu Bo declared, his face filled with pride.
The Imperial Clan was high and noble, like a god from the Nine Heavens. All the others could only bow in worship.

If Ling Han had still been suspicious before, when he saw this expression, he was certain that this guy was telling the truth. His Master was indeed a descendant of the Imperial Clan. Otherwise, he would not have this kind of bone-deep feeling of superiority.
“Let me check.” The large black dog connected to the Galaxy Network and began to look up
information.
After a while, it said, “Fu Huoyang is the descendant of the Destiny Saint Emperor. He’s only a member of the branch family, but his talent is extremely high. Moreover, he’s also an
alchemist.”

The Imperial Clans had always been mysterious. Moreover, this was only because Fu Huoyang was a member of thebranch family. Otherwise, it was possible that his name wouldn’t even be known to outsiders.
Ling Han nodded, then turned to look at Lu Bo, and asked, “What pill does Fu Huoyang want
to concoct?”

“I don’t know,” Lu Bo replied with a shake of his head. Upon seeing the large black dog’s vicious expression, he hurriedly said, “I really don’t know what Master wants to do. He would only issue direct commands, so why would he explain this to me?”
That was true.
“Where is Fu Huoyang now?”
Lu Bo was surprised, and looked at Ling Han with a shocked expression. What did this guy want to do? His Master was a member of the Imperial Clan. Even if he was only from the
branch clan, wasn’t it awesome enough to have the name of Imperial Clan?
Could it be that he wanted to seek his Master out for an accounting?
“That’s right.” Ling Han patted his shoulder, “So, hurry up and tell me his whereabouts. My
patience has always been limited.”
Lu Bo immediately wanted to shake his head. He had a natural reverence for Fu Huoyang,
both because of the great reputation of the Imperial Clan, and also because of Fu Huoyang’s
own strength.
But on second thought, he changed his mind, and said, “My Master is in Anyuan Inn in Golden
Peace City.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3976: Fu Huoyang
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled, and said, “This Fu Huoyang’s cultivation level is at least Core Formation Tier, right?”
Lu Bo opened his mouth, and said something soundlessly, his face filled with surprise.
What he meant was, ‘How do you know?’

“It’s simple. Previously, you looked like you didn’t want to say anything, but in the blink of an eye, you said it. You probably thought that with Fu Huoyang’s strength, if we went to find him, that would be courting death,” Ling Han said.
‘F*ck! Can you read my mind?’
“I cannot read your mind. I’m simply analyzing,” Ling Han said.
The large black dog rushed over and kicked Lu Bo to the ground. “Tell me, what cultivation level is Fu Huoyang at?”
Lu Bo sighed, “Core Formation Tier late stage.”
“Tsk, no big deal.” The large black dog immediately revealed a disdainful expression. Ling Han had even killed a consummate level Core Formation Tier cultivator before.
Yet Ling Han was not careless, and asked, “What about battle prowess?”
“I don’t know.” Lu Bo hurriedly shook his head.

“Heh, you really don’t know?” Ling Han signalled at the large black dog with his eyes. The large black dog understood his signal, and immediately began to throw punches and kicks. “You’re not going to tell me, are you?” The large black dog sneered, “Grandpa Bull will kick your b@lls to burst, so I’ll just let you be an eunuch in future.”
Lu Bo’s face instantly turned green. He had no wish to become an eunuch. That would be the end of his life.

“I really don’t know Master’s strength, but it’s at least above Tenth Heaven,” he said. “Tenth Heaven!” The large black dog bared his teeth. Faced with such an existence, even if Ling Han could protect himself, it was impossible for him to win.
“Is he really that powerful?” It looked towards Ling Han.

Ling Han nodded, “The battle prowess of an ordinary Core Formation Tier consummate level alchemist would probably be Eighth Heaven, but this is calculated in terms of one breaking through from Heaven Cauldron or Bronze Cauldron. The quality of Celestial Cauldron is higher, and the more Celestial Cauldrons formed, then the battle prowess of Core Formation Tier would definitely be higher.”

Lu Yongchang, Zhongsun Tiankun, and the other ultimate prodigies of the Core Formation Tier and so on all had battle prowess of at least Fifteenth Heaven, and this was something that Ling Han could see from afar. In truth, it was possible that it was even higher.

Coming from the Imperial Clan, and being able to be called a prodigy, breaking through to the Core Formation Tier with seven or eight golden cauldrons was naturally very normal. Thus, it wouldn’t be strange for this battle prowess to surpass the Tenth Heaven.
“What do we do?” The large black dog looked towards Ling Han.
“We have to go and take a look. We can’t allow others to bully us for nothing,” Ling Han said calmly.
The large black dog nodded in agreement. They weren’t the type to swallow their grievances. “My lords, can you please let me go?” Lu Bo asked carefully. “I’m really only doing this on orders.”
The large black dog immediately lashed out. Pa! His paw smashed Lu Bo’s head into smithereens. This was an accomplice, so there was naturally no reason to spare his life.
“Come, let’s go to the Golden Peace City.”
Ling Han thought for a moment, then closed the formation. Then, he flew on his divine tool, heading towards the Golden Peace City.
Lu Bo was located in the hub of this formation, and it was very convenient to activate and deactivate it.
With the battle prowess of that guy just now, he was completely capable of easily killing all of
them, so what need was there for him to do something unnecessary, and set up some kind of
formation?
In that case, they had really repaid kindness with hatred.
Sigh, then they deserved to be beaten.

Ling Han and the large black dog didn’t fly on their Tools anymore. They couldn’t use movement techniques, and their speed wasn’t even as fast as traveling on the ground. Of course, it would be different if they advanced into the Core Formation Tier. They didn’t need a Spirit Tool to fly, and they could also use movement techniques in midair, so their speed
would increase explosively.
Half a day later, they arrived at the Golden Peace City.
Anyuan Inn was very easy to find, and the man and dog soon arrived at their destination.
This inn was very big, really very big. There were both ordinary rooms, as well as isolated courtyards. The cost of renting for a day was very shocking.
Ling Han and the large black dog also rented a courtyard. Fu Huoyang was too powerful, so it
was not appropriate for them to alert him.
After settling down, Ling Han released his divine sense to search for Fu Huoyang.
It wasn’t long before he located a powerful aura. It was like a ball of flames, and it was
extremely terrifying. However, upon closer examination, he discovered that these flames
were ice-cold and extremely bizarre.
This was Fu Huoyang? What cultivation technique was he cultivating? How strange.
Right at this moment, the other party had already sensed it. His divine sense began a counter-
exploration of Ling Han.
Good lord, this divine sense was really too sharp.
Ling Han hurriedly withdrew his divine sense. Then, he opened his eyes, and said to the large
black dog, “We’ve been discovered.”
“F*ck! That person’s senses are so terrifying?” the large black dog exclaimed in
astonishment.
“Come on out.” Right at this moment, a gentle voice was heard from outside, without the
slightest bit of anger.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and strode out.

chapters.title: Chapter 3977: Arrogant and fearless
paragraphs: Ling Han walked out, only to see a young man standing in the courtyard.
This man was tall and slender, and wore a milky white long robe, appearing very carefree.
However, though the majority of his hair was jet-black, there was a small tuft that was white. It seemed to have been deliberately dyed, and appeared very conspicuous.
“Fu Huoyang?” Ling Han asked, though he was already 90% sure.
The man nodded, “I am Fu Huoyang.” He paused, and asked in return, “That subordinate of mine should have fallen into your hands, right?”
Ling Han did not hide anything either, “That’s right.”
“Is he dead?” Fu Huoyang asked.
“He’s dead.”
Fu Huoyang smiled, “Just in time, to save me the trouble of making a move.”
“You’re so cruel to your own subordinates?” Ling Han asked.
“A subordinate that has betrayed his Master, should I keep him alive to continue betraying me?” Fu Huoyang asked with a smile.
“Hehe, looks like you would rather betray the world than have the world betray you,” Ling Han said.

Fu Huoyang shook his head, “I am a member of the Imperial Clan, so I am naturally high and noble. So what if I decide the life and death of an ant? In my eyes, that subordinate of mine is an ant, and aren’t you the same?”
“White-haired man, your mouth is asking for a beating.” The large black dog strode out. His mouth was much more toxic than Ling Han’s.

However, Fu Huoyang was not angered. He merely swept an indifferent glance over the large black dog, and his eyes returned to Ling Han, “You are a little special. You are clearly only in Cauldron Forging Tier, yet give me a very strong feeling.”
“Of course, no matter how strong he is, he is only an ant. He is only that slight bit stronger than any ordinary ant.”
Ling Han shook his head, “You keep calling others ants, and say that you are high and noble. Hehe, so what if you are a member of the Imperial Clan? Do you have four legs or six arms?”
Fu Huoyang was calm, appearing to be extremely subtle. He looked at Ling Han, “Your blood... should be very useful!”
He moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! As he stretched out his hand, streaks of light overflowed from his fingers, as if it was a fantasy.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and shot out a punch.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han immediately stumbled back. There was a trace of blood at the corner of his lips.

So strong. How could this guy only have Tenth Heaven-level battle prowess? He was at least Thirteenth or Fourteenth Heaven. Even if the only Celestial Cauldron had dispersed most of the power of this blow, the shockwaves from the impact still caused Ling Han to be injured.
Moreover, this attack had only been a casual move from Fu Huoyang. Once he became serious, just how strong would his battle prowess be?

“Yi?” Fu Huoyang was also extremely stunned. As he saw it, this stretch of his hand would definitely be able to capture Ling Han, but Ling Han had actually sent his hand flying with a single punch. Ling Han’s power was truly astonishing.
However, Ling Han immediately discovered that the ground around him was collapsing, and buildings were collapsing one after another.
Was there an earthquake?
Of course not.
It was Fu Huoyang. He was in midair, and he attacked downwards without any reservations.
With a palm strike, a large area immediately sank.
This was too deranged!
It should be known that this was not an empty city. A great many of the houses were occupied, and being knocked over with a single palm strike from Fu Huoyang, at least 90% of the
residents were immediately killed.
How innocent were these people?
Not only Ling Han, but even the large black dog was enraged. This was far too inhumane!
“Heh, all of this is because of you people,” Fu Huoyang said calmly. “If you people hadn’t fled, the people here wouldn’t have died. Thus, you people are the true culprits who killed
these people.”
F***, how could there be such a shameless person?
“Fu Huoyang, f*ck, your, mother!” the large black dog spat out word by word.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! With such a large commotion happening, the elites in the city naturally could
not just sit by and watch. They all flew into the skies.
“Evil brat, how dare you!” There was actually another True Self Tier elite, who immediately stretched out a hand to grab Fu Huoyang.
“This is the business of the Imperial Clan, step back!” Fu Huoyang rebuked lightly.
‘What?’
The True Self Tier elite’s hand was halfway out, yet he forcefully retracted it.
The Imperial Clan was a clan that resided above the Nine Heavens. Who dared to offend them?
Just as Fu Huoyang had said just now, even if he announced to the world that he was going to
use the blood of ten thousand people to concoct alchemical pills, who would dare to do
anything to him?
“How are you going to prove that you’re an Imperial Clan member?” the True Self Tier elite shouted.
Since he had asked this question, it meant that he had already cowered, and had the intention
to retreat.

sentences.text: Ling Han walked out, only to see a young man standing in the courtyard.
This man was tall and slender, and wore a milky white long robe, appearing very carefree.
However, though the majority of his hair was jet-black, there was a small tuft that was white.
It seemed to have been deliberately dyed, and appeared very conspicuous.
“Fu Huoyang?” Ling Han asked, though he was already 90% sure.
The man nodded, “I am Fu Huoyang.” He paused, and asked in return, “That subordinate of mine should have fallen into your hands, right?”
Ling Han did not hide anything either, “That’s right.”
“Is he dead?” Fu Huoyang asked.
“He’s dead.”
Fu Huoyang smiled, “Just in time, to save me the trouble of making a move.”
“You’re so cruel to your own subordinates?” Ling Han asked.
“A subordinate that has betrayed his Master, should I keep him alive to continue betraying me?” Fu Huoyang asked with a smile.
“Hehe, looks like you would rather betray the world than have the world betray you,” Ling Han said.
Fu Huoyang shook his head, “I am a member of the Imperial Clan, so I am naturally high and noble.
So what if I decide the life and death of an ant?
In my eyes, that subordinate of mine is an ant, and aren’t you the same?”
“White-haired man, your mouth is asking for a beating.” The large black dog strode out.
His mouth was much more toxic than Ling Han’s.
However, Fu Huoyang was not angered.
He merely swept an indifferent glance over the large black dog, and his eyes returned to Ling Han, “You are a little special.
You are clearly only in Cauldron Forging Tier, yet give me a very strong feeling.”
“Of course, no matter how strong he is, he is only an ant.
He is only that slight bit stronger than any ordinary ant.”
Ling Han shook his head, “You keep calling others ants, and say that you are high and noble.
Hehe, so what if you are a member of the Imperial Clan?
Do you have four legs or six arms?”
Fu Huoyang was calm, appearing to be extremely subtle.
He looked at Ling Han, “Your blood... should be very useful!”
He moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
As he stretched out his hand, streaks of light overflowed from his fingers, as if it was a fantasy.
Ling Han clenched his hand into a fist, and shot out a punch.
Peng!

So strong.

He was at least Thirteenth or Fourteenth Heaven.
Even if the only Celestial Cauldron had dispersed most of the power of this blow, the shockwaves from the impact still caused Ling Han to be injured.
Moreover, this attack had only been a casual move from Fu Huoyang.
Once he became serious, just how strong would his battle prowess be?
“Yi?” Fu Huoyang was also extremely stunned.
As he saw it, this stretch of his hand would definitely be able to capture Ling Han, but Ling Han had actually sent his hand flying with a single punch.
Ling Han’s power was truly astonishing.
However, Ling Han immediately discovered that the ground around him was collapsing, and buildings were collapsing one after another.
Was there an earthquake?
Of course not.
It was Fu Huoyang.
He was in midair, and he attacked downwards without any reservations.
With a palm strike, a large area immediately sank.
This was too deranged!
It should be known that this was not an empty city.
A great many of the houses were occupied, and being knocked over with a single palm strike from Fu Huoyang, at least 90% of the
residents were immediately killed.
How innocent were these people?

not just sit by and watch.

anything to him?

chapters.title: Chapter 3978: Bounty
paragraphs: Fu Huoyang merely smiled faintly. Boom, an incredibly frightening aura suddenly rose up from his body, as majestic as if he was a Great Emperor.
This was Imperial Blood!
The True Self Tier elite no longer had any doubts. Only the Imperial Clan would be able to ignite the Imperial Blood. This was solid proof.
He did not say another word, but rather turned around and left.
So be it if the Golden Peace City was destroyed. It was fine as long as his clansmen were fine.
Fu Huoyang smiled faintly. In his eyes, this was only natural.
When the Imperial Clan did things, who dared to stop them?

“I was right, wasn’t I?” Fu Huoyang stood in midair. A Core Formation Tier cultivator could step on empty air, and standing in midair, it could be said that he was extremely showy. He continued to wave his hand in attack, and palm strikes landed, causing the ground around him to crumble.
“Aren’t you going to come out?” he asked calmly. “How many more people do you want to sacrifice for you?”
‘Motherf*cker!’
Ling Han and the large black dog both cursed internally. This Fu Huoyang was really too inhumane.
They exchanged a glance, and both of them dashed out of the city.
Even if the large black dog was scheming and devious, he still couldn’t stand by and watch as so many innocent people died for his sake.
“An ant is an ant, after all,” Fu Huoyang said calmly. As he saw it, Ling Han and the large black dog’s “sacrificial spirit” was practically incomparably stupid.
They were all just ants, so what if a thousand or ten thousand died?

However, it was just right for him to come out. He was very interested in Ling Han’s blood. If he used it to concoct alchemical pills, it should have outstanding effects, and heal the hidden injuries that had been left behind when he had previously cultivated an extraordinary technique. From there, he would be able to open up a wide path, allowing him to reach the peak of martial arts.
He leaped up, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han and the large black dog.

Coming from the Imperial Clan, even if he was only a member of a branch clan, he had grasped a very high level movement technique, and added with the fact that his cultivation level was superior, his speed was not the slightest bit slower than Ling Han. No matter how Ling Han used the terrain in the mountains to break free, he would always follow closely behind him.
“Little Han, why is this sticky candy so hard to deal with?” the large black dog communicated through divine sense.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. He truly wanted to burn Fu Huoyang to death.

However, if he used the Heavenly Dao Flames, it would be too easy to connect him with the real him. That was because in the White Lotus Mystery Realm, he had used the Heavenly Dao Flames to resist Feng Jixing’s rare treasure. With his current popularity, he would definitely be thoroughly studied.
Thus, the fact that he had used the Heavenly Dao Flames meant that his false identity could no longer be used.
Use a false body?
Hehe, just ask the world, where would there be so many freakish freaks that could defeat a Core Formation Tier as a Cauldron Forging Tier?
“Let’s tunnel underground,” Ling Han said. He squeezed into the ground, and Destructive Energy surged, easily melting the ground and forming a passageway.
Boom!
Explosions rang out from above. Clearly, Fu Huoyang had also discovered that they were fleeing underground, and had also begun to blast open the ground in pursuit.
Ling Han did not travel in a straight line, and continued to circle around. After more than an hour, he finally managed to throw Fu Huoyang off his tail.

He had succeeded, of course, because his speed was not much inferior to Fu Huoyang. Otherwise, if it was really an ordinary Core Formation Tier cultivator facing an ordinary Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, he would have long since become a corpse.

Ling Han and the large black dog crawled out of the ground. They had already arrived at the side of a large lake, so they simply washed themselves, and began barbequing food with another fire to fill their stomachs.
“Damn it, Grandpa Dog has never been in such a sorry state in my life,” the large black dog said angrily as he ate.

Ling Han, on the other hand, wasn’t angered. This wasn’t the first time he had been hunted, but this Fu Huoyang was indeed detestable. He had a lofty attitude, and treated everyone in the world like an ant. This kind of mentality was truly disgusting.
“This person is definitely on the list of people to be killed,” he said calmly.
“You’re quite calm, brat.” The large black dog shook his head.
“What else can I do?” Ling Han said with a smile.

“We’ll find that Zhou Yun and give him a good thrashing,” the large black dog said. This was their original plan. They would try their best to find someone who was ranked higher to fight and increase their reputation.

“All right.” Ling Han nodded. In any case, he was still a bit away from the Cauldron Forging Tier consummate level, so for the moment, it was impossible for him to break through to the Core Formation Tier. In that case, he had best set aside Fu Huoyang’s matter first, to avoid ruining his mood just thinking about it.
They returned to the city, and had just gone to investigate the whereabouts of Zhou Yun, when they found out a piece of news that disgusted them.

As it turned out, Fu Huoyang had actually issued a bounty to capture Ling Han and the large black dog. This guy was quite omnipotent, and actually found out the identities of Ling Han and the large black dog. He pointed out that he wanted to capture the newly risen Ding Yi and
Ding Er.
He only requested that Ding Yi be captured alive, and as for Ding Er, there was no restriction on his life or death.
And what was the reward?
It was merely a friendship with Fu Huoyang.
A mere Core Formation Tier cultivator-was his friendship worth anything?
It was worth it!

That was because he was a member of the Imperial Clan. As long as they had established a relation to him, then no matter who wanted to target them, they would have to consider whether this would anger an Imperial Clan, and draw a fatal disaster onto themselves. Hence, a great many forces had already moved when they heard the news, and began to search for Ling Han and the large black dog all over the world. There was no lack of those in the Core Formation Tier or even the True Self Tier among them.
“This is too wanton, isn’t it?” The large black dog trembled in anger, “That guy has destroyed an entire city, and in the end, not only is no one going to deal with him, they are even helping
him hunt us down?”
“Er, strictly speaking, they are hunting you down. As for me, there’s no danger to my life,” Ling Han corrected, adjusting the atmosphere.
“Grandpa Dog is really about to die from fury.” The large black dog spat repeatedly, “Is the Imperial Clan really that impressive?”
“Very impressive.” Ling Han nodded, then smiled, “But so what? This person... I am definitely
going to kill him!”
“Little Han, Grandpa Dog likes your unyielding personality.” The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder, “Go, work hard. Grandpa Dog will be silently cheering you on from behind.”
“Get lost!”
None of them dared to be careless. Now, the victim was going to be hunted down all over the world. Just thinking about it made them feel depressed and furious.
With the existence of the Galaxy Network, it was not difficult to find out about Zhou Yun. The man and dog soon set out, planning to leave this planet after completing this mission.
Why didn’t they leave now?
Of course, it was because they couldn’t swallow this injustice. If they left after defeating Zhou Yun, it would be equivalent to telling Fu Huoyang that he wasn’t afraid of him, and that he
was the next to be defeated.

A day later, they arrived at Wide Clouds City. It was said that Zhou Yun was here. “Hehe, please wait.” They arrived at the city gates, and had not even entered the city gates, when they saw a middle-aged man approach them. “I’ve been waiting for you for a long
time.”
Ling Han and the large black dog exchanged looks. They had actually been ambushed?

“Since you’re already here, there’s no need for you to leave,” the middle-aged man said with a smile. He extended a hand toward Ling Han, and a terrifying aura instantly surged into the surroundings. This was an elite at the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. Ling Han shouted lightly, and raised his fists to greet the incoming attack.
Peng! The two of them exchanged a blow, and Ling Han instantly stumbled, taking a step
back. However, the remaining power had already been completely dispersed by the only
Celestial Cauldron, so he was naturally unscathed.
“Yi?” The middle-aged man was obviously shocked. He had not thought that his attack would
actually not succeed.
He humphed lightly, and once again stretched out a hand towards Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 3979: Lackey
paragraphs: “Let’s go!” Ling Han grabbed the large black dog and left quickly.
Now, it was not them that had gone to look for Zhou Yun, but rather they themselves that were being hunted.
“Do you think you can escape?” the middle-aged man said with a humph. He soared into the sky and chased after Ling Han.

“Old sh*tty killer, did we kill your father, or did we sell off your mother? We’ve never met before, so why are you acting so crazy?!” The large black dog had nothing to do anyway, so he started to shout at the top of his lungs.
More importantly, not only was it shouting, but it was also transmitting a message through divine sense.
Thus, the middle-aged man first heard the large black dog’s words in his mind, then heard them again.
F***, this insult actually had a double blow?
The middle-aged man couldn’t help but feel enraged, and attacked repeatedly. However, Ling Han’s speed was extremely fast, and every time he attacked, he would miss.
“Haha, can’t hit us, can’t hit us. You old sh*tty killer, just eat sh*t behind me.” The large black dog laughed loudly, and once again used the “double blow”.
The middle-aged man humphed, and sent a message through divine sense, “Do you guys know who I am?”

He could only use his divine sense to communicate. If he opened his mouth to speak, because the speed of sound was far inferior to their soaring speed, it was naturally impossible for the people chasing behind to transmit his words to the people in front of them.
“I do. Aren’t you my grandson?” The large black dog continued his verbal attack.

The middle-aged man’s expression changed again and again. Why was this large black ox so detestable? Can’t you say a few good words? He suppressed his anger, and said, “This lord’s surname is Cheng, and our Cheng Clan has mastered a secret technique. As long as we have gotten a look, then no matter where it is, we would be able to find it!”
“So, let me give you a word of advice. Stop obediently, and don’t waste any time.”
The large black dog snickered, and said, “Watch my mouth, get lost!”

The middle-aged man merely smirked coldly, “I have already reported all your information back to the clan. Soon, it will not only be me hunting you down, but the entire Cheng Clan will also be working.”

Ling Han was unafraid of this middle-aged man. It wasn’t like he hadn’t killed someone at the consummate level of Core Formation Tier before. Moreover, this person’s strength was only at the Ninth Heaven, so he couldn’t do anything to him at all.
However, if he drew Fu Huoyang out again, things would be much more difficult.

“I’m truly impressed by you people. You actually dared to offend the Imperial Clan!” the middle-aged man said. He continued to chase after Ling Han. This was a psychological battle, and he was going to incite fear in Ling Han and the large black dog’s hearts.

“He’s just from a side branch of the Imperial Clan. What’s there to be afraid of!” The large black dog was responsible for the cursing battle, “On the other hand, your Cheng Clan sounds so awesome, yet in the end, you’re willing to become a dog, pei, cow, for a sidel branch of the Imperial Clan. I look down on you.”
“It’s our honor to be able to work for the Imperial Clan!” the middle-aged man said. He wasn’t ashamed, but rather proud.

With how shameless he was, the large black dog didn’t know what else to say. In his eyes, this was something that he was proud of. In that case, what meaning was there to attack him? Instead, he would consider it as praise.

“Old sh*tty killer, come and chase me. If you manage to catch me, I’ll take you in as my son.” The large black dog started to act shamelessly again. This was his specialty, and he could make anyone seethe with anger.

As expected, the more the middle-aged man listened, the angrier he became, and his expression became uglier and uglier, “I, Cheng Dongbing, swear that when I catch this despicable bull, I will definitely eat you all, bite by bite!”
Being able to incite the fury of a Core Formation Tier elite, the large black dog’s skill was definitely not to be underestimated.

“Haha, there’s still a pile of sh*t in my stomach. Are you also going to eat with me?” The large black dog laughed loudly. He didn’t know the meaning of the word ‘vulgar’. Every time he opened his mouth, it would drive others crazy.

Cheng Dongbing’s expression instantly darkened. Just now, he had still been swearing there that he would devour the large black dog, but in the blink of an eye, the large black dog was asking him if he would be eating sh*t as well. This was really too f despicable, wasn’t it?
“Despicable bull, you’re seeking death!” He was so furious that flames were burning all over his body, and he had turned into a flaming person.

“Yo, old sh*tty killer, why did you suddenly start burning?” The large black dog feigned surprise, “Yi, it can’t be that you are enjoying your food so much that you want to roast yourself and eat yourself, right? Awesome, awesome, you are really awesome. This kind of glutton really makes me prostrate myself in admiration.”

Cheng Dongbing had already sealed his ears, not wanting to listen to the large black dog’s words. However, he could not seal off his mind, because he still had to communicate with his clansmen. Thus, he still had to endure the verbal attacks from the large black dog.
He was already too lazy to speak, and merely stared coldly at the large black dog.
This was already a dead bull.
‘Hmm?’

Ling Han suddenly frowned. His divine sense had already captured seven figures rapidly approaching him from ahead and to the side. It was as if they had spread out a net, and now was the time to reel in the net.
The other members of the Cheng Clan?
It was very possible.

Cheng Dongbing had been contacting the members of his clan through the Galaxy Network. Thus, after such a long time, it was very normal for the members of the Cheng Clan to leap over from various directions through shortcuts.
However, because the distance was too far, he could only sense that someone was coming, but could not confirm the cultivation levels of these people.
He suddenly stopped. There was no point in continuing to run. He would only fall into the encirclement.
“Yi?” Cheng Dongbing was surprised. He had not thought that Ling Han would suddenly stop.
Could it be that the other party had realized?
However, that was fine. In any case, the elites of the clan had already arrived, and the siege was already formed.
“Brat, why aren’t you running anymore?” he asked calmly, filled with a sense of superiority.
Ling Han remained silent. Since the large black dog was here, there was no need for him to be responsible for the mission of attracting animosity.

In a short while, seven figures appeared. They all looked to be in their fifties or sixties, and looked to be middle-aged geezers. Yi, that’s not right. There was actually a young man. He looked to be in his twenties or thirties, at most, and was filled with vitality.

Ling Han focused his gaze on this young man. Judging by the aura that he was exuding, this person was most likely at the level of the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier. “Hehe, come, let me introduce.” When Cheng Dongbing saw how Ling Han was staring at that young man, he couldn’t help but smile. “This is a prodigy of our Cheng Clan, Cheng Wu. He has only cultivated for 80 years, and is already at the consummate level of Core Formation
Tier.”
“Wu’er will definitely be the first of our Cheng Clan to break through to the True Self Tier. In future, he will create a new era for the Cheng Clan.”
Ling Han scoffed, and said, “So you’re already in your seventies or eighties, and you’re still pretending to be young.”
Cheng Wu humphed, and was the first to charge over. He shot out a punch, and divine light flickered, turning into a dozen over swords of light that shot towards Ling Han.

However, this kind of pure energy attack was no big deal for Ling Han. As long as it did not exceed the tolerance limit of the only Celestial Cauldron, he could easily disperse it.
This was the power of about Tenth Heaven.
Ling Han immediately thought, already having a direct understanding of Cheng Wu’s
strength.
He was extremely calm, but Cheng Wu revealed an expression of intense shock.
What kind of Cauldron Forging Tier was this!

sentences.text: “Let’s go!” Ling Han grabbed the large black dog and left quickly.
Now, it was not them that had gone to look for Zhou Yun, but rather they themselves that were being hunted.
“Do you think you can escape?” the middle-aged man said with a humph.
He soared into the sky and chased after Ling Han.
“Old sh*tty killer, did we kill your father, or did we sell off your mother?
We’ve never met before, so why are you acting so crazy?!” The large black dog had nothing to do anyway, so he started to shout at the top of his lungs.
More importantly, not only was it shouting, but it was also transmitting a message through divine sense.
Thus, the middle-aged man first heard the large black dog’s words in his mind, then heard them again.
F***, this insult actually had a double blow?
The middle-aged man couldn’t help but feel enraged, and attacked repeatedly.
However, Ling Han’s speed was extremely fast, and every time he attacked, he would miss.
“Haha, can’t hit us, can’t hit us.
You old sh*tty killer, just eat sh*t behind me.” The large black dog laughed loudly, and once again used the “double blow”.
The middle-aged man humphed, and sent a message through divine sense, “Do you guys know who I am?”
He could only use his divine sense to communicate.

If he opened his mouth to speak, because the speed of sound was far inferior to their soaring speed, it was naturally impossible for the people chasing behind to transmit his words to the people in front of them.
“I do.
Aren’t you my grandson?” The large black dog continued his verbal attack.
The middle-aged man’s expression changed again and again.
Why was this large black ox so detestable?
Can’t you say a few good words?
He suppressed his anger, and said, “This lord’s surname is Cheng, and our Cheng Clan has mastered a secret technique.
As long as we have gotten a look, then no matter where it is, we would be able to find it!”
“So, let me give you a word of advice.
Stop obediently, and don’t waste any time.”
The large black dog snickered, and said, “Watch my mouth, get lost!”
The middle-aged man merely smirked coldly, “I have already reported all your information back to the clan.
Soon, it will not only be me hunting you down, but the entire Cheng Clan will also be working.”
Ling Han was unafraid of this middle-aged man.
It wasn’t like he hadn’t killed someone at the consummate level of Core Formation Tier before.
Moreover, this person’s strength was only at the Ninth Heaven, so he couldn’t do anything to him at all.
However, if he drew Fu Huoyang out again, things would be much more difficult.
“I’m truly impressed by you people.
You actually dared to offend the Imperial Clan!” the middle-aged man said.
He continued to chase after Ling Han.
This was a psychological battle, and he was going to incite fear in Ling Han and the large black dog’s hearts.
“He’s just from a side branch of the Imperial Clan.

What’s there to be afraid of!” The large black dog was responsible for the cursing battle, “On the other hand, your Cheng Clan sounds so awesome, yet in the end, you’re willing to become a dog, pei, cow, for a sidel branch of the Imperial Clan.
I look down on you.”
“It’s our honor to be able to work for the Imperial Clan!” the middle-aged man said.
He wasn’t ashamed, but rather proud.
With how shameless he was, the large black dog didn’t know what else to say.
In his eyes, this was something that he was proud of.
In that case, what meaning was there to attack him?
Instead, he would consider it as praise.
“Old sh*tty killer, come and chase me.
If you manage to catch me, I’ll take you in as my son.” The large black dog started to act shamelessly again.
This was his specialty, and he could make anyone seethe with anger.

As expected, the more the middle-aged man listened, the angrier he became, and his expression became uglier and uglier, “I, Cheng Dongbing, swear that when I catch this despicable bull, I will definitely eat you all, bite by bite!”
Being able to incite the fury of a Core Formation Tier elite, the large black dog’s skill was definitely not to be underestimated.
“Haha, there’s still a pile of sh*t in my stomach.
Are you also going to eat with me?” The large black dog laughed loudly.
He didn’t know the meaning of the word ‘vulgar’.
Every time he opened his mouth, it would drive others crazy.

This was really too f despicable, wasn’t it?
“Despicable bull, you’re seeking death!” He was so furious that flames were burning all over his body, and he had turned into a flaming person.

“Yo, old sh*tty killer, why did you suddenly start burning?” The large black dog feigned surprise, “Yi, it can’t be that you are enjoying your food so much that you want to roast yourself and eat yourself, right?
Awesome, awesome, you are really awesome.
This kind of glutton really makes me prostrate myself in admiration.”

Thus, he still had to endure the verbal attacks from the large black dog.
He was already too lazy to speak, and merely stared coldly at the large black dog.
This was already a dead bull.
‘Hmm?’

The other members of the Cheng Clan?
It was very possible.

Thus, after such a long time, it was very normal for the members of the Cheng Clan to leap over from various directions through shortcuts.
However, because the distance was too far, he could only sense that someone was coming, but could not confirm the cultivation levels of these people.
He suddenly stopped.
There was no point in continuing to run.
He would only fall into the encirclement.
“Yi?” Cheng Dongbing was surprised.
He had not thought that Ling Han would suddenly stop.
Could it be that the other party had realized?
However, that was fine.

chapters.title: Chapter 3980: Slaying a person, leaving
paragraphs: “Are you very shocked?” The large black dog laughed mischievously, “This is the strength of my underling. All of you, clean your behinds, I will go and kick them one by one later.”
“This boy is indeed a little strange,” Cheng Dongbing said. “I struck him just now, but my power was like a clay ox entering the sea.”
“No wonder an Imperial Son wanted to apprehend him,” an elite from the Cheng Clan said with a nod. There was greed in his eyes.
Cheng Dongbing immediately warned, “This is a person that the Imperial Son wants, so don’t have any other ideas.”
The elite from the Cheng Clan shuddered, and clarity returned to his eyes.
If he dared to rob the Imperial Clan of their prize, then no one in this world would be able to save him.
Cheng Wu pondered for a moment, “If a weapon is used, he can disperse the power, but it is not definite that he would be able to disperse the sharpness of a weapon.”
F***, this person that was acting young was quite discerning.

Ling Han remained calm and collected. The only Celestial Cauldron could only dispel power attacks, but against attacks delivered by sharp weapons, such dispelling effects would not be as satisfactory.
“En!” Cheng Dongbing and the others all drew out their weapons. Some were sabers, some were swords, but there were also rods, hammers and whatnot. They were all Three Star Spirit Tools.
“They’re all strong, Grandpa Dog can do nothing!” the large black dog sent a mental message to Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “There’s no need for you to attack. I’ll deal with them with a few casual moves, and we’ll leave.”
“All right.” The large black dog nodded, “Revenge is a dish best served cold.”
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Cheng Dongbing and the others all charged over at the same time, blasting Ling Han with their sharp weapons.
The murderous aura surged forth.

Weng, instantly, even if they were in the Core Formation Tier, so what? The bodies of the eight elites all paused, and sank into a momentary sluggishness. Ling Han took the chance to charge out. He focused on the weakest Core Formation Tier, and charged forwards to deliver a powerful attack.
The God Slaying Technique.

This was the Pseudo-Emperor Technique, and combined with the Nine Suns Divine Scroll, in truth, in terms of the present stage, its might was not the slightest bit inferior to the Imperial Technique, and added with the fact that he had also used Destructive Energy, black-coloured energy danced between his hands.
Pu!
He clapped his palms together, and pressed them down on the chest of that member of the Cheng Clan.
Visibly, that person’s chest immediately caved in, and Ling Han’s hands actually stretched out from the other side.

Destructive Energy could destroy everything in the first place, and added with the terrifying might of the God Slaying Technique, the might of a single strike was chillingly powerful, directly killing a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Of course, this was only the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han’s attack had succeeded, and he didn’t linger in battle at all, continuing to advance.
In an instant, the seven members of the Cheng Clan had already recovered. Seeing one of their clansmen killed, they were all seething with rage.
“Despicable brat that should be killed!” Cheng Dongbing shouted harshly, his eyes spitting
fire.
Meanwhile, the large black dog laughed loudly, “Old sh*tty killer, even if my brother was standing in front of you, allowing you to attack him, would you dare to kill him?”
Cheng Dongbing couldn’t help but feel his aura weaken. Would he dare to kill?
Of course, he didn’t dare to. Ling Han was someone that Fu Huoyang wanted alive. Would he dare to disobey a member of the Imperial Clan?
“That’s why, old geezer, don’t brag so much in the future.” The large black dog waved his paw, and said, “It’s very embarrassing!”
The seven members of the Cheng Clan were all angered to death. This person had killed one of their own, and actually still dared to mock and ridicule them?
“This despicable bull must be chopped into pieces!”
“En, we cannot allow it to die too easily.”
“At least half a year’s time!”
Meanwhile, the large black dog looked at Ling Han, and said, “Strange, you were clearly the one who killed him, so why do they hate me so much?”
Though these words were directed at Ling Han, it had used its divine sense to transmit a message so that the other members of the Cheng Clan could hear it clearly.
Instantly, the members of the Cheng Clan were naturally even more furious.
“Don’t look at me with such anger. If you do, I’ll be roasted into a barbequed beef.” The large black dog mocked them to its heart’s content, looking very pleased with itself.

Ling Han still tunneled underground, throwing off his pursuers, but just as Cheng Dongbing had said, they were skilled in tracking. Merely half a day had passed, and the Cheng Clan appeared once more.
After exchanging a few moves, Ling Han began to retreat.

The Cheng Clan had also learnt their lesson, and placed great importance on the protection of their clansmen, especially Cheng Wu. He was the least affected by Ling Han’s murderous aura. Thus, after the murderous aura attacked him, he reacted at the first instant, and made a move on Ling Han, saving his clansmen.

“Ding Yi, don’t even think of escaping this time!” Cheng Wu stated calmly, “I have also activated Galaxy Network’s livestream. Your hideous state of being hunted all the way here will be seen by everyone.”
“Yi, this old brat is quite good at playing!” The large black dog smiled, and said, “Brother, you have to take note of your image. Everyone in the universe is staring at you.”
Ling Han smiled faintly, not taking it to heart.
Firstly, he was using a false identity, and secondly, a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was being hunted down by seven Core Formation Tier cultivators. What was there to be embarrassed about?
If anyone was going to lose face, that would be the Cheng Clan. To deal with a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, they actually wanted seven Core Formation Tier cultivators to join
forces.
“Die!”

Cheng Wu and Cheng Dongbing both controlled their Spirit Tools to charge over. This gave Ling Han a headache. After all, the only Celestial Cauldron could only disperse the barrage of pure power. His physical body was not strong enough to withstand being killed by a higher
level Spirit Tool.
Let’s go.
Ling Han immediately turned around and left without a fight.
“Brat, aren’t you very arrogant?”
“Come battle!”
“What are you running for!”
The members of Cheng Clan all launched verbal attacks, as if they felt that they could not
allow the large black dog to be ahead of them.
However, they clearly had the wrong idea.
Who was the large black dog?
An overlord of insults, in terms of verbal attacks alone, if it claimed to be second, no one
would dare claim to be first!
So what if the seven of them joined in on the conversation? The large black dog began a verbal battle, engaging in verbal abuse.
At first, the members of the Cheng Clan were still able to argue back, but as he continued to curse, they were defeated. They were completely no match for the despicable large black dog.
-He had cultivated his strength through cursing for several epochs, and was indeed not someone that the members of the Cheng Clan could compare to.
In the end, the members of the Cheng Clan all obediently shut their mouths, and merely continued to hunt them down.
This was broadcasted live through the Galaxy Network. Everyone saw this scene, and
expressed their shock at Ling Han’s battle prowess. West Heavenly Realm really produced a
freakish being that could stand against Ling Han.
Then, they all warned themselves mentally that if they encountered that large black ox, they definitely should not use their mouths if they could make a move.
That would probably drive them to die with fury,
Chasing, fleeing, chasing, fleeing, these seemed to have become the main theme that would
never change.
“Yi, Little Han, where are you running off to?” The large black dog saw that Ling Han was running in circles, and had no intention of leaving this planet.
“To find Zhou Yun, of course,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Hiss, there are seven people chasing behind us, and it is possible that there are even more
people lying in ambush. You still want to look for Zhou Yun?” The large black dog was given a
fright.
“Isn’t that more fun?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“You’re truly a maniac!” the large black dog remarked. “However, Grandpa Dog likes you!”
Ling Han deliberately took a roundabout route, not allowing the members of the Cheng Clan

to guess his target. They could only trace him from the clues that he had left behind. On this day, he once again cast off the members of the Cheng Clan, and returned to Wide Cloud City. Zhou Yun was still here, and had not left.

chapters.title: Chapter 3981: Defeating Zhou Yun
paragraphs: Ling Han entered the city. This time, no one came to stop him.
He strode forwards. There was no time to waste, and he headed directly for the inn where Zhou Yun was staying.
Ling Han did not know why Zhou Yuan had come here. There was no enmity between the two of them, but I’m sorry, ho asked you to come?
Not long after, Ling Han arrived at the entrance of the inn.
He smiled faintly, and strode in.
His divine sense spread out. With a simple sweep, he was able to locate a powerful divine
sense. Though it was only Cauldron Forging Tier-level, its energy was surging, and was very shocking.
“Zhou Yun!” he called out softly, but his voice penetrated through the layers of walls.
“Who is it?” Zhou Yun continued.
“Hehe, I want to spar with you,” Ling Han said.
“I don’t have time!” Zhou Yun directly refused.
“You don’t dare?” Ling Han provoked.
“Are you worthy?” Zhou Yun countered.
Ling Han sighed, then smiled and said, “At first, I felt a little guilty beating you up for no reason, but with how toxic your mouth is, I can beat you up with a clear conscience.”
“Where did you get such courage from?” Zhou Yun smirked coldly.
Ling Han had already arrived outside the courtyard that Zhou Yun was in. He shot out a punch, and peng, the courtyard wall instantly crumbled.
Instantly, Zhou Yun leaped out, and the others also rushed out when they heard the commotion.
“How dare you! You actually dare to cause trouble in the territory of our Ma Clan!” one of them shouted harshly.
Ling Han casually tossed out a few Dao Stones, “Apologies, I’ll pay.”
That person did not take it, and merely stared at Ling Han. He asked coldly, “Do you think that the pride of our Ma Clan is only worth these few Dao Stones?”
Ling Han ignored him. He didn’t have time to waste on random people.
“Yi, isn’t this Ding Yi?”
“It really is!”
“Wasn’t he being hunted down by the Cheng Clan?”
“Hiss, being hunted down by the Cheng Clan, he still came to challenge Zhou Yun?”
Someone recognized Ling Han and couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.

That person from the Ma Clan was originally about to make a move, but when he heard the discussions of the masses, he couldn’t help but pull back the foot that he had stepped out. Though he was also a Cauldron Forging Tier, how far was he from a freak like Ling Han? Thus, if he made a move, he would definitely be asking for his own humiliation. Forget it. In any case, it was just a wall that had collapsed, so he just had to repair it.
“You are Ding Yi?” Zhou Yun was surprised, and looked towards Ling Han.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.

“Ha, everyone says that your battle prowess is comparable to the Core Formation Tier, but I don’t believe it!” Zhou Yun showed a hint of mockery, “How could the strongest limit of Cauldron Forging Tier possibly touch the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier?”
“I’ve seen the livestream. You’re just running a little faster.”
Hehe, where did he get such confidence from?
Ling Han strode towards Zhou Yun, “Then come and experience it.”
“Do you think I’m afraid of you!” Zhou Yun said calmly.
At first, he disdained from exchanging blows with Ling Han, but after hearing that it was Ding Yi, fighting spirit finally arose in him.

Ling Han flicked out a finger at an extremely slow speed. Against a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, there was really no need for him to be serious. Instead, he had to control his power, and not overexert himself, killing him.
Meanwhile, Zhou Yun’s expression changed drastically. Just how much are you looking down on me?
He gave a loud shout, and shot out a punch at Ling Han.
Peng!

This punch had not even landed on Ling Han, when Zhou Yun was sent flying. Peng, peng, peng! He had crashed through at least a dozen over walls, and only then did he use up all his momentum. With a pa, he collapsed onto the ground.
Hiss, what powerful battle prowess.
“The rumors aren’t false. Ding Yi really has the battle prowess of the Core Formation Tier!”
“He can battle against that freakish freak from the North Heavenly Realm.”
“Our Western Heavenly Realm has also produced a freakish freak!”

Everyone was rueful. The legend of Ding Yi was not something that had just happened in a day or two. However, a great many people did not believe it, and now that they had seen it with their own eyes, it was true, which made them extremely excited.

Ling Han smiled, turned and left. He had finally capsized Zhou Yuan’s carriage. Though it was only a matter of a single strike, but because of Fu Huoyang and the Cheng Clan, it had actually dragged on for so long.
He left through the Transfer Formation. In this way, even if the Cheng Clan had grasped the secret technique of tracking, they would still have to guess which planet he had gone to first.
This could win him at least two to three days’ time.
It wasn’t long before news of Ding Yi defeating Zhou Yun spread throughout the galaxy through Galaxy Network.

Ding Yi’s victory was within everyone’s expectations. After all, Ding Yi had already displayed a terrifying strength that was no weaker than Ling Han’s. However, when he was being hunted down by the Cheng Clan, he actually still managed to find the time to defeat Zhou Yun. The significance of this was completely different.

It was said that there were a few Holy Lands that had become interested in Ling Han, but because of Fu Huoyang, they did not dare rashly extend an olive branch to Ling Han. If they really offended an Imperial Clan, that was no joke.

That’s right. Fu Huoyang was only a branch clansman, but it could not be denied that some Imperial Clan members were unbelievably overbearing, and incredibly protective of their clansmen. What could they do?
Unless another Imperial Clan moved, only then would they be unafraid of Fu Huoyang.
Thus, there was a voice on the Galaxy Network that hoped that the Donglin Imperial Clan could send an invitation to Ling Han. At that time, would the Cheng Clan still dare to hunt Ling Han down?
Even Fu Huoyang had to consider it. He was only a branch clansman of the Imperial Clan. However, the Donglin Imperial Clan had absolutely no intention of speaking.
And at this time, Ling Han had already arrived at the Cold Sealed Planet.

He and the large black dog once again changed their appearance and soul fluctuations, planning to break through to the Core Formation Tier here, and then return to seek out the Cheng Clan for an accounting.
A man who did not exact revenge was not a man of noble character, what more with Ling Han and the large black dog’s personalities.

“Grandpa Dog wants to work hard on cultivation, and advance into the Core Formation Tier as soon as possible!” The large black dog howled. He had been hunted all these days, and he was filled with anger. He really wanted to take a bite out of someone.

Ling Han shook his head, “You would have to rush up to the Nine Cauldrons, at least. If possible, try Ten Cauldrons, and I will see if I can help you create the Fusion Cauldron.” The large black dog was indeed speaking in a moment of anger. Moreover, even if he broke through to the Core Formation Tier now, how could he be a match for a late stage or consummate stage Core Formation Tier cultivator?
“Grandpa Dog just can’t swallow this anger,” the large black dog said angrily.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Believe me, the people from the Cheng Clan are much more
aggrieved by you.”
Speaking of this, the large black dog’s expression became smug again, “Of course, Grandpa
Dog’s battle prowess is not just for show.”
“All right, hurry up and cultivate to Nine Cauldrons,” Ling Han said. “You don’t lack cultivation resources now, so charge up to Nine Cauldrons as soon as possible.”
“All right.”
The man and dog both began to cultivate earnestly. Under the pressure, they were both filled with motivation.
With Ling Han, the Alchemy Emperor, present, there was naturally no shortage of alchemical pills, allowing their cultivation levels to improve very quickly.
Ling Han was still searching on the Galaxy Network, wanting to see if there were any Feng Lin
Stones to make preparations in advance for his cultivation after advancing into the Core
Formation Tier.
This was truly a precious treasure. Great forces would all use it on their disciples, and very rarely would they take it out to sell. Thus, Ling Han could only be disappointed.
In the blink of an eye, a month had already passed.
Ling Han had already cultivated his only Celestial Cauldron to the pinnacle, and was
completely perfect.

He was still unwilling to give up, and wanted to see if he could form a second Celestial Cauldron. However, this was really wishful thinking. The only Celestial Cauldron was the emperor among Celestial Cauldrons. It could not allow a second Celestial Cauldron to exist.
Even the Celestial Cauldron’s core couldn’t be formed. That was a logic that surpassed heaven
and earth.
No means no.
Sigh, it would be better to break through to the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han thought
helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3982: Breaking through to the Core Formation Tier
paragraphs: If others knew of Ling Han’s thoughts, they would probably scold him for showing off. Wasn’t it?
You have already formed Ten Cauldrons, and Fusion Cauldron, so what else do you want if you don’t break through to the Core Formation Tier?
If Ling Han really had to cultivate another Celestial Cauldron, the heavens would really be throwing up blood.
Ling Han sighed. He really wanted to cultivate a few more Celestial Cauldrons. If he had a few more of the “only” Celestial Cauldron, just what level would his battle prowess reach?

Unfortunately, no matter how many cauldrons were fused into one, as long as the Fusion Cauldron was formed, it meant that they had walked to the end of the Cauldron Forging Tier. The only Celestial Cauldron was too strong, and could not allow a new Celestial Cauldron to emerge at all. No matter how strong you were, or how talented you were, it was useless, because this was you opposing yourself.
Alright, he began to break through to the Core Formation Tier.

He had been battling all these days, so there was absolutely no need to worry about whether he had compacted his cultivation level. In this cruel battle, how could there be any possibility that his cultivation level would be unstable?

The first step to breaking through to the Core Formation Tier was to nurture the Celestial Core in one of the Celestial Cauldrons, and then use the other Celestial Cauldrons as nutrients to nurture the Celestial Core.
Ling Han only had one Celestial Cauldron, so there was no need for him to worry about which one he would choose.
The problem was, how could this Celestial Core be formed?
It couldn’t just appear out of thin air, right?
The foundation of the Celestial Foundation was the power of heaven and earth, while the core of the Celestial Core was the logic of heaven and earth.
The heaven and earth channelled, and planets were born and destroyed. There was always a kind of logic that ruled over all of this in this world.

Of course, Ling Han was still not qualified to come into contact with the logic of heaven and earth. This could be called Regulations, Rules, and Laws, but that was all right. Hadn’t he cultivated a higher level of energy?

Whether it was the Heavenly Dao Flames that he had come up with himself, or the Destructive Energy that he had cultivated from the Spirit Diagram, these were actually manifestations of heaven and earth, displaying energy in some special form.

At present, he had a great many options. He only had to set a high-level energy as his target, and extract a sliver of Regulations, and he would be able to use this as the core to construct the Celestial Core.

Of course, the highest level was definitely the Heavenly Dao Flames and Destructive Energy. The Heavenly Dao Flames were the supreme flames of heaven and earth. They could even refine the Origin Gold, and the core of a Celestial Core nurtured from it was definitely awesome. However, Ling Han had only grasped a sliver of the shards through his own observations, and was still far from the real Heavenly Dao Flames.
What about Destructive Energy?

This level was also frighteningly high, and had extraordinary effects against Yin souls. Ling Han suspected that Destructive Energy was even more awesome than Heavenly Dao Flames- even if both were in a complete state.
The problem was that he had only obtained two incomplete Spiritual Diagrams, but had not pieced together the full appearance of Destructive Energy.
Which one should he choose?
Each one was incomplete, and they both had their own regrets. Thus, choosing which one was the problem.
Ling Han hesitated for a moment before deciding to choose Destructive Energy.
There was no other reason. The level of Destructive Energy was higher, so the Celestial Core
that was cultivated with this as the core was definitely of a higher level as well.
Moreover, the third stage of the Core Formation Tier was branding.
Calm down, calm down.
Ling Han thought to himself. The more anxious he was, the less likely it was that he would
succeed.
He composed himself and continued.
A few days later, Ling Han heard a commotion. Then, he saw a few people push open the doors and enter, as if they were the owners of this place.
Ling Han and the large black dog were presently staying in a side courtyard of an inn. It was a solitary courtyard, and was very quiet, but now, this silence had clearly been broken.
He looked over, and saw that the people who had barged in were Cheng Dongbing and the
others.
They managed to catch up to him even with that?
Ling Han immediately stood up, and shouted, “Who are you people? What right do you have
to barge in?”

His current appearance and soul fluctuations were completely different, and the large black dog was in the inner room, the large black dog had long since transformed into the appearance of a white wolf. He had also reluctantly removed his iconic iron underwear, and it
could be said that he was really “unrecognizable”.
Thus, Ling Han was completely capable of questioning him in a justifiable manner. As a
victim, this was the kind of reaction that he should have.
“En?” The seven members of the Cheng Clan swept their gaze over Ling Han a few times, then completely ignored him. They strode into the house and began their search.
“Who are you people? What do you want to do?” Ling Han shouted from outside, appearing
both anxious and helpless.
It wasn’t long before the exasperated shouts of the large black dog rang out from the room. It was as if someone had peeped on him while he was bathing.
After a while, Cheng Dongbing and his group walked out of their rooms, still completely
ignoring Ling Han.
A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was naturally beneath their notice.
“Strange, that despicable brat should be nearby.”
“Let’s search again. After all, this is a big place.”
“All right.”
The seven of them walked out, and still didn’t cast a second look at Ling Han. However, they
didn’t know that this was the target they were looking for.
