chapters.title: Chapter 3983: Primal Chaos Celestial Core
paragraphs: Cheng Dongbing and the others left. They naturally wouldn’t give up. Instead, they continued to search for “Ding Yi” and “Ding Er”.
A cold smile appeared on Ling Han’s face as he watched their receding figures disappear behind the courtyard wall.
Let these people be smug for a few more days.
He sat down in a cross-legged position, and continued to break through to the Core Formation Tier.
With this, a sense of urgency instantly rose up in his heart.
For someone like him, it was impossible for him to retreat under pressure. It would only stimulate an even stronger motivation.
‘Come!’
Destructive Energy was extracted by him, and he dissected it to search for its essence.
One day, two days, three days, he continued to experience failure. It was as if taking this step was impossible, causing him to repeatedly encounter obstacles.
Should he switch to another high-level energy to analyze?
No.

This thought only flashed through Ling Han’s mind before he resolutely rejected it. He walked the path of the strongest. He clearly knew that Destructive Energy was stronger, yet he still settled for the next best thing. Then, even if he succeeded, his Dao Heart would also be affected.
In the future, when he was breaking through a barrier, he would involuntarily want to avoid it, and he would slowly disappear among the masses.
In history, a great many super geniuses had disappeared in this manner. It was not because they had died, but rather because they were no longer prodigies.
He definitely could not retreat in the slightest on the path of pursuing the strongest.
Continue!
He thought to himself, and then extracted the Destructive Energy, studying it even more earnestly.
After failing a few more times, Ling Han suddenly discovered that when the energy had been exhausted, there was actually still a speck of light left behind.
How could just ‘speck’ be used to describe light?
However, this was indeed the case. This was an indescribably small speck of light. It clearly wasn’t dazzling, yet it gave off an incredibly dazzling feeling.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited. Was this the fundamental nature of Destructive Energy?
Pa, without waiting for him to study it, this spot of light dimmed, and Ling Han could vaguely see that this was an incomplete seal.
Again, again. This time, his confidence was instantly boosted a hundredfold.
He did not lack motivation, nor did he lack fighting spirit, but when he saw hope, he would naturally feel even more confident.
He summoned the Destructive Energy again, then analyzed it bit by bit. Finally, the particle of light appeared again.
However, he did not improve. This was far from enough.
Ling Han continued to extract Destructive Energy. After analyzing it, two spots of light finally appeared.
Very good.
Ling Han tried continuously, and every time, he was extremely diligent. Furthermore, the number of spots of light that he dissected also increased, from two to three, then to five, then to ten.
After reaching a certain amount, Ling Han discovered that there was actually a connection between the specks of light, and they could be arranged.
He tried to combine them, but the spots of light dimmed too quickly, leaving him pitifully little time.
The heavens were just. If you wanted to break through, it would summon an internal demon to interfere. If you failed, you would die, and if you succeeded, your soul would be nourished.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and continued to nurture the core of the Celestial Core.
Another twelve days later, Ling Han finally stopped.
The Celestial Core was formed.
In the Celestial Cauldron in his mind, there was a round ball that looked to be only the size of
a walnut. It seemed to have been formed by the Primal Chaos, and could not be seen clearly at all. At the same time, there was also an incredibly ancient aura, just like the Primitive
Celestial Gate.

This was natural. The origin of Ling Han’s Celestial Cauldron was the Celestial Foundation that was built from an imitation of the Primitive Celestial Gate. The Celestial Core that was nurtured from this naturally also inherited this trait.
There was also a bolt of lightning that was circling around the Celestial Core.
This was the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.
“It’s said that if the Heaven Cauldron and Earth Cauldron breaks through, the Celestial Core
that he cultivates is bronze in colour, and is called Copper Core, and when Four to Six Cauldrons break through, it is a Silver Core, and for Seven to Nine Cauldrons, it is a Golden
Core that is formed.”
“I am Ten Cauldrons fused into one, and the Celestial Core is the Primal Chaos Celestial Core.”
“Yi, then what kind of Celestial Core would be cultivated by Nine Cauldrons merged into one,
or Ten Cauldrons?
Ling Han was slightly curious, but no matter what Celestial Core it was, it definitely could not
compare to his Primal Chaos Celestial Core.
Core Formation Tier, success!
Ling Han stood up. This breakthrough had taken over a month’s time, and could be
considered long.
“Little Han, you’ve succeeded?” The large black dog was also cultivating diligently. When it
saw Ling Han suddenly stand up, it was immediately overjoyed, and immediately jumped up.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I succeeded.”

He raised his right foot and stepped on empty air. A shocking scene appeared, as if there really was a staircase in the air, allowing him to step firmly. Then, his left foot followed, ascending into the air with each step.
Stepping on air, Core Formation Tier!
The large black dog laughed loudly, “All right, let’s immediately go and beat up the b@stards
from the Cheng Clan.”
Ling Han also smiled, “There’s no hurry. I have to get used to my current battle prowess
first.”

His foundations were too sturdy, so he didn’t have to worry about his cultivation level becoming unstable after just breaking through. However, he indeed had to get used to his own battle prowess first. Only by knowing himself and his enemy would he be able to win a hundred battles.

sentences.text: Cheng Dongbing and the others left.
They naturally wouldn’t give up.
Instead, they continued to search for “Ding Yi” and “Ding Er”.
A cold smile appeared on Ling Han’s face as he watched their receding figures disappear behind the courtyard wall.
Let these people be smug for a few more days.
He sat down in a cross-legged position, and continued to break through to the Core Formation Tier.
With this, a sense of urgency instantly rose up in his heart.
For someone like him, it was impossible for him to retreat under pressure.
It would only stimulate an even stronger motivation.
‘Come!’
Destructive Energy was extracted by him, and he dissected it to search for its essence.
One day, two days, three days, he continued to experience failure.
It was as if taking this step was impossible, causing him to repeatedly encounter obstacles.
Should he switch to another high-level energy to analyze?
No.
This thought only flashed through Ling Han’s mind before he resolutely rejected it.
He walked the path of the strongest.
He clearly knew that Destructive Energy was stronger, yet he still settled for the next best thing.
Then, even if he succeeded, his Dao Heart would also be affected.
In the future, when he was breaking through a barrier, he would involuntarily want to avoid it, and he would slowly disappear among the masses.
In history, a great many super geniuses had disappeared in this manner.
It was not because they had died, but rather because they were no longer prodigies.
He definitely could not retreat in the slightest on the path of pursuing the strongest.
Continue!
He thought to himself, and then extracted the Destructive Energy, studying it even more earnestly.
After failing a few more times, Ling Han suddenly discovered that when the energy had been exhausted, there was actually still a speck of light left behind.
How could just ‘speck’ be used to describe light?
However, this was indeed the case.
This was an indescribably small speck of light.
It clearly wasn’t dazzling, yet it gave off an incredibly dazzling feeling.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited.
Was this the fundamental nature of Destructive Energy?
Pa, without waiting for him to study it, this spot of light dimmed, and Ling Han could vaguely see that this was an incomplete seal.
Again, again.
This time, his confidence was instantly boosted a hundredfold.
He did not lack motivation, nor did he lack fighting spirit, but when he saw hope, he would naturally feel even more confident.
He summoned the Destructive Energy again, then analyzed it bit by bit.
Finally, the particle of light appeared again.
However, he did not improve.
This was far from enough.
Ling Han continued to extract Destructive Energy.
After analyzing it, two spots of light finally appeared.
Very good.
Ling Han tried continuously, and every time, he was extremely diligent.
Furthermore, the number of spots of light that he dissected also increased, from two to three, then to five, then to ten.
After reaching a certain amount, Ling Han discovered that there was actually a connection between the specks of light, and they could be arranged.
He tried to combine them, but the spots of light dimmed too quickly, leaving him pitifully little time.
The heavens were just.
If you wanted to break through, it would summon an internal demon to interfere.
If you failed, you would die, and if you succeeded, your soul would be nourished.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and continued to nurture the core of the Celestial Core.
Another twelve days later, Ling Han finally stopped.
The Celestial Core was formed.
In the Celestial Cauldron in his mind, there was a round ball that looked to be only the size of
a walnut.
It seemed to have been formed by the Primal Chaos, and could not be seen clearly at all.
At the same time, there was also an incredibly ancient aura, just like the Primitive
Celestial Gate.
This was natural.
The origin of Ling Han’s Celestial Cauldron was the Celestial Foundation that was built from an imitation of the Primitive Celestial Gate.
The Celestial Core that was nurtured from this naturally also inherited this trait.
There was also a bolt of lightning that was circling around the Celestial Core.
This was the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning.
“It’s said that if the Heaven Cauldron and Earth Cauldron breaks through, the Celestial Core
that he cultivates is bronze in colour, and is called Copper Core, and when Four to Six Cauldrons break through, it is a Silver Core, and for Seven to Nine Cauldrons, it is a Golden
Core that is formed.”

or Ten Cauldrons?

compare to his Primal Chaos Celestial Core.

chapters.title: Chapter 3984: Revenge
paragraphs: Ling Han flew out of the city and exploded in the mountains, using celestial technique after celestial technique.
After a long while, he stopped.
Right now, his raw power was at the Eighth Heaven.

With this breakthrough, he had increased his power by a whole Five Heavens, which could be considered terrifying. It should be known that even for a supreme prodigy like Feng Jixing, taking this step only increased his power by Three Heavens.
Nine Cauldrons fused into one and Ten Cauldrons fused into one were really too different.

Power was the foundation of everything. With the support of Eight Heavens of power, if Ling Han channeled Venerate Tier-level techniques, his battle prowess would be able to soar to Ninth Heaven, and if he used Saint Techniques, it would be Tenth Heaven!

If he wanted to beat up normal consummate stage Core Formation Tier cultivators, then he wouldn’t need to use the Saint Technique anymore, or wait for the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning to explode. Instead, he would only need to channel the Venerate Tier-level technique.

In terms of maximum battle prowess, Demonic Monkey Fists, God Slaying Technique, and so on could allow him to unleash the battle prowess of Eleven Heavens, and as for Primal Chaos Divine Lightning... Twelve Heavens!
Most importantly, not only did he have astonishing battle prowess, he also had other means to weaken his opponent’s battle prowess.

For example, the barrage of murderous aura, the suppression of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core. It was unknown how many Heavens of battle prowess the Primal Chaos Celestial Core could weaken his opponent by, but with his opponent weakening while his battle prowess was strong, it was equivalent to increasing Ling Han’s battle prowess.
In other words, as long as his opponent was struck by the murderous aura, and affected by the Primal Chaos Celestial Core, Ling Han’s maximum battle prowess would surpass Twelve
Heavens.
Just how terrifying was this?
He had just broken through to the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han broke into a grin. As expected, the increase in battle prowess brought about by advancing a major tier was really too great.
He didn’t return at the first instant. Instead, he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and began to refine this treasure.
This was a future Imperial Weapon, so how could it not be treasured?

In the first place, the Origin Gold had great might, but was limited by Ling Han’s strength and could not be used. Now that he had refined it, the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also began to increase by tons.
The protective ability of Primal Chaos Qi and the destructive power of lightning had both broken through to a new height.
Ling Han thought for a moment, and attempted to replicate the Divine Beast patterns of the Celestial Cauldron on the body of the tower.

It could not be helped. The Celestial Cauldron was destined to disappear. Then, when the Celestial Cauldron disappeared, the images of the Divine Beasts on the cauldron would also disappear. That would be too much of a pity.

Thus, if he could replicate the images of the Divine Beasts on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he would be able to preserve it eternally, and this would also add another might to this future Imperial Weapon.
He would do as he said.
Ling Han put his thoughts into practice, and copied the images of the Divine Beasts on the Celestial Cauldron.
This took him a whole five days, and finally, ten patterns of the Divine Beasts appeared on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel speechless. After a while, he finally said, “If you do this, it would be very easy for the spectators to scold us for inserting unnecessary fillers.”
“We inserted fillers with our abilities, and they can decide whether to watch or not.” The large black dog was very simple-minded.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Forget it. I don’t have that much time to waste. I’ll just go and visit them directly.”
The large black dog sighed, expressing his regret. To think that he had been mulling over the script for so long, but very soon, he became excited.
It was time for revenge.
They walked towards the Cheng Clan Manor, and in a short while, they arrived at the entrance
of a massive manor. It was decorated with red bricks and green tiles, looking incredibly
imposing.
There was a row of eight guards at the main doors. All of them looked fierce, as if they were saying that no one was allowed to enter.
“What are you doing?” When Ling Han and the large black dog approached, the eight people instantly shouted in unison.
The large black dog bared his teeth in a grin, “Looking for trouble!”
“How dare you!” Those eight people were all furious. The Cheng Clan was a domineering
force of the Wide Western City, and this man and bull actually dared to come to their doors
and say that they were looking for trouble. Just how arrogant was this?
Yi, one person and one bull?
The eight of them faltered for a moment before suddenly coming to their senses.
Wasn’t this the person that the higher-ups were looking for?
Hiss!
They were all excited. They had searched high and low for him, yet they had found him without much effort. This man and bull had actually delivered themselves to their doorstep.
This was great. It was time for them to make a great contribution.
“I’ll go report it!”
“No, let me go!”
“Holy f*ck!”
The eight of them scrambled over one another, all wanting to go in and report this to the higher ups. This was a great merit, and those who went to report the news would definitely be
heavily rewarded.

“What’s the point of fighting? Do you really think we are here to die?” The large black dog pushed out a hoof, and the door instantly shattered with a loud bang. Meanwhile, the eight people were also swept away by the remaining power, and they all fell to the ground, groaning and screaming in pain.
And this was still because the large black dog hadn’t used his full strength. Otherwise, how could a mere Mystery Realm Tier cultivator withstand it?

chapters.title: Chapter 3985: Walking Into a Trap or Closing the Door to Thrash the Dog
paragraphs: “Yi, you’ve broken through to Seven Cauldrons?” Ling Han asked.
“Of course! Do you think I’ve been playing around for the past month?” the large black dog said smugly.
Seven Cauldrons, this was enough to be ranked in the top 100 on the Galaxy Network, so they certainly had the right to be arrogant.
Ling Han smiled and said, “No matter how hard you try, you’ll at least have to charge up to the Nine Cauldrons.”

The large black dog bared his teeth. This was really easier said than done. Though he had reached Seven Cauldrons, it was also because of this that he knew how difficult it was to take another step further. Eight Cauldrons was already difficult enough, so what of Nine Cauldrons?

Of course, though it was difficult, it definitely still had to break through. At least, it had to reach the level of Nine Cauldrons, and only then would it have the possibility of becoming a Saint in future.

“Who goes there, to actually dare come to the Cheng Clan and behave atrociously!” A middle- aged man rushed out, but when he saw Ling Han and the large black dog, his expression immediately changed drastically, and he hurriedly turned around to leave.

“Hehe, why are you in such a rush to leave? I’m very ugly, so did I scare you?” The large black dog moved, and power surged out. The middle-aged man was instantly restrained. His feet were clearly moving continuously, yet he had not even taken a single step.
That person was so anxious that he was about to cry. He did not want to die at all.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! A few more people flew out.
“Seventh Cousin, what’s wrong!” Seeing the restrained clansman, those people immediately exclaimed in shock.
“All of you can be together.” The large black dog moved again, and took down the newcomers as well.
They were only in the Foundation Building Tier, so how could they possibly be a match for the large black dog? They were all easily subdued.
Ling Han ignored him. The large black dog could play however he liked. In any case, he had come today to vent his anger.

People continued to appear, but Foundation Building Tiers were naturally delivering themselves up to be killed. Even if a few Cauldron Forging Tiers came, against a Seven Cauldrons like the large black dog, he would only have to spend a few more moves, at most.

After capturing each person, the large black dog tossed him aside. Not long after, a pile of people had formed. Furthermore, the pile was getting taller and taller, looking like they were piling up into a small mountain.
The large black dog turned to Ling Han and asked, “Don’t I have artistic sense?”
Ling Han spread out his hands, “I only saw a deep sense of mischief.”
“Sigh, that’s because you don’t know how to appreciate.” The large black dog shook his head, and said, “Forget about it. Prodigies are always lonely. I don’t expect you to understand.”
As they spoke, more and more members of the Cheng Clan continued to surge out. Of course, they were all delivering themselves up to be captured.
“Humph, the two of you are really outrageously bold!” A cold humph rang out, and Cheng Wu appeared. His hands were crossed behind his back, his eyes sharp.

“I’m so scared! I’m so scared!” The large black dog stood on its hind legs like a human, hugging its chest with its front paws as it swayed its behind. Its iron underwear swayed along with it, reflecting light that was practically blinding.
Ling Han strode forwards, “Old grudges and new grudges, today will be the day to settle
everything.”
“Brat, even if you advance into the Core Formation Tier, how many Heavens of battle prowess can you possess?” Cheng Dongbing sneered. “Today, you’re walking right into a trap!”
“Formation activate!”
He gave a loud shout, and instantly, the whole Cheng Clan was enveloped by a layer of white
mist.

“Haha, this was originally a great defensive formation of our Cheng Clan. Even True Self Tier elites would have to expend some effort to break in,” Cheng Dongbing declared proudly, “The people outside cannot break in, and if the people inside want to leave, it is similarly
impossible!”
“So, this time, you’re really trapped.”
Ling Han only smiled, “Why is it not closing the doors to hit the dog?”
Cheng Clan and the others all looked furious. Ling Han actually dared to compare them to
dogs.
On the sidelines, the large black dog was also very displeased. He had also been implicated by
that.
“Capture this brat,” Cheng Dongbing said coldly. The seven of them moved in unison,
charging towards Ling Han.
This was a super genius of the Core Formation Tier, and he couldn’t be underestimated. As for
the large black dog, they didn’t need to worry about him at all. He was merely a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, and they could suppress him with one hand.
The seven of them attacked together, launching a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.

Ling Han was calm and unperturbed. It could be said that previously, he had not feared the combined forces of these seven people. The only Celestial Cauldron was capable of dispersing the attack of power below Sixth Heaven. Now that he had advanced into the Core Formation Tier, his original power had directly soared to Eighth Heaven.
Even if he didn’t use the celestial technique, and purely used the mystical power, to wound him, his opponent’s battle prowess would have to reach Fourteen Heavens, at least.
This was something that even Cheng Wu could not do.
Hehe, this time, it was his turn to show his might.

chapters.title: Chapter 3986: Killed one by one
paragraphs: Ling Han first dodged a few moves.
In the eyes of the members of the Cheng Clan, this was only natural.
How could a mere early stage Core Formation Tier cultivator oppose them?

“Brat, it would be best for you to surrender yourself, to avoid suffering too much,” Cheng Dongbing said. This time, it was really a sure bet. Ling Han was trapped in the formation, and had nowhere to run.
“Is that so?” Ling Han shook his head. He stared at a Core Formation Tier cultivator, then charged over.
“In your dreams!” Cheng Wu sneered, and immediately stepped forward to block.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and greeted the incoming attack with a punch.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Cheng Wu’s expression instantly changed drastically. The power of Ling Han’s punch was frighteningly strong, and it actually forced him backwards.
Of course, Ling Han retreated even more.
How was this possible?
He was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, so how could he possibly possess battle prowess above the Tenth Heaven? He was practically capable of matching him?
Ling Han turned around and threw another punch at his previous target.

Peng, the punch landed, and though that person was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, his battle prowess was only at the Seventh Heaven, so how could he possibly match it? Instantly, he was shattered by the punch.
“No!” All six Core Formation Tiers of the Cheng Clan exclaimed in shock.
He should have been trapped, yet Ling Han had actually counterattacked and killed one of them. How could they accept this?

“All right, just see how I will deal with him!” The large black dog caught hold of him, a hair- raising smile appearing at the corners of his lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 3987 Invitation from the Donglin Imperial Clan
paragraphs: 3987 Invitation from the Donglin Imperial Clan
You guys can’t screw people over like this.

Cheng Wu stared blankly, his face almost dripping blood from his embarrassment and fury. At the same time, he was also filled with disbelief. Such a prodigy, shouldn’t his word be as good as gold? How could he be so sinister?
“What trust do I have to speak of with trash like you?” the large black dog said. He then turned to Ling Han, and said, “I’m tired of playing around with you guys. Kill him.”

After saying this, it stomped down with its foot. Pa, Cheng Dongbing’s head immediately shattered. He was completely dead, and there was absolutely no chance for him to burn his Celestial Core and start over again.
“Ah, ah, ah!” Cheng Wu howled at the skies, like a lone wolf that had been injured.
Boom, a terrifying aura surged out of his body, his whole body glowing. Then, he charged towards Ling Han, brandishing the Spirit Tool in his hand, only attacking and not defending.

Ling Han threw a punch, which landed on Cheng Wu’s body. This punch was very fierce, and forcibly punched a hole into Cheng Wu’s chest, but the strange thing was that Cheng Wu’s wound was actually rapidly healing. In an instant, he had become completely fine.
Yi, was this burning the Celestial Core?

Cheng Wu was really putting his life on the line. He had not sustained any injuries, yet had taken the initiative to burn the Celestial Core. Not only could this allow him to instantly recover from any injuries, it would also elevate his battle prowess by Two Heavens.

For ordinary Core Formation Tier elites, a consummate level elite’s battle prowess was only Eighth Heaven. This sudden increase of Two Heavens of battle prowess was a completely decisive factor in a battle, but for Ling Han, the increase of a mere Two Heavens of battle prowess was still unable to turn the tables.
However, it had to be admitted that Cheng Wu was indeed very decisive. Once he was sure that Fu Huoyang would not be able to make it, he immediately used his last resort.
He was determined to hold on until the formation closed, so that he could leave.

This was extremely awesome. His battle prowess had originally reached Twelfth Heaven, but Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Celestial Core had forcefully suppressed it to Ninth Heaven. Now, with a boost of Two Heavens, it had still reached the height of Eleventh Heaven.
Looking at Ling Han again, his original power was Eighth Heaven, then even if he channelled the Imperial Technique, he would only have the battle prowess of Eleventh Heaven.
However, could the Imperial Technique channel continuously?
In this way, Cheng Wu immediately had the upper hand. Furthermore, the Spirit Tool in his hand was extremely sharp, and could also pose a great threat to Ling Han.

Thankfully, Ling Han still had the barrage of murderous aura. Every time he shot out a punch, Cheng Wu would be hit, and there would be a momentary pause. It practically completely disrupted the rhythm of Cheng Wu’s attacks, and his advantage in battle prowess was naturally hard to show.
“Why hasn’t the formation been closed yet?” Cheng Wu roared.
“Soon, soon,” the members of the Cheng Clan said. They were also anxious.
Finally, after Cheng Wu had withstood a few more moves, the formation closed.
“Retreat!” Cheng Wu roared, and was the first to flee.

He didn’t care about the others, because he was only in his eighties, young to the extreme, and his future was also bright. As long as he could escape, at worst, he could spend another eighty years, and he could still cultivate until the consummate stage of Core Formation Tier.
Furthermore, he would definitely become even stronger after destruction and rebuilding himself.

Ling Han smiled faintly. The Primal Chaos Celestial Core appeared, releasing a supreme aura. Instantly, all the members of the Cheng Clan were knocked unconscious, falling heavily onto the ground. Only Cheng Wu managed to escape.
He gave chase again. The Imminent Skyline was unleashed, so how could Cheng Wu compare to him?
He caught up to Cheng Wu in an instant, and then threw a series of punches.
Cheng Wu was both anxious and furious. Why was he still unable to get rid of Ling Han?

Though he was presently strong, and could even just barely suppress Ling Han, the burning of the Celestial Core was not endless. When the Celestial Core was completely burnt, his strength would fall out of the level of the Celestial Path, and that would definitely lead to death.

He roared repeatedly in fury, and attacked with all his might. In any case, aside from fatal injuries, he could recover other injuries now. He was naturally unafraid of being injured, and wanted to use mutual destruction to scare Ling Han off.
Unfortunately, this kind of desperate struggle did not scare Ling Han in the slightest.
Ling Han only needed to wrap the Starlight Screen around his fist to block the sharpness of the Spirit Tool. The remaining power could be easily dispersed.
—The only Celestial Cauldroncould, and the Primal Chaos Celestial Pill, the Celestial Core, that had been nurtured by the only Celestial Cauldron could as well.
Ling Han only used the God Slaying Technique. The Primal Chaos Divine Lightning, the Demonic Monkey Fists, and so on all belonged to Ling Han. Now that he was Ding Yi, he naturally wouldn’t use them.
He had to keep his guard up. What if someone broadcasted this battle live through Galaxy Network?

After dragging on for a while, Cheng Wu’s aura began to rapidly decline, from the Core Formation Tier to the Cauldron Forging Tier, to the Foundation Building Tier, and finally to the mortal level. Only then did it finally stop.
Pa!

This drop in cultivation level was too fast, and there had been no prior signs either, so Ling Han had not expected it either. He had not made a move, but because the aura of the Core Formation Tier was too violent, Cheng Wu was blasted into a shower of blood.
This!
Ling Han stroked his chin. Though he would definitely kill Cheng Wu, this uncontrollable situation still made him feel a little regretful.
Forget it. In any case, this wasn’t some mighty figure, so it didn’t matter how he died.

Ling Han returned to the Cheng Clan Manor. The large black dog had already handled everything, and through searching his soul, he could determine which member of the Cheng Clan Manor deserved to die, and which one of them would be spared.

They ransacked the treasure chamber of the Cheng Clan. After all, this was a force of the Core Formation Tier, so there were bound to be some treasures. The large black dog beamed with joy, and said that his hard work had finally paid off.
Then, they left.
A few days later, Ling Han suddenly saw a piece of news on the Galaxy Network. It was sent by the Donglin Imperial Clan. This message was sent to him.
The Donglin Imperial Clan officially sent him an invitation, inviting him to the Donglin Planet to participate in the prodigy gathering.
Hehe, so late?
Ling Han knew that the Donglin Imperial Clan must have received news of the destruction of the Cheng Clan before deciding to send him an invitation.
They really had a high opinion of him. They actually waited until he had dealt with a Core Formation Tier-level force before they were willing to invite him.

Ling Han looked at the date, and saw that this prodigy gathering would only be held in half a year’s time, and there was no need for him to go to Donglin Planet now. He only had to give an address, and the Donglin Imperial Clan would send him an invitation.
When the time came, the invitation would automatically send the person to Donglin Planet.
The methods of the Imperial Clan were indeed extraordinary.

Because “Ding Yi” did not have a Galaxy Network account, or rather a verified Galaxy Network account, the Donglin Imperial Clan would send someone to deliver the invitation to this planet personally, right at the Cheng Clan Manor.
Ling Han waited at the Cheng Clan Manor, and after a few days, a middle-aged man indeed came over.
“Who’s Ding Yi?” This middle-aged man was extremely arrogant, as if he didn’t care about anyone.
This was a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and could no longer be considered weak.
Ling Han’s brow wrinkled into a frown. The errand boys of the Imperial Clan were all so high and mighty?
No wonder Fu Huoyang was so fearless. He had truly been spoiled.
He opened his mouth and said calmly, “I am Ding Yi.”

The middle-aged man glanced at Ling Han for a while, then nodded and said, “The appearance is the same as Galaxy Network, but it’s not certain if it’s an impersonation. How about this? You use a celestial technique, and let me appraise it.”
If this person didn’t have such a lofty attitude, Ling Han wouldn’t mind spending some effort to prove his identity. After all, this was also a safety measure.
But now? Hehe.
Ling Han smiled, “I have a more direct method.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3988 No Temper
paragraphs: 3988 No Temper
The envoy from the Donglin Imperial Clan faltered upon hearing this. What other way was there?
“Come and experience it for yourself!” Ling Han rushed over and threw a punch at the envoy from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
The envoy was so furious that smoke was about to come out of his nostrils. He was an envoy from the Imperial Clan, and you f actually dare to use force against him?
Boom! However, Ling Han’s fist smashed over like a great star, forcing him to face it head-on.
With this strike, his whole person was instantly sent sliding backwards, creating a very long mark on the ground.
What terrifying power!
This envoy thought internally. He felt that though his right hand was raised, he had lost all feeling, as if it did not belong to him.
Ling Han strode forwards, and threw another punch.
The envoy could only switch to another hand to parry. Peng, his whole person slid backwards once more.
Just as Ling Han was about to walk over and deliver his third punch, he hurriedly said, “I believe you! I believe you!”
Only then did Ling Han stop. He shrugged, and said, “You see, my method is faster, right?”
The envoy was already cursing in his mind. He furiously retrieved an invitation and tossed it at Ling Han, a cold glint in his eyes.

At first, he had wanted to take advantage of the fact that he was an envoy of the Imperial Clan, and put on airs, so he could enjoy the pleasure of being ingratiated with by a supreme prodigy. If he could still get some benefits, that would be even better. He had not thought that Ling Han would not play by the rules at all, and directly threw a punch, which ruined all his plans.
Damn it, he was really too detestable.
“Ding Yi, don’t regret this!” he couldn’t help but say.

“What do I regret?” Ling Han smiled faintly, “What you mean is that when I go to the Donglin Imperial Clan in the future, you will trip me up and make things difficult for me? Hehe, don’t think too highly of yourself.”
“Emissary of the Imperial Clan? Haha, this is only what you think. You are only an errand boy, so what is there to be proud of?”
“I’m not even afraid of Fu Huoyang, so how could I be afraid of a minor character like you?”

“Furthermore, with how heroic and extraordinary I am, it is highly possible that I will become the ideal son-in-law for the Donglin Imperial Clan in the future. At that time, you would still have to kneel down to receive me!”
There was one other thing that Ling Han didn’t say, and that was that this was a fake identity. No matter how much trouble “Ding Yi” caused, it had nothing to do with Ling Han.
Meanwhile, the large black dog gestured with his paw at Ling Han, meaning that his skin was thick enough, and he had inherited the large black dog’s bearing.

The envoy was completely stupefied. He had no choice but to admit that what Ling Han said was very logical. He was not a descendant of the Imperial Clan at all. He was only an errand boy. To compete with someone that the Imperial Clan had a high opinion of, was he worthy?

Furthermore, Ling Han was indeed extraordinary, and his battle merits were terrifying. It was very possible that this kind of person would gain the notice of the Donglin Imperial Clan, and be taken in as a son-in-law.
Was this someone he could compare to?
“Scram!” Ling Han shouted lightly.
The envoy didn’t dare to say another harsh word, and he ran away with his tail between his legs.
Ling Han merely smiled, and did not take this matter to heart. What pleasure could there be in stepping on a mere servant?
If he wanted to step on someone, he would be stepping on someone like Fu Huoyang.
“Are we going back to the Nine Suns Holy Land now?” The large black dog approached and asked. There was still half a year until the grand gathering of the Donglin Imperial Clan.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “If we return to the Holy Land on our own, half a year might not even be enough time for a journey. There’s no need to waste this time.” He paused, then continued, “Let’s cultivate here.”

By now, he had already received an invitation from the Donglin Imperial Clan. This meant that he was a guest of the Donglin Imperial Clan. If anyone dared to make a move on him, that would be equivalent to slapping the Donglin Imperial Clan across the face. Who would dare?
Hence, he was very safe now. This was a life-saving golden medallion.
The large black dog thought that hewas right, so he didn’t say anything else.
The man and dog settled down, cultivating earnestly every day.

Ling Han put up a high bounty for the purchase of Feng Lin Stones on the Galaxy Network. The heavens do not disappoint those who persist. In other words, as long as one offered a high enough price, there was nothing that could not be bought. Finally, someone contacted Ling Han. He had Feng Lin Stones in his possession.
The two of them used the Galaxy Network as an intermediary to complete this transaction.
Ling Han immediately began to concoct the Wind Stream Pill. For the Alchemy Emperor, this was naturally not difficult at all. He only failed three times before successfully concocting it.

One after another, Wind Stream Pills were ingested, and the growth of the Primal Chaos Celestial Core instantly sped up, and the melting of the only Celestial Cauldron was also speeding up.

The early stage of the Core Formation Tier was different from previous cultivation levels, and belonged to the category that could be cultivated at any time, because there was no need to draw on the power of heaven and earth for this. At this moment, in Ling Han’s mind, the three legs of the only Celestial Cauldron had already disappeared. This meant that he was already halfway through the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his power had also improved, reaching Ninth Heaven.
In this way, he could cultivate to the peak stage of the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, and his power should be able to reach Ten Heavens.
This was too shocking.

The large black dog’s improvement wasn’t small either. He had reached Eight Cauldrons, and peak stage of Eight Cauldrons at that.. However, it wasn’t easy to take the step into Nine Cauldrons. The large black dog also needed a large amount of time to accumulate his power. Then, he would burst his accumulated power and see if he had a chance to take this step.
Weng, Ling Han’s body suddenly emitted light.
He faltered for a moment before coming to his senses. It was time for the prodigy gathering hosted by the Donglin Imperial Clan. The teleportation was about to begin.
The Transfer Formation wsa not activated at the first instant, clearly giving him some time to make preparations.
“Old Black,” Ling Han called out.
“Grandpa Dog is here.” The large black dog leaped over.
Ling Han grabbed hold of the large black dog and wrapped it in his mystical power. In this way, they would be able to teleport together.
The large black dog’s expression was also filled with anticipation. He had never tried such a high-level teleportation before.
Then... there was no ‘then’.
The light was still surging, and they could see that the man and bull were embracing each other tightly. The atmosphere appeared slightly awkward.
“Er, why hasn’t this Transfer begun yet?” Ling Han asked.

“It won’t stay like this forever, right?” The large black dog also began to stick out his tongue, “Grandpa Dog isn’t gay. Furthermore, even if Grandpa Dog wants to be gay, he would still go find a pretty boy!”
Ling Han was just about to kick him, but right at this moment, that light suddenly surged violently. Xiu, Ling Han and the large black dog disappeared from where they were standing.
They had finally been teleported.

There was a blur in front of Ling Han’s eyes, and when Ling Han could clearly see what was ahead of him, he had already arrived at a plaza. He saw that there were people all around him, both men and women. All of them had soaring auras, and possessed intimidating vigor.
Those who were qualified to come here were naturally all prodigies of their respective regions.
“Ding Yi!” A voice rang out, and Fu Huoyang flew over from the distance. He stood in midair, looking down on Ling Han.

“Hehe, little friend of the Fu Clan, no matter what grudges you have against each other, you are not allowed to make a move in this period of time.” An elder immediately appeared, issuing a warning to Fu Huoyang.
Fu Huoyang sneered at Ling Han before turning around to leave.
He had no choice but to take the Imperial Clan’s warning seriously. After all, he was only from a side branch, and not the Imperial Son.

What other way was there?
“Come and experience it for yourself!” Ling Han rushed over and threw a punch at the envoy from the Donglin Imperial Clan.

He was an envoy from the Imperial Clan, and you f actually dare to use force against him?
Boom!
However, Ling Han’s fist smashed over like a great star, forcing him to face it head-on.
With this strike, his whole person was instantly sent sliding backwards, creating a very long mark on the ground.
What terrifying power!

He felt that though his right hand was raised, he had lost all feeling, as if it did not belong to him.
Ling Han strode forwards, and threw another punch.

Just as Ling Han was about to walk over and deliver his third punch, he hurriedly said, “I believe you!
I believe you!”
Only then did Ling Han stop.
He shrugged, and said, “You see, my method is faster, right?”
The envoy was already cursing in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 3989 Luck
paragraphs: 3989 Luck
Ling Han felt a little regretful. He really wanted to fight Fu Huoyang, but unfortunately, he was stopped.

He kept a very low profile. After all, this was the Imperial Clan, and their background was too deep. Additionally, he was also in disguise, so if he was noticed by others, after careful observation, if they recognized his true identity, it would be difficult to deal with.
Everyone had been teleported over at the same time. As far as the eye could see, quite a number of people’s bodies were glowing, as if they were gods.
There were really a lot of prodigies.
Ling Han only swept an eye over them, and discovered a great many powerful beings. Their battle prowess was all above Fifteenth Heaven.
Moreover, he also saw a few familiar faces, such as Lu Yongchang, Ni Wenbai and Wang Huazang.
Everyone was greeting each other. There were a few that were too extraordinary, forming into small circles with them at the centre.
Whether it was Lu Yongchang, Ni Wenbai, Wang Huazang or Fu Huoyang, they were all surrounded by people. Only Ling Han was an exception, as he only had a large black ox by his side.
“Brat, aren’t you a little too unpopular?” the large black dog asked in disdain.
Ling Han chuckled, “Compared to you, I should still be quite popular.”
Just look at these people. The circle around a few people were the largest.
Ling Han didn’t need to go over. He only needed to listen to their conversation to know the identities of these people.

Zhu Chengyun, previously number one Cauldron Forging Tier of the South Heavenly Realm. He had now advanced into Core Formation Tier. It was said that once he stepped into Core Formation Tier, he had gained Four Heavens of power, so he was inconceivably strong.

Zhu Yixiu, ranked fourth in Core Formation Tier of the Galaxy Network. It was said that his battle prowess reached Twenty Four Heavens, and was the strongest Core Formation Tier of the East Heavenly Realm.
Yi Yuanrong, ranked third in Core Formation Tier of the Galaxy Network, strongest Core Formation Tier of the West Heavenly Realm.
Sha Yang, ranked second in Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network, the second strongest Core Formation Tier of the South Heavenly Realm.

However, the only one missing was the number one Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network. He too was a prodigy of the South Heavenly Realm. His name was Jing Hao. For some unknown reason, the Donglin Imperial Clan had clearly issued him an invitation, but he was nowhere to be found.

It was extremely likely that this Jing Hao was currently exploring an ancient site, and had cut off the Galaxy Network’s signal. It was also possible that he was presently in deep seclusion, and could not appear at all.

These prodigies were basically accompanied by their Dao Protectors, and all of them were at least Spiritual Transformation True Lords. Right now, they had all retreated outside the plaza and didn’t join in, giving the youngsters a chance to relax.
Why was the Donglin Imperial Clan holding such a prodigy gathering so attractive?

Being able to cultivate a secret technique was naturally one of the factors. However, this was also a good opportunity for prodigies to expand their social circle. Which of the prodigies here was not a top-notch prodigy? In fact, there were even heirs of the Imperial Clans. It was just that some of them were too low-key, and no one knew their identities.
If one wanted to become the sect master of a large sect, not only did one have to be strong enough, but they also had to have a large enough social circle.

Thus, all the prodigies flocked to this place like ducks. Otherwise, why, when only one person would be able to cultivate the technique together with Chi Menghan, would someone whose abilities were obviously insufficient come?
Now was a good chance to form a friendship, so everyone naturally had to make the most of their time.

However, after forming such circles, some people appeared to be all alone. For example, Ling Han only had a large black ox by his side, and not far away, there was also a young man standing alone, looking completely laidback.
Ling Han glanced at him, and his first feeling was that this person was too ordinary, so much so that he overlooked him with a single glance.
However, if he was really ordinary, how could he have possibly been invited over by the Imperial Clan?
In that case, he was clearly extraordinary, yet even Ling Han couldn’t tell how extraordinary. This was impressive.

Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked over. Immediately, he revealed an astounded expression. This young man was like a divine furnace, with a terrifying immortal flame burning inside his body. Once it exploded, it would have the might to destroy the heavens and earth.
“Brother Ding, it’s not good to peep like this.” The young man’s divine sense was extremely sharp, and he had already turned to look at Ling Han, a lazy smile curling up the corners of his lips.
What a handsome guy. His face was as gentle as jade, and added with his laidback nature, he would probably be able to charm a considerable number of young girls to death.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “You know my name, but I don’t know yours. This is a little unfair, isn’t it?”
“Haha!” The young man laughed, then said, “I am Shen Yutang.”
Ling Han thought for a moment, but could not match the surname “Shen” with any major force. However, it was fine. When he made friends, he did not care about the latter’s background.
“Brother Shen.” He clasped his hands in greeting.
Meanwhile, the large black dog approached, and asked, “Have you seen Chi Menghan before?”
Shen Yutang shook his head, “No.”
“Everyone says that she’s the third most beautiful woman in the universe. I really want to meet her. Just how beautiful is she?” The large black dog’s imagination ran wild.
Shen Yutang couldn’t help but smile, “Brother Ding, your beast pet is really quite interesting.”
“I’m not a pet beast, but this brat is my human pet!” The large black dog was instantly flustered and exasperated.
At this time, elites from the Donglin Imperial Clan also appeared, telling everyone to make preparations. They would be divided into groups to undergo the first selection.
That was too fast, wasn’t it?
However, there was nothing that could be done. The Imperial Clan had already made their decision, so who would be able to oppose it?
Very soon, they began to divide into groups, with every ten people forming a group.

“The first round of the test will depend on your luck, young friends.” The Donglin Imperial Clan sent out an elder at the level of Sect Master. This was enough to suppress the situation, and even those Dao Protectors had to treat him with respect.
Luck?
“Luck is also a part of strength. In fact, it’s the most important,” the old Sect Master said.
This naturally caused all the prodigies to shake their heads. How was this possible?
Comprehension, hard work, and good fortune were the most important. What could mere luck do?

The old Sect Master smiled faintly and said, “The most important thing I’m talking about is naturally prodigies like you. When you have the chance to advance to the fourth pinnacle level, you’ll discover that the most important thing to become a Saint isn’t hard work or natural talent, but luck.”
“And if you want to become an Emperor, you would have to gather the fortune of the world.”
Er, hearing the words of this old Sect Master, none of them could refute him.
Indeed, with natural talent and a certain amount of effort, luck was really too important.

“Hence, the first test is a test of luck,” the old Sect Master said. “You guys will form groups of ten, and take turns drawing lots. Whoever draws a lot that has the words ‘pass’ written on it will be able to enter into the next round.”
‘F*ck! You can do this?’
Everyone instinctively wanted to object. This had absolutely nothing to do with abilities, and what was most important to cultivators?
Strength!
Whoever was stronger would be able to claim the title of king.

But now? There was Foundation Building Tiers, Cauldron Forging Tiers, and the Core Formation Tiers mixed together in a group. This was very likely to cause a Core Formation Tier to be eliminated by a mere Foundation Building Tier. This was too unfair, wasn’t it?
“I’ve already said that your talent and effort are the best. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have been invited. Thus, what we’re competing in now is your luck,” the old Sect Master said.
He didn’t care what everyone was thinking. With a wave of his hand, the test began.
Everyone had no choice but to draw lots.
How could they argue stubbornly with a member of the Imperial Clan?

chapters.title: Chapter 3990 Natural treasure
paragraphs: 3990 Natural treasure

“Hahaha, I drew the pass lot!” After the first group had drawn, someone immediately shouted in pleasant surprise, but immediately drew the hostility of the nine people in the same group, and hurriedly closed their mouth again.
He was only a Cauldron Forging Tier=, and there was no shortage of elites in the same group who were in the Core Formation Tier.
Group after group, they all began to draw lots. There was no need to fight, and the results would be out soon.
Thus, though several thousand people had come, 90% of them were immediately eliminated, leaving behind a mere few hundred people.
Ling Han walked up to draw lots, and when he touched it with his hand, he retreated to the side. Then, he looked, and saw that there was a word written on it: pass.
His luck was not too bad.
Ling Han smiled, and looked towards Shen Yutang. He saw that Shen Yutang had also looked over, and was holding a lot in his hand, waving it in his direction.
Obviously, he had also passed the test.
“Give me your lot!” A deep voice rang out, and someone walked to Ling Han’s side, “Whatever you want, just name it.”

Ling Han turned around to look. This was a young man who looked to be in his twenties. His hair was slightly yellowish, and his eyes were dark green in colour. Furthermore, they were a little triangular.
Obviously, this was not a human, but rather a Demonic Beast that had taken human form.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Not interested.”
“I’m Bai Wenxuan from the Soaring Snake Holy Land,” the young man said. “Now, you’re interested, right?”
Ling Han looked at him pitifully. This guy must have gone stupid.

“You!” Seeing that not only did Ling Han not agree, but he even looked like he pitied him, Bai Wenxuan was enraged. He humphed, and was just about to make a move, but he had just raised his hand, when he immediately felt a heavy pressure bearing down on him.
He raised his head, only to see the old Sect Master smiling at him. However, the look in his eyes was as terrifying as could be.
Bai Wenxuan’s heart clenched, and he hurriedly took a few steps back.
He glared fiercely at Ling Han. He was definitely not going to let things pass just like that.

“Many people feel that this is unfair, right?” The old Sect Master spoke up. He nodded, “All right, I will give you a chance to show off your abilities. Those who have been eliminated can compete, and for the top ten to emerge victorious, those who are interested can stay, and those who are not can leave.”
The actions of the Imperial Clan were just that arbitrary and overbearing. They did not discuss with you at all, and could do whatever they wanted.

Among those who were eliminated, there were a considerable number of Core Formation Tier cultivators, and the number far exceeded a dozen. Thus, in terms of martial arts competition, there was absolutely no hope for Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators.
Thus, only the Core Formation Tier martial artists registered to participate in the following “revival battle”.
Bai Wenxuan was also among them. He looked coldly at Ling Han, and sent a message through divine sense, “Brat, regret it now?”
“Idiot,” Ling Han replied coldly, and strode off.

Bai Wenxuan really wanted to chase after him, but when he recalled that there was an Imperial Clan member in front of him, his courage instantly vanished without a trace. However, his hatred for Ling Han deepened even further.
He turned this hatred into fighting spirit. He was determined to make it into the top ten, and then teach Ling Han a harsh lesson.

This mountain was too mysterious. The power of heaven and earth was dense, and even the mountain rocks were like jade. Vaguely, one could still see Celestial Qi inside the rocks. What else could it be but a spiritual mountain?
“As expected of the Imperial Clan. This place is really too amazing,” someone sighed ruefully.
“Pu!” Shen Yutang immediately laughed out loud.
“What do you mean?” That person was instantly displeased. He actually dared to mock him?
Shen Yutang shook his head and said, “Apologies, this isn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan. It’s only the outer circle.”
What!

This wasn’t the Donglin Imperial Clan, but the power of heaven and earth here was clearly so dense. Moreover, this place was brimming with opportunities that even the Holy Land couldn’t compare to. It was actually just the outer circle of the Donglin Imperial Clan?
“Impossible!” Immediately, a great many people shook their heads in disbelief.
Yet Shen Yutang had completely no intention of clarifying further. In any case, it was up to them whether they believed him or not.
Ling Han was slightly surprised. Could it be that this guy was also a member of the Imperial Clan? Otherwise, how could he possibly have such an understanding?

They settled down here, then received a notice that three days later, there would be a new challenge waiting for them, and this was one of the main events of the Prodigy Gathering, telling them to make their preparations.

In these three days, Ling Han chatted idly with Shen Yutang a few times, but this guy looked laidback, and did not seem to be scheming at all. However, his mouth was especially tight, and did not reveal the slightest bit of secrets about himself.
And just like that, three days’ time passed in the blink of an eye.
On the other side, the revival battle had also ended, and ten people who had been eliminated and redeemed emerged.
Ling Han shockingly discovered that Bai Wenxuan was also among them.
When he saw Ling Han, Bai Yuxuan made a throat-slitting gesture at Ling Han, his threat clear.
“Brother Ding, you seem to have offended him,” Shen Yutang said with a smile.
“Hehe, I’ll knock him over with a single punch,” Ling Han said calmly, appearing to be completely unconcerned.
Shen Yutang did not say anything further.

“Today, the true prodigy gathering will begin.” The old Sect Master came again. “However, I have to remind you that this is very dangerous. If you are not careful, you will suffer serious injuries, or even die in truth.”
He paused, then continued, “However, if you guys can persist, your gains would also be huge.”
“Senior, what kind of test is that?” someone asked.

The old Sect Master smiled calmly, and said, “In this heaven and earth, there are some divine items that are naturally nurtured by the heaven and earth, and have unimaginable effects. They are called natural treasures.”
Everyone exchanged looks. Weren’t they talking about a dangerous test? Why had he suddenly digressed?
But for a mighty figure like Sect Master to digress, who would dare say anything?

“Our Donglin Imperial Clan has an unusual vine. It was personally transplanted by our Great Emperor hundreds of millions of years ago from the depths of the universe. After so many years, it finally bloomed and bore fruit.” The old Sect Master showed a nostalgic expression, seeming to be recalling the glory of the Donglin Imperial Clan.

Though the Donglin Imperial Clan was also a top-notch force in the universe now, there were many forces that could match them. It was unlike the time when the Great Emperor was still alive and the whole world was under his command. Even the Imperial Clans had to be respectful.
The old Sect Master shook his head, collected his thoughts, and said, “The strange vine bears a gourd.”
Another gourd?
Ling Han instantly felt an urge to complain. Could he not have so many gourds?
“This gourd has no offensive effect, nor is it capable of nurturing divine sense and physique,” the old Sect Master said. “However, it is a path of connection.”
“Connect to what?” Someone mustered up the courage to ask.
“The Netherworld,” the old Sect Master said.
Pu, a great many people spluttered.
What, what, the Netherworld?
Yin soul was nothing unfamiliar to these prodigies. Most of them had had contact with yin souls before, and had at least heard of such things before.

However, after a living being died, their soul would be repelled by the power of heaven and earth, and enter into the Netherworld. Theoretically speaking, it was impossible for them to return. This was decided by the Regulations of heaven and earth.

However, there seemed to be a great many places where the Living Realm and the Netherworld intertwined. For example, Celestial Sea Planet was one such place. In the past, innumerable Yin souls had escaped, and in fact, even caused a Saint to die as a result, which was proof enough of how terrifying Yin souls were.
However, these connecting points were all fixed and unchanging.
And now, a gourd could actually connect to the Netherworld. Just how astonishing was that?

chapters.title: Chapter 3991: Entering the Netherworld
paragraphs: The old Sect Master continued, “Through this Natural Treasured Gourd, one can enter into the Netherworld, but it is only limited to the spiritual level. The physical body cannot pass
through.”
“Moreover, there’s also a restriction on cultivation level. It can only be below the True Self Tier.”
“Previously, young people from our clan entered, and killed a considerable number of Yin souls in the Netherworld. They had astonishing gains.”
“Killing Yin souls there can nourish the divine sense.”

A smile appeared on the old Sect Master’s face, and he said, “You all should know that when you advance into the True Self Tier, your main focus will be on the divine sense. Moreover, if you can cultivate your divine sense to a powerful level at this stage, not only will it be easier for you to advance into the True Self Tier, it will also allow you to become even stronger in the True Self Tier.”
Everyone looked excited. Though they too could nurture their souls, they could only do so through natural treasures.
And what were natural treasures?
To talk about large numbers, that would be cabbages. All natural treasures were incredibly
rare.
Thus, killing Yin souls would strengthen the soul, and this was indeed a rare opportunity.

Ling Han also nodded internally. Previously, when he had killed Yin souls in the White Lotus Mystery Realm, he had also been rewarded by the heaven and earth, washing away the hidden injuries in his body. The benefits could be said to be great.
Thus, it was not impossible for the old Sect Master to say that killing Yin souls could nourish the soul.
However, killing Yin souls in the Netherworld was different from killing Yin souls in the Living Realm.

“However, I also have to remind you,” the old Sect Master said seriously. “If your souls are injured by the Yin soul, or even destroyed in fact, your physical bodies will become an empty shell that will only slowly corrode over time.”
Everyone was solemn. The soul was the master of the physical body. Without the soul, no matter how strong the physical body was, it would be useless.

It could be imagined that after entering into the Netherworld, Yin souls would definitely cover the skies and earth, their number chillingly great, and what if they encountered the Yin souls of Saints or VenerateTier elites?
Just how powerful was that destructive power?

“Whether you want to go or not is up to you, young friends,” the old Sect Master said. “I’ll give you half a day to consider. After half a day, I’ll still bring the Natural Treasured Gourd over. Those who don’t want to participate can leave on their own.”
Everyone nodded. This decision was indeed very big, and there was a need to weigh the pros and cons. In fact, they even had to discuss it with the protector.
Ling Han naturally had nothing to hesitate about. He had already decided to participate.
To say nothing else, merely with the Destructive Energy that he had grasped, what need was there for him to be afraid of Yin souls?
However, this time, it was his soul that would be going over. Ling Han hadn’t used Destructive Energy to battle in his soul state yet, so he had to get used to it first.
However, he believed that this shouldn’t be too difficult, because he broke through to the Core Formation Tier with Destructive Energy as the core.
He returned, and told the large black dog about this.
“Little Han, you have to be careful,” the large black dog said seriously. “In the past, when the Yin soul wreaked havoc, even Celestial Sea Planet was shattered, and even a Saint died.”
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “I know.”
“Don’t worry. Grandpa Dog will protect your physical body for you. I won’t let anyone r@pe your a*s.” The large black dog soon couldn’t say anything nice.

Ling Han instantly felt an urge to kick this despicable dog madly. Even his own people could be provoked to such an extent, then the damage suffered by his enemies would definitely be multiplied by a hundredfold.
Half a day later, Ling Han walked out.
Most people chose to continue. This was a rare opportunity, but there were also some
prodigies that chose to give up under the strong request of their protectors.
To these prodigies, there were too many ways to become stronger. There was no need to take such a great risk.
After all, even the Imperial Clan was unable to reach that place.
Calculating, there were around four hundred of them.

It wasn’t long before they saw the old Sect Master arrive. There were nine young people following behind him, and they were five men and four women. They were all graceful and enchanting. One of the women was even wrapped in a cloak, and not a single hair could be seen. However, one could still vaguely see her shapely figure, and it would make one’s heart beat wildly.
“These are a few young people of our clan, and they will be taking the risk with everyone,” the old Sect Master said with a smile. However, he had no intention of introducing the nine of
them.
However, everyone felt much more at ease.
The Donglin Imperial Clan also sent their clansmen to the netherworld. It was clear that they were extremely confident.
Shen Yutang’s eyes turned towards the cloaked woman, and his eyes lit up slightly. Then, he withdrew his gaze, and returned to his laidback appearance.
Ling Han shuffled over, and said, “So that’s Chi Menghan?”
Shen Yutang was startled, and asked, “Why would you think that?”
“You told me.” Ling Han smiled.
Shen Yutang faltered for a moment before saying with a smile, “You’re far too observant. I have to be extremely careful. Otherwise, you’ll reveal all of my secrets.”

“Alright, let’s begin.” The old Sect Master took out a green-skinned gourd, then swept an eye over everyone. “I’ll give everyone another piece of advice. After entering into the Netherworld, there will be enemies at every step, so everyone must work together.” “Additionally, after entering, you guys won’t be in the same place completely, but the distance between you guys won’t be too far. Therefore, the first thing you guys have to do is find the main troops, and unity is the greatest source of strength.”
“Alright, that’s all I have to say. You guys behave yourselves.”
The old Sect Master held the gourd in his hand, and said, “You guys relax. No matter what position you take, as long as you make yourselves comfortable, it’s fine.”

Everyone sat down in a cross-legged position. This soul had left the body, and the physical body was only an empty shell. Who knew how long they would have to leave for, so it was better to sit down in a cross-legged position. Lying down would be too inelegant. “Relax,” the old Sect Master exclaimed softly. Then, he slapped the gourd, and instantly, the gourd shone brightly with green light. A power spread out, forming a powerful suction force. Instantly, everyone felt as if their spirits were floating, wanting to be stripped from their physical bodies.
They could not control themselves at all. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Everyone felt their bodies lighten, and then flew in midair.
But they shockingly discovered that there was another of themselves on the ground.
Realization immediately dawned on them. Their souls had left their bodies.
Xiu, they had not even finished this thought, when their souls were attracted by the gourd,
and flew towards the mouth of the gourd. Then, they entered into a hazy green world, and continued to fly at an extremely high speed.
Then, they saw the scene in front of them change again. A piece of land appeared in front of
them.
Peng, peng, peng! They all crashed onto the ground, their whole bodies aching.
Strange, they were only soul fragments now, so how could they still be impacted, and even
feel pain?
Because this was the Netherworld, Regulations were different.
In the Living Realm, the soul was shapeless, and one could pass through walls and burrow into the ground, but here, sorry, but the soul was like a physical body.
Ling Han crawled up. As expected, they fell here like raindrops. Though there was not much distance between them, every single one of them had indeed been separated.
Should he look for someone else?
Ling Han immediately shook his head. He had hold of the power of Destructive Energy, and it
was extremely effective in killing Yin souls. There was absolutely no need for him to join
forces with others.
Let’s see if he could use Destructive Energy first.

Strange, they were only soul fragments now, so how could they still be impacted, and even
feel pain?
Because this was the Netherworld, Regulations were different.
In the Living Realm, the soul was shapeless, and one could pass through walls and burrow into the ground, but here, sorry, but the soul was like a physical body.
Ling Han crawled up.
As expected, they fell here like raindrops.
Though there was not much distance between them, every single one of them had indeed been separated.
Should he look for someone else?
Ling Han immediately shook his head.
He had hold of the power of Destructive Energy, and it
was extremely effective in killing Yin souls.
There was absolutely no need for him to join
forces with others.
Let’s see if he could use Destructive Energy first.

chapters.title: Chapter 3992: Improving soul power
paragraphs: Ling Han communicated with high-level energy, and shockingly discovered that even if this was the netherworld, it was still unaffected.
Right now, his soul had also taken human form. Black energy immediately enveloped his fists.
Yes, he could.
Ling Han nodded internally. With the leap into the Core Formation Tier, his soul also possessed the ability to channel high-level energy.

Very good. Destructive Energy’s restraining effect on Yin souls surpassed cultivation level. In the Ling Han, Ling Han could not possibly match a True Self Tier, but here, even a True Self Tier Yin soul would probably be no match for him.
Of course, whether it was true or not would only be known after the battle.
Ling Han walked in the opposite direction, away from the masses. If he was alone, he could come and go as he liked, without any worries or attachments.
He observed the environment here. This was a rolling mountainous area, but the mountain was not very high, and there were no plants on the ground. There were only pieces of bare rock.
There was no sun in the sky here, but it was not completely dark either. Instead, it was only a dusky area, appearing extremely oppressive.
Sure enough, Yin souls were everywhere in this place.
Ling Han had not taken a few steps, when he saw a Yin soul appear ahead of him. It looked like a bull, and was completely black in colour.

In this place, the soul was equivalent to the physical body. Thus, divine sense naturally could not be released, and one’s senses were extremely poor. Only when the two were less than three hundred meters away from each other did Ling Han sense this Yin soul bull through his “eyes”.
The other party had also discovered him, and immediately turned around, charging towards him on all four hooves.
It opened its mouth, and released a roar. Its upper jaw had actually flipped over its head, which was incredibly exaggerated.
This was a Yin soul, so it naturally wouldn’t make a sound. It was just a wave of divine sense. Boom, the soundwave assaulted, piercing to the ears and heart.
Ling Han humphed, and the Destructive Energy surged, wrapping around his fist as it blasted towards the Yin soul bull.
Seeing the Destructive Energy, the yin soul bull actually revealed a terrified expression. Then, it rapidly braked, obviously wanting to pull back from the brink. Then, it turned and fled.

Ling Han was astounded. Yin souls only had the instincts of slaughter, and were like fierce beasts, but they would actually develop thoughts of fear. Just how much of a restraining effect did this Destructive Energy have?

He activated Imminent Skyline, and with a sudden burst of speed, he had already rushed in front of the Yin soul bull. With a punch, Destructive Energy surged, and the Yin soul bull was immediately blasted into smithereens.

This was a manifestation of the soul. It did not have a physical body, so there was naturally no shower of blood. Instead, it was only the soul fragments that were dispersing, but there was still one that was left behind, turning into a speck of sparkling matter that melted into Ling Han’s body.
Instantly, Ling Han felt that his body had become slightly stronger.
Now, his body was made up of his soul. Thus, even though his body had become stronger, it was actually his soul that had become stronger.
That was really the case. Killing Yin souls could strengthen the soul.
Good, very good.

Ling Han’s soul was very powerful, but it was definitely not the strongest among those at the same cultivation level, because he had not strengthened his soul before, such as cultivating some secret technique or natural treasures.

Hence, this adventure was very important to him, so that when he advanced into the True Self Tier in future, he would also be able to immediately stand at a very high position, and would not have to cultivate the soul after advancing into this cultivation level.
He continued onwards, and very soon, he saw even more Yin souls.
There was nothing much to say. There was only one word for it, and that was to fight.

He could feel that his soul was continuously becoming stronger. This feeling was really too good, making him have the urge not to let his soul back into his body, because without the restraints of his body, he would be even more free.
However, the moment this thought arose, Ling Han immediately became alert.

The physical body could not be without a soul, or it would only be an empty shell. However, the soul could not be removed from the physical body for too long, or it would be like duckweed without roots.

Without a physical body, there would be no feeling of weariness. Furthermore, killing Yin souls could also nourish one’s soul. This was the best way to nurture one’s soul through battle, causing Ling Han to become more and more energetic the more he fought. He was filled with energy, and did not need to rest at all.
However, he still stopped, and examined his own situation.
This kind of soul strengthening was too quick. He was worried that there would be repercussions.
With this inspection, Ling Han indeed discovered a problem.
His soul had indeed become stronger, but there were also some impurities that affected the purity of his soul.
His soul was impure, and after reaching a certain level, he might not be himself anymore.

Ling Han’s heart shuddered, and he hurriedly started to refine these impurities. Thankfully, there weren’t many impurities now. He expelled them one by one, and it wasn’t long before his soul became clear and pure again.
“Haha, I’ve finally found you!” A cold laugh rang out, and Bai Wenxuan walked out.

Though they were all souls, firstly, they had all simulated their own figures and appearances, and secondly, the undulations of the soul fragments were also fixed and unchanging. Thus, it was actually very simple to recognize who was who.
“Brat, I’ve been looking for you for a long time,” Bai Wenxuan said coldly.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Are you rushing to your death?”

“What a joke!” Bai Wenxuan scoffed, “I am ranked 87th in Core Formation Tier on the Galaxy Network, with battle prowess surpassing Eighteen Heavens. Even if I am only in my soul state now, you are far from possibly being a match for me.
Where did he get such confidence from?

Cultivation level determined raw power, and power was the most important indicator of battle prowess for cultivators. As for soul power, though it would also be affected by cultivation level, but because everyone had not reached the level of cultivating soul power,
the gap wouldn’t be too big.
Moreover, Ling Han had killed so many Yin souls before, strengthening his soul. It was not certain whose soul would be stronger.

“Die!” Bai Wenxuan charged over. Even if he was only a pure soul, he still possessed a powerful battle prowess. His fists were enshrouded in divine light. That was high-level energy, and it was dazzlingly bright. It had a considerable restraining effect on Yin souls.
“Hahaha, the high-level energy I cultivate is of the light element, and is specialized in restraining souls. Without the protection of the physical body, how many moves can youn block from me?”
In a spiritual state, cultivators didn’t have a physical body, so they naturally couldn’t use mystical power. Thus, most celestial techniques were useless, and they could only use high-
level energy.
Thus, whoever grasped high-level energy that had strong destructive power against the soul clearly had a great advantage.
Ling Han didn’t say anything, and he simply raised his fist to block Bai Wenxuan’s attack.
Peng!
The two men’s fists crashed into each other. This was all formed from their souls, and they were competing to see whose Spiritual Power was stronger and whose higher-level energy
was more powerful.
After the attack, Ling Han and Bai Wenxuan both took a few steps back. Their spiritual bodies
rippled like water.
“Hmm?” Bai Wenxuan wore an astounded expression. Not only was Ling Han’s high-level energy no weaker than his, but his spiritual body was also incredibly solid. In fact, it was no
weaker than his.
How was this possible?

He was the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, and was three minor levels higher than Ling Han. This was equivalent to his soul power having improved three times more than him. Yet, he was still unable to gain the upper hand? How could he believe this?
