chapters.title: Chapter 3993: Soul technique
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Ling Han broke into a grin. As expected, he had killed a great many Yin souls in these few days, nourishing his soul. There was a clear improvement. Compared to a prodigy like Bai Wenxuan, who was three minor levels higher than him, he was not the slightest bit inferior.
Moreover, the high-level energy that he had used just now was only Heavenly Dao Flames.
“With such measly abilities, you’re still boasting?” Ling Han shook his head, appearing extremely disappointed.
Bai Wenxuan was in a towering rage. He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han again. Energy of light flickered, and he was like a god of war.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and casually attacked, clashing with Bai Wenxuan.

In the state of the soul, any martial arts techniques would be useless. They would only be competing in terms of the strength of Spiritual Power and the level of high-level energy, and in terms of battle techniques, who would be weaker than the other if they could become supreme prodigies like them?
The two of them exchanged blows, yet neither was able to gain the upper hand.
“Spiritual Spear!”
Xiu, Bai Wenxuan’s forehead split apart, and a golden spear shot out. It was incredibly dazzling, and had a powerful deterrent effect on the soul.
When this spear shot over, Ling Han instantly felt a strong sense of danger. If he still had any hair on his body, it would definitely be standing on end at this moment.
“An!” he roared loudly, and the secret technique of the Buddhist Race channelled, turning into a golden wave.
Peng!

The Six Characters Bright King Curse struck the golden spear, and the golden spear’s offensive immediately stalled. Then, it crumbled bit by bit, turning into pure energy that returned to the heaven and earth.
“What!” Bai Wenxuan was stunned to the extreme. “The Buddhist Race’s Six Characters Bright King Curse! You’re actually the successor of the Buddhist Race!”

Without a physical body, the majority of celestial techniques would not be able to channel, because they would need the support of mystical power, but there was an extremely small number of secret techniques that were an exception, and that was soul techniques!
Soul techniques were activated with Spiritual Power, so without the support of a physical body, they could still be channeled.

Bai Wenxuan was astonished. When it came to spiritual-level battles, the heirs of Buddhist Race were all elites. This was because they were specialized in exorcising Yin souls and moving people’s hearts. They could even sway people’s beliefs. Just how powerful was this spiritual power?
In the Netherworld, the battle prowess of a successor of the Buddhist Race could be increased by at least tenfold.

No wonder Ling Han’s spiritual power was no weaker than his even though he had only just advanced to the Core Formation Tier. Moreover, the high-level energy he grasped was also extremely terrifying. Then, could it be that this was the legendary “karmic flames”?

Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “I have many children, so on what basis have you discerned that I am a monk?” He charged over, and this time, he didn’t use the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Instead, he unleashed a murderous aura attack.
This was also on the level of divine sense, so he didn’t need to use his physical body to cast it.
As it turned out, he had actually mastered two soul techniques.

In the Living Realm, the murderous aura would arrive in a single strike, completely ignoring distance. However, in the Netherworld, the Regulations of heaven and earth were different, and one could see that the murderous aura’s attack had solidified, shooting towards Bai Wenxuan like an arrow.
There were traces to follow, so he could naturally dodge.

Bai Wenxuan didn’t know the origins of this attack, so he naturally didn’t dare to face it head- on. He hurriedly dodged, but Ling Han was already waiting for him. He threw another punch. The Heavenly Dao Flames burned fiercely, possessing tremendous destructive power against souls.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them continued to exchange blows. Both of them had mastered soul techniques. The destructive power might not be as frightening as high-level energy, but they could attack from afar, so whether it was close-quarter combat or a roaming battle, they could maintain a strong oppressive power.

However, Ling Han had mastered another soul technique, and the murderous aura continued to attack him. Bai Wenxuan was finally hit, and he couldn’t help but grab his head. He screamed repeatedly, and the spiritual ripples turned into endless ripples.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to charge over, his fists raining down.
Bai Wenxuan also went all out. With a loud roar, three golden spears actually surged out of his body at the same time.
Ling Han extinguished one of the spears with an ‘an’ character, but the other two spears still shot towards him.

Bai Wenxuan smirked coldly. This was his ultimate move, and he had not used it all this while because he wanted Ling Han to think that he was already at the end of his rope, and launch a fatal attack when he was careless.
And now, he had finally waited for a chance.
Ling Han’s expression was cold. He shot out both fists, each greeting a long spear.
He was seeking death!

Bai Wenxuan thought to himself, ‘This is a soul technique that specializes in impaling the soul, yet you’re facing it head-on with a spiritual body. Even if you channel high-level energy, it’s impossible for you to disperse all the attacks. With a single strike, you’ll definitely be severely injured.’

He had full confidence, because after battling for so long, he had gained a very strong understanding of the might of Ling Han’s Heavenly Dao Flames. It was definitely impossible that it could block the attacks of his twin spears.
Peng! Peng!
Ling Han’s fist greeted the long spear. As the Destructive Energy surged, the two long spears were instantly destroyed.
Pu!

Bai Wenxuan instantly spluttered. Even in his soul form, he still spat out a large amount of spiritual light. That expression on his face... it wasn’t changing color, but changing shape. He was a soul in the first place, and could become whatever he wanted.
F***, how was this possible?
His ultimate move was actually destroyed with a casual two punches from Ling Han?

“What kind of energy is that?!” Bai Xuanxuan exclaimed in astonishment. Although high- level energy was destructive toward souls, this kind of energy that was so dark that it surpassed darkness itself was enough to make his soul tremble.
This was too terrifying. How could there be such high-level energy?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “I call it... Destructive Energy!”

Bai Wenxuan was both envious and resentful. Why was Ling Han able to obtain this kind of high-level energy? He was the heir of the Holy Land, so why was the high-level energy he grasped completely incomparable to Ling Han?
However, in the next instant, he turned around and left.
In front of this kind of energy, he was definitely no match. If he continued to fight stubbornly,
the only result would be his soul being destroyed, and his physical body becoming an empty
shell, right until he died after expending all his life energy.
He was proud, he was overbearing, but he was not the slightest bit stupid.
‘Leave. Where there’s life, there’s hope.’
“Still trying to escape?” Ling Han said with a cold chuckle. He leaped forward and chased
after Bai Wenxuan.

However, in a soul state, both sides were unable to channel movement techniques. Furthermore, the Regulations of heaven and earth were different, so they could only run on the ground, and could not fly or tunnel through the ground.
This allowed them to have fewer variations in their movement technique. They would either be walking in a straight line or walking in circles, so it was very easy to judge.
The murderous aura surged forth.
Ling Han waved his hand repeatedly, sending out bursts of murderous aura.
Right now, his soul was extremely powerful, and he could easily withstand such extravagance.
He continued to unleash murderous aura attacks at Ling Han.
Bai Wenxuan was extremely awkward. Should he dodge or not?
If he dodged, he wouldn’t be able to maintain a straight line. With the two of them moving at
the same speed, he would be immediately caught up to. At that time, he would have to face the Destructive Energy. Just the thought of it terrified him.
But if he didn’t dodge?
The barrage of this murderous aura had a powerful numbing and intimidating effect on his
soul, causing him to sink into a state of stagnation. Even if it was only for an instant, Ling Han
would still catch up to him.
Xiu, he moved, and dodged. Then, his spiritual body released a wave.
“Save me!”

Bai Wenxuan was both envious and resentful.
Why was Ling Han able to obtain this kind of high-level energy?
He was the heir of the Holy Land, so why was the high-level energy he grasped completely incomparable to Ling Han?
However, in the next instant, he turned around and left.
In front of this kind of energy, he was definitely no match.
If he continued to fight stubbornly,
the only result would be his soul being destroyed, and his physical body becoming an empty
shell, right until he died after expending all his life energy.
He was proud, he was overbearing, but he was not the slightest bit stupid.
‘Leave.
Where there’s life, there’s hope.’
“Still trying to escape?” Ling Han said with a cold chuckle.
He leaped forward and chased
after Bai Wenxuan.
However, in a soul state, both sides were unable to channel movement techniques.
Furthermore, the Regulations of heaven and earth were different, so they could only run on the ground, and could not fly or tunnel through the ground.
This allowed them to have fewer variations in their movement technique.
They would either be walking in a straight line or walking in circles, so it was very easy to judge.
The murderous aura surged forth.
Ling Han waved his hand repeatedly, sending out bursts of murderous aura.
Right now, his soul was extremely powerful, and he could easily withstand such extravagance.
He continued to unleash murderous aura attacks at Ling Han.
Bai Wenxuan was extremely awkward.
Should he dodge or not?
If he dodged, he wouldn’t be able to maintain a straight line.
With the two of them moving at
the same speed, he would be immediately caught up to.
At that time, he would have to face the Destructive Energy.
Just the thought of it terrified him.
But if he didn’t dodge?
The barrage of this murderous aura had a powerful numbing and intimidating effect on his
soul, causing him to sink into a state of stagnation.
Even if it was only for an instant, Ling Han
would still catch up to him.
Xiu, he moved, and dodged.
Then, his spiritual body released a wave.
“Save me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3994: Rapidly growing stronger
paragraphs: As a prodigy of the Holy Land, he had actually been beaten to the point of screaming for help? This was too laughable.

However, this was the only thing Bai Wenxuan could do at this moment. If someone else entered, they might be able to save his life. Moreover, even if he alerted the Yin souls here, it would be good. Taking advantage of the chaos, he would be able to escape.
Ling Han was neither angry nor happy. He leaped out, and he had already caught up to Bai Wenxuan, his fists attacking furiously.

Originally, he had only wanted to take the first place in a low-key manner, and then cultivate the precious technique with Chi Menghan. Then, he would return home. From now onwards, the eternal burial of Ding Yi had nothing to do with him.
But this Bai Wenxuan was determined to trifle with him, and even wanted to kill him.
Then there was nothing more to say. If you want to kill me, you can go die first.
Bai Wenxuan resisted with all his might. There was great terror in his heart, because Ling Han didn’t use Destructive Energy, which put a huge psychological pressure on him.

Xiu, xiu, xiu! Right at this moment, seven Yin souls appeared. When they saw Ling Han and Bai Wenxuan, they were like sharks that had smelt blood, and they could feel that they were glowing with excitement.
To Ling Han and the others, Yin souls could nourish their souls, but vice versa, living souls were also a rare tonic for them.
Without the slightest pause, they pounced over.
However, their abilities were too low.
They were either Foundation Building Tier or Cauldron Forging Tier, and there wasn’t even a single Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han finally channeled the Destructive Energy. He didn’t want to drag things out any longer.

Boom, his fists danced, and the seven Yin souls that had rushed over all collapsed in an instant. The remaining power did not diminish, and landed on Bai Wenxuan’s fist. Destructive Energy wreaked havoc, and his right fist instantly disappeared, then spread out along his arm, instantly destroying his entire right arm.

Bai Wenxuan screamed in pain. However, with a shake of his body, his right arm instantly surged out again. It was as if nothing had happened, but it could be seen that his body had clearly dimmed and become slightly transparent.
He could regrow a lost limb even when he wasn’t a Saint?
Of course not. However, Bai Wenxuan wasn’t a physical body right now, and he was only a soul. Thus, he could change his appearance however he wanted.
Losing his soul was still a loss, so his soul had become dimmer and more transparent. In fact, it had even become smaller.
Yet Ling Han felt a sense of familiarity. There was energy being absorbed by him, causing his soul to become slightly stronger.
Among it, there were seven Yin souls, and a portion of it came from Bai Xuanxuan. One of his arms had been destroyed, and in truth, he had lost a portion of his soul.
However, Bai Wenxuan didn’t dare to say another word, and he hurriedly continued to flee.
Just now, he had finally exchanged blows with the Destructive Energy. This allowed him to deeply experience just how terrifying this kind of high-level energy could be.
He was completely outmatched!
Without the protection of the physical body, the soul was too fragile in front of such high- level energy.
When he left here and returned to his physical body, just see how he would deal with Ling Han.
At that time, his advantage in cultivation level would be fully displayed. After all, Ling Han was only in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier, so there was no way he could rival him.
Just you wait, he would definitely get his revenge.

“You don’t have such an opportunity,” Ling Han said coldly. He unleashed his murderous aura, forcing Bai Wenxuan to dodge. He caught up to him, and with a furious punch, the Destructive Energy surged. It was too effective against the soul.

“No!” Bai Wenxuan roared in fury. He was the heir of the Holy Land, and was on the level of Dao Child. In future, it was very possible that he would inherit the inheritance of the Holy Land, and could hold the Saint Tool in his hands, looking down on the universe.
Furthermore, his cultivation level was superior to Ling Han’s. If he was killed like this, he would not be resigned. He would be too aggrieved.
Ling Han didn’t say anything. In his eyes, Bai Wenxuan was already a dead man, so there was no need to waste his breath.
Hong, hong, hong! Under his furious attacks, Bai Wenxuan continued to lose limbs, and his soul became smaller and smaller, and dimmer.
“No! No! No!” Bai Wenxuan screamed. He could already foresee death.
This very quickly became reality. His spirit had completely died out, turning into pure energy of heaven and earth. A sliver of it was absorbed by Ling Han, strengthening his spirit.

“Killing someone would allow one to become stronger. Just thinking about it is truly terrifying. If the conditions permit, wouldn’t one be able to cultivate their soul to the level of the Venerate Tier or even Saint Tier in an extremely short amount of time?”
“There is nothing in this world that can reap without sowing. To improve so quickly, there would definitely be disadvantages.”
“I can’t be greedy and insatiable. Every time I improve, I have to turn around to see if there are hidden dangers left in my soul.”
Ling Han said to himself. This kind of method of becoming stronger would really cause one to become obsessed. It was too simple. He only needed to kill.
He naturally would not stop. For the moment, he had not seen any disadvantages. He naturally would not miss out on such an alluring method of improvement.
Bai Wenxuan had already completely dissipated, and his soul had returned to heaven and earth. Even if his physical body was not the slightest bit injured, it was eternally impossible
for him to wake up.
Ling Han continued to advance, hunting Yin souls.

After walking for a while, he discovered that there was a large group of Yin souls that were presently forming a group and heading in a certain direction. Though this group was not very organized, it was a dense mass, and at a glance, he was still filled with shock.
What was going on here?

Previously, though Ling Han had also encountered a considerable number of Yin souls, all of them were like lonely ghosts that would only wander in a certain area, but now, it was clearly different. It was like an army had been summoned, and was presently gathering towards the
battlefield.
However, there were so many Yin souls.
Ling Han’s eyes practically lit up - if he really had eyes now. He immediately charged out.
If there were others here, they would discover that Ling Han was like a moth flying into a flame, or like a sheep entering a pack of tigers, charging into the vast army of Yin souls when
he himself was incredibly tiny..
However, in the next instant, Ling Han exploded.
He brandished his fists, and Destructive Energy surged madly. Yin souls fell one after another, reaping as if they were straws.

However, the yin soul soldiers did not have intelligence. Though the yin soul soldiers near him were very afraid of the Destructive Energy, the yin soul soldiers in the distance only smelt the sweet temptation of a living soul, and were still endlessly squeezing over. Thus, Ling Han didn’t need to chase after them at all. He only needed to stand where he was and brandish his fists. Naturally, there would be a large number of yin souls charging over for
him to kill.

Every time he killed one, his soul would become slightly stronger, and the rate at which he killed was really too fast. The speed at which his soul became stronger was also astonishingly fast. It was definitely more terrifying than eating natural treasures.
After battling for a long time, Ling Han was finally worried that there would be disadvantages. Thus, he charged out of the siege, and fled into the distance.
The Yin souls were in pursuit, but after chasing for a while, these Yin souls stopped, and returned to their original course, continuing their journey.
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to expel the impurities in his soul.

He had clearly only battled for half a day, but he had killed too many Yin souls. His soul fragments had also become very heterogeneous, causing him to feel like he had lost himself. He wanted to keep fighting, just for the sake of becoming stronger.
How terrifying.
Ling Han spent a whole four days’ time, and only then did he manage to turn his soul back to a
pure and transparent state.
All right, he would go again.

chapters.title: Chapter 3995: Yin soul with intelligence
paragraphs: These words sounded very reasonable.
However, as Ling Han looked at those Yin souls that were endlessly advancing in the distance, he shook his head, and asked, “Why do these Yin souls not devour each other?”
“This... I don’t know either,” the great yin soul said.

Ling Han laughed loudly, “My memory is not that bad. Previously, when you came, your first words were ‘why Yin souls are missing’. As it turned out, it was I who had cut off the yin souls here. Thus, you are deliberately guiding these Yin souls to some place.”
The great yin soul was dumbfounded. Why was this living soul’s intelligence so high?
“Do you think that I have just developed intelligence like you?” Ling Han scoffed. Their intelligence were on two completely different levels.
The great Yin soul was rendered speechless.
“Don’t forget, you only have one chance,” Ling Han said calmly.

The large Yin soul hesitated for a moment, then said, “In front of us, there is a small piece of Ghost Spirit Crystal. For low-level Yin souls, it is an irresistible temptation, so they would all be attracted, and then begin fighting over it.”
“In this kind of contest, the yin souls would devour each other, and ultimately, develop intelligence.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. This was more logical.
“Since the Ghost Spirit Crystal is so useful, why didn’t you seize it?”
The large yin soul hesitated for a moment, then said, “Lord Gaddallah placed it there. Its purpose is to produce a yin soul with intelligence, and turn it into its subordinate.”

“Oh, what’s the deal about this Gaddallah?” Ling Han asked. “Come, come, come. Don’t simply answer one question at a time. Tell me everything you know. En, let’s start from after you developed intelligence.”
Ling Han listened to what the great Yin soul said.

This was actually not all that complicated. The place that Ling Han was presently in was the territory of the Western Desert King, and this Western Desert King was equivalent to an elite of the Sect Master-level.

Aside from the Western Desert King, there were also seven True Lord Tier-level Great Yin Souls, and the subordinates of these seven Great Yin Souls naturally included the True Self Tier, the Core Formation Tier yin souls, and they had all developed intelligence.
How was it developed?
It was very simple. They would devour each other, and when they devoured each other to a certain extent, they would be able to develop intelligence.
Not only that, as long as it continued to devour its peers, the Yin soul could continue to become stronger.
For example, the Western Desert King had started from the True Self Tier and devoured who knew how many dead souls before finally becoming Sect Master-level.
Why did it start from the True Self Tier?
Because the Western Desert King was an elite when he was alive, the Yin soul after death was also very powerful, and its starting point far surpassed other Yin souls.

And after reaching Sect Master-level, it was already impossible for the Western Desert King to improve further by devouring ordinary Yin souls. Thus, if it wanted to become stronger, it could only devour Yin souls that were similarly Sect Master-level.
However, as fellow Sect Masters, who was weaker than the other?
Thus, these super powerful Yin souls would work hard to nurture their subordinates, and build an army to help themselves.
Of course, if his subordinate continued to become stronger, and suddenly advanced, the Western Desert King would not mind devouring this subordinate.

However, it was unknown how many Yin souls one would have to devour to gain intelligence. Then, it would become more and more difficult. To advance from the Spiritual Transformation Tier to the Minor Advanced Tier was as difficult as ascending the heavens, and it was unknown how many tens of thousands of years or even hundreds of thousands of years it would take for one to appear.
Thankfully, Yin souls did not have the limitations of lifespan, so they could just continue waiting like this.

Ling Han took a deep breath, though this action was very unnecessary. They were presently in the territory of a Sect Master-level Yin soul, and if they accidentally encountered such an elite, they would not even have the chance to flee.
His soul could not return, and his physical body would slowly decay.
With a thought, he decided to continue.
This kind of method to strengthen his soul was really too simple and too easy, making him feel as if he had become addicted, and could not get rid of it no matter what.
He just had to be careful.

He killed that great yin soul with a single punch, and the soul naturally strengthened further. This was a yin soul of a Core Formation Tier, and its nourishing effects were slightly stronger than other yin souls.
Ling Han continued to hunt Yin souls, but this time, he did not block off all the Yin souls here. Instead, he released half of them. In any case, there were many Yin souls here.
After killing for a while, he stopped and purified his soul.
Just like that, after only a month, Ling Han discovered that his soul had become extremely strong. It was like a water bag that was already filled to the brim, swelling to an
uncomfortable extent.
His soul had already reached the peak stage of the Core Formation Tier.
After killing a few more Yin souls, the strength of Ling Han’s soul surpassed the threshold of the Core Formation Tier and advanced into the True Self Tier.
Of course, it was only the soul’s strength that surpassed Core Formation Tier. In terms of cultivation level, he was still at the Core Formation Tier.

Ling Han had no intention of crossing over either. This was something that could be forcibly increased through killing Yin souls, and not something that he had cultivated himself. After all, this was not reliable.

It was just like using natural treasures to directly increase one’s cultivation level. What was the point of achieving such a cultivation level? In a battle of equal cultivation levels, one’s strength would definitely be pitifully low.

Thus, Ling Han was only increasing the strength of his soul now, but the cultivation level of his soul was still at the same level. When he returned to his physical body, he would improve it together with his physical body. Only then would the cultivation level he had cultivated
become stronger.
However, when the strength of his soul had advanced into the level of the True Self Tier, killing Yin souls would no longer be able to help him improve any further.

If he hadn’t encountered the large yin soul soul from before, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t have understood, but now he knew that this was a bottleneck. In the future, he could only kill True Self Tier yin souls, and only then would he be able to continue improving the strength of
his soul.

This wouldn’t be fast, because there were only so many True Self Tier yin souls. Furthermore, they had all developed intelligence, so it would be extremely difficult to hunt them. Furthermore, Yin souls of this level could be considered the most capable subordinates of the Western Desert King. The death of one would definitely draw attention, and a great search
would be carried out.
Thus, he had to be careful.
However, there was still another option, and that was the Ghost Spirit Crystal.
Why could Yin souls scramble madly for this? That was because this could increase the
strength of Yin souls, causing Yin souls to have an instinctive need.
The Ghost Spirit Crystal could improve Yin souls, and for living souls like them, it was also a
nutritious saintly item.
Thus, Ling Han decided to steal the Ghost Spirit Crystal.
He walked in the direction that the Yin souls were advancing in. After walking for about half a
day, he saw that those Yin souls had all become irritable and uneasy, and Ling Han could also vaguely sense that there was an indescribable fragrance ahead of him, which made him feel
comfortable all over.
Was that the Ghost Spirit Crystal?

A bit further ahead, the Yin souls began to fight with each other. The winning side would devour the losing side, and thus become much stronger. In this way, the victor would become stronger, and stand out from the rest.

Ling Han didn’t get too close. He was a living soul, and for a yin soul, his temptation wasn’t much inferior to that of the Ghost Spirit Crystal. However, he retracted his soul fluctuations very well. Unless one could see him “with the naked eye”, they would not be able to discover
him.
In terms of strength of Spiritual Power, the True Self Tier-level vision was only about three thousand meters.
“En?” Ling Han was surprised, and looked to the side. The yin souls there were rioting, as if
they had gone mad.

become stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 3997: Selfish
paragraphs: What was going on?
Ling Han looked over, only to see several streaks of dazzling soul light soaring into the sky. He could see them clearly even from such a far distance away.
Living souls.
F***, it was the group that had just entered.
They had obviously had a taste of success, and followed those Yin souls all the way here. It was equivalent to entering into a mountain of treasures, with treasures everywhere ready for the taking.
However, the problem was that they clearly weren’t like Ling Han, who had captured a Yin soul that had gained intelligence and found out that there was more than just an opportunity here.
-This was a Yin soul that was on the level of Sect Master, and was incredibly terrifying.
So showy, were they tired of living?
Because they were too far away, and those few people were surrounded by Yin souls, he could not see clearly who was who.
He, this may be a chance.

The strength of Ling Han’s soul had already advanced into the True Self Tier, and added with the terrifying destructive power of Destructive Energy, he would probably be able to defeat even Yin souls that were slightly weaker in the Spirit Transformation Tier.
If a Sect Master-level old yin soul did not appear, he should not be in any life-threatening danger.
This was just right. He could make use of these people to draw out the great yin soul, and he could take advantage of the opening to kill it.

Ling Han made up his mind, and sat on the sidelines, calmly waiting. In any case, the small monsters were completely useless to him, so he’d just let them kill each other and create large monsters, and only then would they be useful to him.
Moreover, it was not like the Ghost Spirit Crystal would run away.

“Hahaha, I never thought that a few living souls would actually barge in here. This is really delicious!” Amidst a long laugh, a great monster appeared. It was also in human form, but its whole body was covered with dark green spikes, that were about a foot long, and looked incredibly vicious.
When this great monster appeared, those small Yin souls seemed to have encountered their nemesis, and they all stepped back, appearing to be incredibly reverent.

Although ordinary Yin souls didn’t develop intelligence, this was an inherent suppression. Even if they didn’t have intelligence, they would still instinctively feel fear, just like how the suppression of high-level vicious beasts against low-level vicious beasts completely came from their ranks.
When these Yin souls retreated, Ling Han could see clearly that there were a total of five people. Judging by the appearances of the souls, they should all be men.
“Yi, there is actually a Yin soul that has gained intelligence!” When the five people saw the giant monster, they too looked surprised.
“Not good, the Yin soul’s oppressive power is too strong, and it’s extremely likely to reach the True Self Tier!” someone immediately said.

This caused the other four people’s expressions to become grim. Though the level suppression on the soul would be considerably smaller, this was still a large tier’s difference in cultivation level, after all. Furthermore, the True Self Tier had begun to cultivate the soul, so the True Self Tier Yin soul would also be considerably stronger in comparison.

“Gaga, living souls, you guys are right.” The giant monster laughed strangely, “I am in the True Self Tier. Your soul light is so dim, and in front of me, it is completely unable to withstand a single blow. However, you guys are living souls, and should taste extremely delicious.”
It charged over, and delivered a palm strike.

Though the five of them looked like they were facing a great enemy, they did not panic. After all, they were all supreme prodigies that had stunned an entire galaxy in the outside world, so how could they possibly not be able to maintain even the most basic level of composure?

“A Yin soul is only a Yin soul. No matter how strong it is, it is still limited!” A living soul said. He waved his hand and shot out a ray of light, which was incredibly dazzling, like it was a ray of sunlight that had pierced through the darkness.
“Yi?” The giant monster was shocked, and stretched out a hand to parry, destroying this ray of light. However, a wisp of smoke rose from its hand, and its soul was slightly weakened.
Of course, for its colossal size, this little loss was negligible, and there was absolutely no need to be concerned.
“Living souls are really quite hard to deal with,” the large monster said. Then, with a shake of its body, a chain was thrown out, sweeping towards the five people.
That was Dark Frost Iron.
The five of them channeled the soul technique and attacked the giant monster.
They were all top-notch prodigies, so it wasn’t strange for them to have mastered soul techniques.
The soul technique could greatly increase the battle prowess of the soul. When the five great prodigies joined forces, their might was astonishing.

However, the giant monster was a True Self Tier elite, and it wasn’t one that had just advanced into the True Self Tier. Instead, it had devoured a great many Yin souls of the same cultivation level, allowing the strength of its soul to reach the late stage of the True Self Tier. Thus, this gulf was massive, and could not be compensated by mere soul techniques.
Even if the five prodigies teamed up, they were still no match for the giant monster. They were beaten into an extremely sorry state.
Ling Han was just about to make a move, when the alliance of five people suddenly crumbled. One of them suddenly turned around and left, leaving his companions behind.
He used the other four people to hold back the giant monster, buying time for his own escape. “Wang En, you are too despicable!” Immediately, someone rebuked. Then, he too turned around and fled.
In this way, the speed at which this alliance crumbled was even faster.
The other three were also unwilling to sacrifice themselves, and hurriedly turned and fled as
well.
Ling Han frowned. He had already decided to make a move, but looking at the appearance of these five people, he felt bitterly disappointed.
This kind of person was selfish, so what was there to save them for?
He withdrew his gaze, and turned towards the centre of the barrage of Yin souls.
The Ghost Spirit Crystal was definitely there.
He charged over. For Yin souls, living souls were a sweet and irresistible temptation. The nearby Yin souls immediately surged over, surrounding him like floodwaters.

Ling Han did not linger in battle. By now, this kind of minor character could no longer be of any benefit to him. He moved swiftly. Only when there was really no other path left for him, would he move, and shatter the Yin soul in front of him.
Not too long later, he had arrived at the central area.

A stone pillar suddenly stood erect here. It was a few meters wide, but its height was 300 meters. After arriving here, Ling Han could clearly sense that there seemed to be something at the top of the stone pillar that was incredibly attractive to him.
The Ghost Spirit Crystal was at the top of the stone pillar.
Ling Han immediately began to climb. Using both his hands and feet, his speed was extremely
fast.

In less than a few seconds, he had arrived at the top of the stone pillar. As expected, there was a black crystal on it. It was almost transparent, but there were countless veined patterns on it. If one stared at it, it seemed to have a powerful attraction that could absorb one’s soul as well. Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all as he grabbed the black crystal. He then wrapped his soul around it and stored it inside his body.

He leaped down. Peng, his soul crashed into the ground, instantly creating a massive shockwave. One after another, Yin souls were sent flying, turning into straws in the sky. There was no more value here. Ling Han rapidly ran. This kind of place that was used to create intelligent Yin souls was definitely not the only one. Thus, he only had to go to another area, and he would definitely be able to obtain even more Ghost Spirit Crystals.

As he ran, Ling Han refined the Ghost Spirit Crystal with his soul. He felt copious amounts of power surge into his body, strengthening his soul. Although its speed wasn’t as fast as slaughtering Yin souls, it wasn’t slow either.
More importantly, he no longer had any profit from killing ordinary Yin souls, so the value of
the Ghost Spirit Crystal was clearly displayed.
“Stop right there!” A voice suddenly rang out from within his body.

He was a soul, so this voice was actually transmitted through his divine sense. Ling Han turned around to look. There was a person chasing after him. It was one of the five people from before, and it was that Wang En who had fled at the first instant.

Of course, for its colossal size, this little loss was negligible, and there was absolutely no need to be concerned.
“Living souls are really quite hard to deal with,” the large monster said.
Then, with a shake of its body, a chain was thrown out, sweeping towards the five people.
That was Dark Frost Iron.
The five of them channeled the soul technique and attacked the giant monster.
They were all top-notch prodigies, so it wasn’t strange for them to have mastered soul techniques.
The soul technique could greatly increase the battle prowess of the soul.
When the five great prodigies joined forces, their might was astonishing.
However, the giant monster was a True Self Tier elite, and it wasn’t one that had just advanced into the True Self Tier.
Instead, it had devoured a great many Yin souls of the same cultivation level, allowing the strength of its soul to reach the late stage of the True Self Tier.
Thus, this gulf was massive, and could not be compensated by mere soul techniques.
Even if the five prodigies teamed up, they were still no match for the giant monster.
They were beaten into an extremely sorry state.
Ling Han was just about to make a move, when the alliance of five people suddenly crumbled.
One of them suddenly turned around and left, leaving his companions behind.
He used the other four people to hold back the giant monster, buying time for his own escape.
“Wang En, you are too despicable!” Immediately, someone rebuked.
Then, he too turned around and fled.
In this way, the speed at which this alliance crumbled was even faster.
The other three were also unwilling to sacrifice themselves, and hurriedly turned and fled as
well.
Ling Han frowned.
He had already decided to make a move, but looking at the appearance of these five people, he felt bitterly disappointed.
This kind of person was selfish, so what was there to save them for?
He withdrew his gaze, and turned towards the centre of the barrage of Yin souls.
The Ghost Spirit Crystal was definitely there.
He charged over.
For Yin souls, living souls were a sweet and irresistible temptation.
The nearby Yin souls immediately surged over, surrounding him like floodwaters.
Ling Han did not linger in battle.
By now, this kind of minor character could no longer be of any benefit to him.
He moved swiftly.
Only when there was really no other path left for him, would he move, and shatter the Yin soul in front of him.
Not too long later, he had arrived at the central area.
A stone pillar suddenly stood erect here.
It was a few meters wide, but its height was 300 meters.
After arriving here, Ling Han could clearly sense that there seemed to be something at the top of the stone pillar that was incredibly attractive to him.
The Ghost Spirit Crystal was at the top of the stone pillar.
Ling Han immediately began to climb.
Using both his hands and feet, his speed was extremely
fast.
In less than a few seconds, he had arrived at the top of the stone pillar.
As expected, there was a black crystal on it.
It was almost transparent, but there were countless veined patterns on it.
If one stared at it, it seemed to have a powerful attraction that could absorb one’s soul as well.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all as he grabbed the black crystal.
He then wrapped his soul around it and stored it inside his body.
He leaped down.
Peng, his soul crashed into the ground, instantly creating a massive shockwave.
One after another, Yin souls were sent flying, turning into straws in the sky.
There was no more value here.
Ling Han rapidly ran.
This kind of place that was used to create intelligent Yin souls was definitely not the only one.
Thus, he only had to go to another area, and he would definitely be able to obtain even more Ghost Spirit Crystals.
As he ran, Ling Han refined the Ghost Spirit Crystal with his soul.
He felt copious amounts of power surge into his body, strengthening his soul.
Although its speed wasn’t as fast as slaughtering Yin souls, it wasn’t slow either.
More importantly, he no longer had any profit from killing ordinary Yin souls, so the value of
the Ghost Spirit Crystal was clearly displayed.
“Stop right there!” A voice suddenly rang out from within his body.
He was a soul, so this voice was actually transmitted through his divine sense.
Ling Han turned around to look.
There was a person chasing after him.
It was one of the five people from before, and it was that Wang En who had fled at the first instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 3998: Wang En
paragraphs: Yi, why had this person chased over? Furthermore, he looked like he had come aggressively. Ling Han stopped in his tracks, and asked calmly, “What can I do for you?”

“I saw it. You took something from the stone pillar. Now, hand it over.” Wang En placed his hands behind his back, looking calm as if he was confident that he could defeat Ling Han. The sorry state he had been in when he had fled in a panic was completely gone.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “Why should I give you something I obtained?”
“Because I am stronger than you,” Wang En said, his expression matter-of-fact.
Ling Han shook his head, “You are strong? Just now, who was the one that was no match for the Yin soul, and fled without regard for his companions?”
Wang En’s expression instantly changed. Because he was a spiritual body, he had not only changed his face, but also his entire body.
To him, this was a great stain. He had actually used his companions to hold back the enemy while he himself escaped. Though those companions were not much better as they too immediately fled.
However, it could not be denied that he was the first to flee.
He could do it, but he definitely would not allow others to say it, and definitely could not say it right in front of him.

“You’re truly seeking death!” Wang En said coldly. His killing intent was already blazing. Ling Han was completely unconcerned, and said calmly, “I’m not an indignant youth, and can’t be bothered to deal with people like you screwing over each other, but if you insist on being greedy and provoke me, I can only spend some effort to blast you into smithereens.” “Hahaha!” Wang En laughed loudly. This was really the biggest joke in the world. He was a late stage cultivator of the Core Formation Tier, and he had been killing Yin souls all these days. The strength of his soul had already reached the consummate level of the Core Formation Tier, which was incredibly powerful.
A mere cultivator in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier actually dared to say that he wanted to kill him? Wasn’t this a joke?

Even if Ling Han’s killing efficiency was the same as his, the strength of Ling Han’s soul would only reach the middle stage of the Core Formation Tier at most, so how could it possibly compare to his?

“Alright, since you’re so arrogant, I’ll oblige you.” Wang En charged over, delivering a palm strike at Ling Han. Only when it was about to hit Ling Han did his palm light up. A fiery flame was burning, wanting to directly burn Ling Han’s soul into ashes.
Ling Han brandished his fists in response, and the Heavenly Dao Flames ignited, fighting fire with fire.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Wang En was immediately sent flying.
How could a consummate level Core Formation Tier cultivator compare to a True Self Tier cultivator?

“What?!” Wang En’s expression changed again, but this time, it wasn’t due to embarrassment and anger, but due to shock. How could this brat be so terrifying? Wasn’t he at the early stage of Core Formation Tier? How could his soul be so powerful, reaching the level of the True Self Tier?

Could it be that he was the heir of the Imperial Clan, and had nurtured his soul with natural treasures since childhood, which was why the strength of his soul had surpassed his true cultivation level by a whole level?

He couldn’t help but feel shocked. The words ‘Imperial Clan’ were like mountains. No matter how prodigious you were, you would still be suppressed to the point of being unable to raise your head in front of these two words.

Unless you could become an Ancestral King, you would only be able to be polite to the Imperial Clan forever. Even if you became a Saint, you would not be able to do as you liked in front of the Imperial Clan.
However, the problem now was not whether he was from an Imperial Clan or not, but rather that his opponent was too strong, and he was completely no match for him.
Run.
He turned around and immediately fled.
This time, he had really kicked an iron plate. He could not have imagined that a Core Formation early stage cultivator would actually possess the spiritual strength of a True Self Tier.
No, he had to kill more Yin souls and increase his own Spiritual Power. Then, he would kill this person with a Spiritual Tool.
Once his soul was destroyed, no one would know that he had offended the Imperial Clan.
However, he had only taken two steps, when he shockingly discovered that Ling Han was already closing in on him.
His speed was not as fast as Ling Han.
This was natural. Neither of them could cast the movement technique, so it must be whoever had a stronger soul, and whose speed would be faster.
Wang En gritted his teeth, and his head actually cracked open. Then, a green long sword
appeared.
The moment this sword appeared, Ling Han immediately felt a coldness, which was very similar to the feeling that the Dark Frost Iron gave him.
Yi, was this also a Spirit Tool that was specifically targeted at souls?
Hold on, how had he brought it in?
“I have a Soul Tool in hand. If you continue to be so overbearing, we can simply destroy each other indiscriminately,” Wang En said. His sword in hand, he did not attack.
This was a Soul Tool?
Ling Han nodded internally. If it was not a soul, how could it possibly be brought into the Netherworld?

Looks like the heirs of these great clans and forces really had deep roots. It was clear that they were completely unaware that they had entered into the Netherworld this time, but they had indeed prepared a Soul Tool. This was the strength of their background.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Then I have to thank you for gifting me treasures!”
‘What?’
Wang En faltered for a moment before becoming furious.
Just how much did he look down on him? Did he think that even if he had a Soul Tool, it would
only be for show? That he would simply surrender the treasure to him?
“You are really arrogant!” Wang En said through gritted teeth.
“I’m just telling the truth.” Ling Han moved, approaching Wang En.
“You’re seeking death!” Wang En slashed down with his sword.
This was a Soul Tool. If it was used in the Living Realm, its might would be too weak, because
it could only target the soul. Moreover, whose soul wasn’t in the mind and protected by the
physical body? It couldn’t possibly be wounded by a Soul Tool.
But in the Netherworld, this was completely a deadly weapon.
Shua, the sword slashed over, its cold light blazing.
Ling Han wrapped the Destructive Energy around his fist, and then greeted the attack.
When Wang En saw this, he couldn’t help but feel both happy and furious.

How much did they look down on him for daring to use his bare fists to parry the attacks of the Soul Tool? How could he not be enraged? However, this was also his opponent seeking death. This strike would at least slice off one fifth of his soul, causing the strength of his soul to drop
from the True Self Tier.
Peng!
His fist met the soul sword, but a jaw-dropping scene appeared. The sword was actually
blocked.
“What!” Wang En called out, the ripples in his soul boiling.
He was really going to be scared to death. How was this possible? A soul was facing a Soul
Tool head-on?
No, that black-coloured energy.
Wang En saw very clearly. It was precisely because of this layer of black energy that Ling Han’s
fist managed to block the sharpness of his sword.
Hiss, what kind of high-level energy was this, that it could actually block a Soul Tool?
Ling Han smiled calmly, “I have already said. You are only delivering treasures to me.”
Wang En gritted his teeth and forcefully pulled his sword back. Then, he slashed at Ling Han
again.
Ling Han merely smiled, and brandished his fists in response. Peng, peng, peng! Wrapped in Destructive Energy, he was completely capable of taking on a Soul Tool by himself.
The strength of his soul was completely superior to Wang En’s, and the latter’s Soul Tool couldn’t take effect, so Wang En naturally could only passively take a beating.
The spiritual attack.
Weng, a shockwave surged towards Wang En. In the present situation, how could Wang En possibly be able to dodge? Instantly, he was hit, and the entire soul body froze.
In the first place, he was at a disadvantage, so how could he afford to have such a mistake
happen? Peng!
Ling Han shot out a punch, and used Destructive Energy to directly obliterate the other’s
spiritual body.
Wang En only had time to release a short scream of pain before completely dispersing, but there was still his unwilling resentment in the air.
A prodigy in the late stage of Core Formation Tier actually died in the hands of a cultivator in the early stage of the Core Formation Tier. Anyone would be dissatisfied if it was them.

chapters.title: Chapter 3999: Rescue
paragraphs: Ling Han picked up the Soul Tool on the ground.
He took a closer look, and couldn’t help but feel surprised. That was because while it was also a Soul Tool, but this was much higher grade than the chain used by the great yin soul from before.
Dark Cold Iron Frost itself could cause damage to the soul. Thus, if one wanted to use it as a weapon, they could only smear a special substance on one end to block any damage to the soul.
However, there was a flaw in this, and that was he could not store it into his soul.

However, this sword was of a very high level. It used veined patterns to suppress the damage that the material itself could cause to the soul. When it needed to be used, it could be activated again, and this suppression would disappear.
Thus, the chain was completely crude, and this sword was worthy of being called a Soul Tool.

Ling Han put the sword away, then continued to advance. At the same time, he refined the Ghost Spirit Crystal in his soul. With every minute and second that passed, he felt that his soul had become slightly stronger.
As long as he had a few more Ghost Spirit Crystals, the True Self Tier consummate level would be just around the corner.
In this place, there was no change in day and night. The sky was still gray, and it was extremely oppressive.
After spending seven days, Ling Han finally digested the Ghost Spirit Crystal. The strength of his soul had already reached the middle stage of the True Self Tier.
There was no need for appreciation. Just like wild beasts, as long as they had a full stomach, their abilities would naturally rise accordingly.
However, he had yet to discover a second wave of Yin soul troops.
On this day, he continued to advance, searching for the second Ghost Spirit Crystal.
Yi?
He did not discover a vast expanse of Yin souls, but heard the sounds of battle.
What was going on?
He fled through the shockwaves of battle, and after traversing a small hill, he discovered that there were presently two spiritual bodies battling fiercely.

One of them was a Yin soul. Moreover, it was a large monster that had reached the level of the True Self Tier consummate stage. Meanwhile, he wielded a large saber in his hand, and as he brandished the saber, cold light flashed. It had a massive destructive effect on the soul.
On the other side was a living soul, obviously one of their companions that had entered into the Netherworld on this trip.

Ling Han took a closer look, and discovered that this living soul was a female. She looked ordinary, but her abilities were quite extraordinary, and the strength of her soul had also surpassed the True Self Tier. Otherwise, there was no way she could stand against this great monster that was a True Self Tier consummate level.

However, her present situation was also quite dire. Though she also had a Soul Tool in her possession, which could oppose the large saber, there was an obvious gap in the strength of soul, so she was in a tight spot.
“Don’t resist stubbornly anymore,” the great yin soul said. “I won’t kill you either. As long as you submit to me, I’ll spare your life.”
A spiritual wave surged over, and Ling Han could actually sense the greed that seeped out of this great yin soul. That was a covetous desire for her beauty.
‘F*ck! Yin souls also have that kind of need?’
Ling Han was instantly a little dumbfounded. What was going on here?
He hurriedly shook his head. This was too vulgar.

Meanwhile, the woman ignored him, and merely brandished her sword in a slash. Occasionally, she would unleash a powerful move, delivering incredibly fierce flashes of Sword Qi, which made even Ling Han feel slightly frightened, and resolved the perilous situation.
This gave her a chance to catch her breath, but in the long term, when her soul power was exhausted, she would definitely still be unable to escape the fate of being killed and captured.
Ling Han shouted lightly, and immediately moved.

“Another one here to deliver himself to death?” That great Yin soul sneered, and sent the woman backwards with a punch. Then, brandishing his saber, he delivered a slash at Ling Han. Ling Han brandished his sword to parry. With a crisp clang, he was instantly sent backwards. In terms of power, he was only at the middle stage of the True Self Tier, so how could he possibly rival someone at the consummate level of the True Self Tier?
“Come, let’s work together!” the woman said.
Ling Han ignored her. He was indeed no match in terms of power, but his resistance against Yin souls had never been based on power or a Soul Tool.
He rushed over again, and again delivered a strike with his sword.

“What an idiot!” The great yin soul laughed loudly, and still delivered a strike with his saber. The woman gritted her teeth, and hurriedly moved, impeding him from the sidelines. Shua, the saber slashed over, yet Ling Han abandoned his sword, causing the great yin soul’s saber to miss its target. He took advantage of the opening to advance, and shot out a punch at the great yin soul.
Yi, there was such a thing?

The large yin soul faltered for a moment, then laughed loudly. Though it had not foreseen this, you have destroyed your own strength. Without your Soul Tool, how are you going to block my saber from now on?
It was already too late for it to parry with its saber, so it also shot out a punch at Ling Han.
He had taken the bait.
Ling Han smiled. Boom! Destructive Energy suddenly jumped up from his fist, rolling out like black flames.
The large monster immediately looked shocked. This kind of energy made it feel fear from the depths of its soul.
It hurriedly wanted to withdraw its fist, but it was already too late.
Peng!
The two fists crashed into each other, and Ling Han was sent flying. Then, he saw that the
large monster’s fist was like snow that was melting, and had directly disappeared.
Not only that, but this disappearance was also spreading upwards. Its entire arm had
disappeared.
“Ah!” The giant monster released a furious roar. With this punch, its soul had been weakened by about one fifth. It was too hurt.

The woman was also taken aback. She had not thought that the power of Ling Han’s punch would be so terrifying. However, she did not hesitate in the slightest, and slashed down with her sword, exploding with an astonishingly cold light.
Since this great monster had been severely injured, she naturally had to take advantage of its illness to take its life.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged back, brandishing both fists.
The large yin soul’s body swayed, and its missing left arm immediately grew back, but its
body had shrunk a size. It first dodged the woman’s attack, then brandished its saber in a slash towards Ling Han. This living soul was too despicable.
The murderous aura surged forth.
Weng, when this attack landed, even if it was a great yin soul, so what? It was instantly hit,
and fell into a state of confusion.
Ling Han took advantage of the opportunity to unleash his killing intent, and his fist had
already shot over.

The great yin soul regained consciousness, but saw two fists smashing towards his face. It was already too late for him to dodge, so he could only use his arms to block in front of him. Though it had a saber in its hand, because the time was too short, how could it possibly parry?
Peng!

After two punches, the great yin soul sadly discovered that its two arms were gone again. This caused it to grit its teeth. Just now, it had still been the consummate level of the True Self Tier, yet now, it was rapidly falling to the middle stage of the True Self Tier.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fists repeatedly, his offensive becoming even
more rapid.
The great yin soul was exhausted from parrying, but it only caused his soul to continuously dim, and in the end, was forcefully destroyed by Ling Han.
Instantly, Ling Han felt a powerful force enter his body, causing the strength of his soul to
clearly increase by a significant amount.
Invigorating.
Ling Han saw that the woman’s eyes were also tightly shut, and her body was trembling slightly. Clearly, she had also gained some benefits. Because the two of them were beside each
other, when the great yin soul was destroyed, the spiritual energy should have been divided
equally among them.
“Thank you!” The woman opened her eyes, and nodded at Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t have any thoughts of blackmailing her into repaying his kindness. He nodded
at the other party, and said, “We’ll meet again.”
“Wait,” the woman hurriedly called out.
“En?” Ling Han stopped in his tracks.
“Perhaps you know that there’s something here that can increase the strength of one’s soul?”
the woman said.

He did not discover a vast expanse of Yin souls, but heard the sounds of battle.
What was going on?
He fled through the shockwaves of battle, and after traversing a small hill, he discovered that there were presently two spiritual bodies battling fiercely.
One of them was a Yin soul.
Moreover, it was a large monster that had reached the level of the True Self Tier consummate stage.
Meanwhile, he wielded a large saber in his hand, and as he brandished the saber, cold light flashed.
It had a massive destructive effect on the soul.
On the other side was a living soul, obviously one of their companions that had entered into the Netherworld on this trip.
Ling Han took a closer look, and discovered that this living soul was a female.
She looked ordinary, but her abilities were quite extraordinary, and the strength of her soul had also surpassed the True Self Tier.
Otherwise, there was no way she could stand against this great monster that was a True Self Tier consummate level.
However, her present situation was also quite dire.
Though she also had a Soul Tool in her possession, which could oppose the large saber, there was an obvious gap in the strength of soul, so she was in a tight spot.
“Don’t resist stubbornly anymore,” the great yin soul said.
“I won’t kill you either.
As long as you submit to me, I’ll spare your life.”
A spiritual wave surged over, and Ling Han could actually sense the greed that seeped out of this great yin soul.
That was a covetous desire for her beauty.
‘F*ck!
Yin souls also have that kind of need?’
Ling Han was instantly a little dumbfounded.
What was going on here?
He hurriedly shook his head.
This was too vulgar.
Meanwhile, the woman ignored him, and merely brandished her sword in a slash.
Occasionally, she would unleash a powerful move, delivering incredibly fierce flashes of Sword Qi, which made even Ling Han feel slightly frightened, and resolved the perilous situation.
This gave her a chance to catch her breath, but in the long term, when her soul power was exhausted, she would definitely still be unable to escape the fate of being killed and captured.
Ling Han shouted lightly, and immediately moved.
“Another one here to deliver himself to death?” That great Yin soul sneered, and sent the woman backwards with a punch.
Then, brandishing his saber, he delivered a slash at Ling Han.
Ling Han brandished his sword to parry.
With a crisp clang, he was instantly sent backwards.
In terms of power, he was only at the middle stage of the True Self Tier, so how could he possibly rival someone at the consummate level of the True Self Tier?
“Come, let’s work together!” the woman said.
Ling Han ignored her.
He was indeed no match in terms of power, but his resistance against Yin souls had never been based on power or a Soul Tool.
He rushed over again, and again delivered a strike with his sword.
“What an idiot!” The great yin soul laughed loudly, and still delivered a strike with his saber.
The woman gritted her teeth, and hurriedly moved, impeding him from the sidelines.
Shua, the saber slashed over, yet Ling Han abandoned his sword, causing the great yin soul’s saber to miss its target.
He took advantage of the opening to advance, and shot out a punch at the great yin soul.
Yi, there was such a thing?
The large yin soul faltered for a moment, then laughed loudly.
Though it had not foreseen this, you have destroyed your own strength.
Without your Soul Tool, how are you going to block my saber from now on?
It was already too late for it to parry with its saber, so it also shot out a punch at Ling Han.
He had taken the bait.
Ling Han smiled.
Boom!
Destructive Energy suddenly jumped up from his fist, rolling out like black flames.
The large monster immediately looked shocked.
This kind of energy made it feel fear from the depths of its soul.
It hurriedly wanted to withdraw its fist, but it was already too late.
Peng!
The two fists crashed into each other, and Ling Han was sent flying.
Then, he saw that the
large monster’s fist was like snow that was melting, and had directly disappeared.
Not only that, but this disappearance was also spreading upwards.
Its entire arm had
disappeared.
“Ah!” The giant monster released a furious roar.
With this punch, its soul had been weakened by about one fifth.
It was too hurt.
The woman was also taken aback.
She had not thought that the power of Ling Han’s punch would be so terrifying.
However, she did not hesitate in the slightest, and slashed down with her sword, exploding with an astonishingly cold light.
Since this great monster had been severely injured, she naturally had to take advantage of its illness to take its life.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged back, brandishing both fists.
The large yin soul’s body swayed, and its missing left arm immediately grew back, but its
body had shrunk a size.
It first dodged the woman’s attack, then brandished its saber in a slash towards Ling Han.
This living soul was too despicable.
The murderous aura surged forth.
Weng, when this attack landed, even if it was a great yin soul, so what?
It was instantly hit,
and fell into a state of confusion.
Ling Han took advantage of the opportunity to unleash his killing intent, and his fist had
already shot over.
The great yin soul regained consciousness, but saw two fists smashing towards his face.
It was already too late for him to dodge, so he could only use his arms to block in front of him.
Though it had a saber in its hand, because the time was too short, how could it possibly parry?
Peng!
After two punches, the great yin soul sadly discovered that its two arms were gone again.
This caused it to grit its teeth.
Just now, it had still been the consummate level of the True Self Tier, yet now, it was rapidly falling to the middle stage of the True Self Tier.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fists repeatedly, his offensive becoming even
more rapid.
The great yin soul was exhausted from parrying, but it only caused his soul to continuously dim, and in the end, was forcefully destroyed by Ling Han.
Instantly, Ling Han felt a powerful force enter his body, causing the strength of his soul to
clearly increase by a significant amount.
Invigorating.
Ling Han saw that the woman’s eyes were also tightly shut, and her body was trembling slightly.
Clearly, she had also gained some benefits.
Because the two of them were beside each
other, when the great yin soul was destroyed, the spiritual energy should have been divided
equally among them.
“Thank you!” The woman opened her eyes, and nodded at Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t have any thoughts of blackmailing her into repaying his kindness.
He nodded
at the other party, and said, “We’ll meet again.”
“Wait,” the woman hurriedly called out.
“En?” Ling Han stopped in his tracks.
“Perhaps you know that there’s something here that can increase the strength of one’s soul?”
the woman said.

chapters.title: Chapter 4000: Mine
paragraphs: “Ghost Spirit Crystal?” Ling Han asked.

The woman nodded, “That’s right. When the strength of our souls has advanced into the True Self Tier, killing ordinary Yin souls would no longer be able to strengthen our souls. We would only be able to kill True Self Tier Yin souls, or... use Ghost Spirit Crystals.”
“And then?” Ling Han asked.
The woman was neither too fast nor too slow, “There are very few Yin souls of True Self Tier, and they are also very hard to kill...”

At this point, she paused. This did not seem to be applicable to Ling Han. Just now, this guy had practically killed a Yin soul of consummate True Self Tier. He could not be measured in terms of common sense.
She continued, “So, if one can refine the Ghost Spirit Crystal, it would be much simpler.”
Ling Han smiled, “You know where there is a large number of Ghost Spirit Crystals?”
“That’s right.” The woman nodded, “Oh, that’s right, my name is Chi Xuan. I come from the Donglin Imperial Clan.”
“Continue.” Ling Han did not show any reverence towards the Imperial Clan, and nodded very casually.
Chi Xuan appeared slightly surprised. This young man was really calm. He was completely unmoved even when he heard the words “Imperial Clan”. No wonder he dared to challenge Fu Huoyang.
She withdrew her surprise, and continued, “Our Donglin Imperial Clan has long since entered here, so we know more about this place.”
At this point, she stopped again.
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh. What was wrong with her? Was she trying to keep him hanging?
He did not speak either, and merely looked at Chi Xuan.
Chi Xuan was a little disappointed. This guy was too calm, wasn’t he? She didn’t even know where to start if she wanted to use the secret to blackmail him into negotiating an alliance.
“There’s a mine of Ghost Spirit Crystal here,” she said directly.
Ling Han finally revealed a shocked expression, and asked, “Really?”

“En.” Chi Xuan nodded, “However, the mine is occupied by the Western Desert King, and there is a powerful Yin soul keeping watch at all times. Our Donglin Imperial Clan is inviting all the young prodigies in the world to work together to take down this mine. At the very least, we would have to snatch some Ghost Spirit Crystals.”
Sure enough, Ling Han had already guessed that the prodigy gathering this time wasn’t as simple as simply selecting a son-in-law for Chi Menghan. In fact, this was only a pretense.
-She was a noble daughter of the Imperial Clan, and was also a seductive beauty ranked third on the Beauty Roll. Was there any need to use this kind of method to choose a partner?

“Previously, our clan had indeed invited a large number of prodigies to launch an attack on that mine, but we never thought that the strength of the guards would exceed our imagination. Almost all of us were wiped out, and only a very small number managed to escape separately,” Chi Xuan said.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then asked, “What are the abilities of the strongest elites?”
“Late stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier,” Chi Xuan replied.

Ling Han frowned slightly. Relying on the strength of the Destructive Energy, he could even match the early stage of the Spiritual Transformation Tier. However, if he encountered a middle stage Spiritual Transformation Tier, he would be done for. If he encountered a late stage Spiritual Transformation Tier, his only fate would definitely be to flee.
However, if they couldn’t snatch the mine, but could they steal the mine?
Chi Xuan smiled faintly, “With Brother Ding’s strength, if we work together, we should be able to steal some ores.”
“You know about me?” Ling Han was surprised.
“As the host, how could I not know the identity of a guest?” Chi Xuan countered.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “All right, we will go and steal the mine.”

When they returned to the Living Realm, natural treasures that could strengthen the soul were too rare. Even the Imperial Clan couldn’t supply them in large quantities. Thus, when the Donglin Imperial Clan discovered this place, and when they discovered the existence of the Ghost Spirit Crystal, they couldn’t remain calm any longer, and immediately called for the Prodigy Gathering this time.
Moreover, in order to keep this a secret, they had even used the excuse of finding a husband for Chi Menghan.
Of course, if it weren’t for the fact that the Natural Treasured Gourd could only accommodate cultivators below the True Self Tier, the Donglin Imperial Clan wouldn’t have been so
generous.
Ling Han’s soul wasn’t weak, but compared to his battle prowess, it couldn’t be considered top-notch at all. Thus, he couldn’t miss this opportunity.
The two of them happily reached an agreement, and Chi Xuan led the way, heading towards the mine.
After spending close to a day’s time, they finally arrived at the mine.
“Yi?” Ling Han was surprised. There was actually a formation here, and it was extremely brilliant at that.
“You saw through it?” Chi Xuan was also quite surprised. This guy also knew formation techniques.
Ling Han nodded, “Who would’ve thought that there would be Formation Masters among yin souls.”

Chi Xuan looked at Ling Han, and a hint of admiration appeared on her face, “I had not expected either. Not only do you have astonishing battle prowess, you are also proficient in formation techniques.”

“I can’t be considered proficient, but I do have some understanding.” Ling Han was modest. “This formation has already been broken through by the Formation Master of my clan. Please follow me,” Chi Xuan said.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. Since it was already broken through, he didn’t need to waste any more effort.
The two of them entered into the formation, and with Chi Xuan leading the way, the two of them soon walked out.
The mountain was still the same mountain, and the sky was still the same. It was dark and gloomy, but in truth, they had indeed passed through a formation area.

“This formation is actually mainly to prevent weak Yin souls from entering by accident,” Chi Xuan said, “According to the deductions of the Saints of my clan, there are not many Ghost Spirit Crystals in the Netherworld, so it is impossible to create powerful Yin souls in this
way.”
“However, the number of Yin souls is endless. Hence, using this as bait, allowing the Yin souls to devour each other, only then would they be able to endlessly create powerful Yin
souls.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. The universe was far too large, and large amounts of living beings would die at any moment. Their souls would also enter the Netherworld.
“Be careful. There are three Spiritual Transformation Tier Yin souls standing guard here,” Chi
Xuan said solemnly.
“All right.”
The two of them advanced, and soon saw some Yin souls mining, and these Yin souls were all Core Formation Tier souls who had gained intelligence.
True, if it hadn’t developed intelligence, it wouldn’t have be mining the mountain, and if the Ghost Spirit Crystal was mined, the yin soul would refine it itself, so how could it be handed
over?
Only with reverence would one not dare to be greedy.
It was just like how mortals dug out gold ores, who would dare to take it for themselves?
“What do you want to do?” Chi Xuan asked Ling Han.
“Since this is a mine, it should be excavated here and there. We don’t have to stick to this
place,” Ling Han said after some thought.
“All right.”
The two of them switched locations, then using the Soul Tool as a shovel, began digging.
Of course, it was impossible that there would be ore immediately after digging, and the two of them were both calm. Though they had dug for a long time without any results, they were
not discouraged.
But when there was not the slightest bit of gain for a whole two days, a thought rose up in both of them, and that was there really might not be any Ghost Spirit Crystals in this area.
“Let’s go somewhere else.”
They kept changing locations to dig, but the result was the same. They had gained nothing.
“No way, only that area has Ghost Spirit Crystal?” Both of them were speechless.
They returned to where the Yin souls were mining, and observed carefully. After half a day, they saw these yin souls dig out two Ghost Spirit Crystals. Though they
weren’t very big, nor were they very pure, they did indeed have some gains.
“Forced robbery?” Chi Xuan asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “There are only two Ghost Spirit Crystals, so it isn’t worth
it to alert the elites here.”
“Then what do you mean?” “Steal their stores.”
